Most notably, he now stars in his biggest film role to date as Oscar-winning Rocky producer Irwin Winkler in Peter Farrelly’s biographical awards contender, I Play Rocky.
paras.zh: 这位新泽西人仅在 2026 年就获得了 8 部作品，其中包括他在《男孩们》、《土狼 vs. Acme》、《橡树街的尽头》中反复出现的角色的结局，以及在美国热门有线电视节目《造雨人》中的常规角色。最值得注意的是，他现在在彼得·法拉利的传记奖竞争者《我扮演洛基》中饰演奥斯卡获奖洛奇制片人欧文·温克勒，这是他迄今为止最重要的电影角色。

paras.en: In 1975, Winkler and his producing partner Robert Chartoff were developing Martin Scorsese’s New York, New York at the same time as the underdog story from a then-unknown Sylvester Stallone. The former would become the first of a half-dozen films Winkler collaborated on with Scorsese, including 2013’s The Wolf of Wall Street. It’s fitting, then, that Byrne is now playing the celebrated producer, given that his own career turning point came with his role as Rugrat in Scorsese and Leonardo DiCaprio’s unhinged take on the life of former stockbroker Jordan Belfort. (Byrne would later reunite with Scorsese on his 2016 series Vinyl.)
paras.zh: 1975 年，温克勒和他的制片搭档罗伯特·查托夫正在拍摄马丁·斯科塞斯的《纽约，纽约》，同时拍摄当时还默默无闻的西尔维斯特·史泰龙的失败者故事。前者成为温克勒与斯科塞斯合作的六部电影中的第一部，其中包括 2013 年的《华尔街之狼》。那么，伯恩现在扮演这位著名制片人是很合适的，因为他自己的职业转折点是在斯科塞斯中饰演鲁格拉特以及莱昂纳多·迪卡普里奥对前股票经纪人乔丹·贝尔福特的生活的精神错乱的演绎中出现的。 （伯恩后来在他的 2016 年剧集《黑胶唱片》中与斯科塞斯重聚。）

paras.en: Byrne’s turn as a founding member of Belfort’s Stratton Oakmont is probably best remembered for one particularly rambunctious trading-floor scene in which his character shaves a female sales assistant’s head. The opportunity also allowed Byrne to put his unused finance degree from Boston College to work, albeit in a fictionalized version of a career path he had quickly abandoned because of his aversion to boiler-room culture.
paras.zh: 伯恩作为贝尔福特斯特拉顿奥克蒙特的创始成员，最令人难忘的可能是一个特别粗暴的交易大厅场景，在这个场景中，他的角色剃掉了一名女销售助理的头发。这个机会还让伯恩将他从波士顿学院获得的未使用的金融学位投入到工作中，尽管他由于厌恶锅炉房文化而很快放弃了职业道路的虚构版本。

paras.en: In the mid-’90s, one of his Boston College professors encouraged him to try his hand at drama school instead, leading him to DePaul University in Chicago. Byrne’s time in the Windy City seems to have left a lasting impression. He often speaks about acting in the same terms that Chicago Bulls legend Michael Jordan once used to describe his record-setting 3-point barrage against the Portland Trail Blazers in Game 1 of the 1992 NBA Finals. When Byrne acts, he strives to enter a flow state, or “the zone,” as Jordan called it, where he’s so locked in to the task at hand that distractions fade and he can achieve peak performance.
paras.zh: 上世纪 90 年代中期，波士顿学院的一位教授鼓励他去戏剧学校尝试，并带领他进入了芝加哥的德保罗大学。伯恩在风城的时光似乎给人留下了深刻的印象。他经常用芝加哥公牛队传奇人物迈克尔·乔丹描述自己在 1992 年 NBA 总决赛第一场比赛中对阵波特兰开拓者队的创纪录三分球的术语来谈论自己的表演。当伯恩行动时，他会努力进入心流状态，或者乔丹所说的“区域”，在这种状态下，他会全神贯注于手头的任务，干扰会消失，从而能够达到最佳表现。

paras.en: Byrne’s Wolf of Wall Street video audition featured a monologue he reimagined from the ground up. Channeling his brief experience in the financial world, he portrayed his stockbroker character emotionally manipulating a widow into forking over $100,000 during a sales call. Scorsese appreciated the creative risk so much that he recited part of the speech back to Byrne during their eventual in-person callback. Byrne’s improvisational instincts and willingness to take creative leaps through punch-ups and alternative dialogue are muscles he first developed during his early days in Los Angeles.
paras.zh: 伯恩的《华尔街之狼》试镜视频中有一段他从头开始重新构思的独白。他借用了自己在金融界的短暂经历，描绘了自己的股票经纪人角色，在一次销售拜访中，情绪激动地操纵一位寡妇，让她支付超过 10 万美元。斯科塞斯非常欣赏这种创造性的风险，以至于他在最终的面对面回电中向伯恩背诵了部分演讲内容。伯恩的即兴创作本能以及通过拳打脚踢和另类对话实现创造性飞跃的意愿是他早年在洛杉矶锻炼出来的肌肉。

paras.en: At the turn of the century, Byrne put himself through the wringer of commercial auditions. With a talent pool far deeper than most people might expect, he knew he needed to find a way to stand out. That meant arriving with his own variations on the material or improvising in the moment. To pay the bills between sporadic acting jobs, he provided script coverage and handled other development duties at the production company of family friend and fellow Boston College alum Chris O’Donnell.
paras.zh: 在世纪之交，伯恩经历了商业试镜的痛苦。他的人才库远远超出大多数人的预期，他知道自己需要找到一种脱颖而出的方法。这意味着他要带着自己对材料的变化或即兴发挥。为了支付零星表演工作之间的账单，他在家庭朋友、波士顿学院校友克里斯·奥唐纳的制作公司提供剧本报道并处理其他开发职责。

paras.en: Eventually, he left his VP position to focus solely on acting. Nameless parts soon gave way to small but named roles, though there were milestones along the way that reinforced his greater pursuit. One came when he made Will Ferrell and Stephen Colbert laugh during a table-read scene in Nora Ephron’s Bewitched (2005). Byrne played a TV writer in the film, an early example of the showbiz-affiliated roles that would become a calling card throughout his career. He speculates that his time working in development may have influenced that pattern.
paras.zh: 最终，他辞去了副总裁的职务，专注于演艺事业。无名的角色很快就被小而有名的角色所取代，尽管一路上有一些里程碑加强了他更大的追求。其中之一是，在诺拉·艾芙隆 (Nora Ephron) 的《迷惑》(Bewitched)（2005 年）中，他让威尔·法瑞尔 (Will Ferrell) 和史蒂芬·科尔伯特 (Stephen Colbert) 在桌读场景中大笑。伯恩在影片中扮演一名电视编剧，这是演艺界角色的早期例子，这些角色后来成为他整个职业生涯的名片。他推测他从事开发工作的时间可能影响了这种模式。

paras.en: Byrne’s road to I Play Rocky can also be traced back to commercials cast by casting director Rick Montgomery. It further involved producer Toby Emmerich’s tenure as head of New Line, during which Byrne made memorable appearances in the label’s Horrible Bosses and Final Destination 5. Above all, Byrne won a major fan in Farrelly when he played a record executive in the best picture-winning Green Book, followed by Dear Santa, the Christmas comedy Farrelly co-wrote for his brother Bobby to direct.
paras.zh: 伯恩的《我玩洛奇》之路也可以追溯到选角导演里克·蒙哥马利拍摄的广告。它还涉及制片人托比·艾默里奇 (Toby Emmerich) 担任新线 (New Line) 负责人期间，伯恩在该厂牌的《恐怖老板》和《死神来了 5》中令人难忘的亮相。最重要的是，伯恩在获得最佳影片奖的《绿皮书》中扮演唱片公司高管，赢得了《法拉利》的一大粉丝，随后是《亲爱的圣诞老人》，这是法拉利与他的兄弟鲍比共同编剧的圣诞喜剧。

paras.en: “After Green Book, Peter was like, ‘You need your Paul Giamatti [in Sideways] part. You need a bigger part in a movie,’” Byrne tells The Hollywood Reporter.
paras.zh: “绿皮书之后，彼得说，‘你需要保罗·吉亚玛提（《杯酒人生》中的角色）。你需要在电影中扮演更重要的角色，’”伯恩告诉《好莱坞报道》。

paras.en: The role of Irwin Winkler still didn’t come easy. In the behind-the-scenes narrative, Winkler and Chartoff desperately want to produce Stallone’s Rocky screenplay, but he refuses to sell it unless he gets to star as the title character. Winkler and Chartoff, ever the pragmatists, try to give the aspiring young actor and screenwriter a reality check about how star power drives the financing and green-lighting of most movies. But Stallone stands his ground despite increasingly lucrative offers for the script.
paras.zh: 欧文·温克勒（Irwin Winkler）的角色仍然不容易。在幕后故事中，温克勒和查托夫迫切希望制作史泰龙的《洛奇》剧本，但史泰龙拒绝出售剧本，除非他能出演主角。温克勒和查托夫一直是实用主义者，他们试图让这位有抱负的年轻演员和编剧接受现实检验，了解明星力量如何推动大多数电影的融资和开绿灯。但尽管剧本报价越来越丰厚，史泰龙仍坚持自己的立场。

paras.en: Eventually, Winkler and Chartoff realize they shouldn’t be producing an underdog story about a small-time boxer named Rocky Balboa if they aren’t willing to practice what they preach. So they risk everything, including their names and their homes, to install Stallone as the star, all while distributor United Artists sets him up to fail at every turn in hopes of replacing him with a proven commodity.
paras.zh: 最终，温克勒和查托夫意识到，如果他们不愿意言出必行，就不应该制作一个关于一个名叫洛基·巴尔博亚的小拳击手的失败故事。因此，他们冒着一切风险，包括自己的名字和家园，将史泰龙选为明星，而发行商联美公司则让史泰龙每次都失败，希望用一种成熟的商品取代他。

paras.en: The casting of Byrne’s role also became rather meta because the I Play Rocky brain trust initially sought a name for Winkler. With relative unknown Anthony Ippolito already cast as young Sly, it’s understandable why they would want to shore up the surrounding roles with established, butts-in-seats actors. But the producers of I Play Rocky ultimately arrived at the same conclusion as the producers of Rocky — gamble on talent, not status.
paras.zh: 伯恩这个角色的选角也变得相当元，因为“我扮演洛基”智囊团最初为温克勒寻找一个名字。由于相对不知名的安东尼·伊波利托(Anthony Ippolito)已经出演了年轻的斯莱(Sly)，所以他们希望用成熟的演员来支撑周围的角色是可以理解的。但《我玩洛奇》的制片人最终得出了与《洛奇》制片人相同的结论——赌的是才华，而不是地位。

paras.en: “They wanted to get a name, because there weren’t a lot of names [in this cast]. But they were also living in the world of, If we’re going to cast Anthony Ippolito as Sylvester Stallone, then let’s give other people shots too,” Byrne says. “They all knew me from these small parts. Then they just believed in me enough to give me a shot. I want to tell the world that there’s honestly no small parts. Someone will ultimately give you a chance.”
paras.zh: “他们想要一个名字，因为[这个演员阵容中]的名字并不多。但他们也生活在这样的世界里，如果我们要让安东尼·伊波利托扮演西尔维斯特·史泰龙，那么我们也给其他人提供镜头，”伯恩说。 “他们都从这些小细节中认识了我。然后他们就足够相信我，给了我一个机会。我想告诉世界，老实说，没有小细节。最终会有人给你机会。”

paras.en: Below, in a conversation with THR, Byrne also discusses the day his improvisational skills resulted in I Play Rocky’s most hilarious scene. He also addresses whether the strained relationship between Winkler and Stallone in recent years influenced his take at all.
paras.zh: 下面，在与《THR》的对话中，伯恩还讨论了他的即兴创作技巧导致《我玩洛奇》最搞笑场景的那一天。他还谈到了近年来温克勒和史泰龙之间的紧张关系是否影响了他的看法。

paras.en: It’s not talent. I just have three children. I have to pay for their lives. That’s all that is. It’s like, Yes, I’ll do that. I have three children.
paras.zh: 这不是天赋。我只有三个孩子。我必须为他们的生命付出代价。仅此而已。就像是，是的，我会这么做。我有三个孩子。

paras.en: You’ve still cemented yourself as one of the industry’s go-to character actors.
paras.zh: 您仍然巩固了自己作为业界首选角色演员之一的地位。

paras.en: I always say ABC: always be classy. So I don’t know if I can admit to that, but I do have repeat buyers, if you will, because they’re buddies. Once I work on anything, I tend to have repeat business. So I’ll meet you halfway. I hate giving myself flowers like that, but I believe in myself to deliver. And if other people see that, then I appreciate it.
paras.zh: 我总是说ABC：永远保持优雅。所以我不知道我是否可以承认这一点，但如果你愿意的话，我确实有回头客，因为他们是朋友。一旦我开始做某件事，我往往就会有回头客。所以我会在半路上遇见你。我讨厌给自己送这样的花，但我相信自己能送花。如果其他人看到这一点，我会很感激。

paras.en: When you hear labels like “character actor” or “comic relief” or “scene-stealer,” do you bristle at all? Or do you embrace the lane you’ve carved out for yourself?
paras.zh: 当你听到“性格演员”、“喜剧浮雕”或“抢镜者”等标签时，你会感到愤怒吗？或者你是否拥抱自己为自己开辟的道路？

paras.en: It’s funny. I don’t even look at it that way. All ships rise with the tide. I want everyone to score and win. I’m always surrounded by incredible actors in everything I do, so everyone passes the ball nicely. It’s not about being funny or stealing scenes. It’s, How do I make these moments pop more? This sounds so cheesy and trite, but it’s really, How do I service the director or the writer? I’ve been doing this so long that they are often my really good friends.
paras.zh: 这很有趣。我什至不这么看。所有的船只都随着潮水而上升。我希望每个人都能得分并获胜。在我所做的一切事情中，我周围总是有一些出色的演员，所以每个人都传得很好。这不是为了搞笑或偷场面。问题是，我如何让这些时刻更加流行？这听起来很俗气、很老套，但实际上是，我如何为导演或编剧服务？我这样做已经很久了，所以他们常常是我真正的好朋友。

paras.en: When someone makes a movie, they’ve put four years of their life into it. They’ve battled producers and studio executives to get this one day of this particular scene, and half their budget is being spent on a goddamn crane shot. So I just want to do everything I can for them. I put in the work, and my brain just naturally looks for moments that can pop. Is there an ability to make this zeitgeisty so that people can relate to it and it can become its own thing?
paras.zh: 当有人拍一部电影时，他们投入了四年的生命。他们与制片人和工作室高管进行了斗争，以获得这一特定场景的这一天，而他们的一半预算都花在了该死的起重机镜头上。所以我只想为他们做一切我能做的事。当我投入工作时，我的大脑就会自然而然地寻找可能出现的时刻。是否有能力让这种时代精神成为人们的共鸣，并使其成为自己的东西？

paras.en: I started out in Los Angeles doing commercials, and I was baptized by fire doing them. Commercials are like street basketball. It’s rough. They’re not nice to you. The rooms aren’t sweet. They’re not kind. But some of the best actors are commercial actors. They just never found the right lane or the right agent. They’re still out there, and they’re extraordinary actors. But adding jokes during commercial auditions is how I trained my brain to find moments to pop. I would think of the fifth funniest joke in my brain because the first four would probably be thought of by someone else.
paras.zh: 我一开始是在洛杉矶拍广告，在做这些广告的过程中我经历了火的洗礼。广告就像街头篮球。这很粗糙。他们对你不好。房间不温馨。他们并不友善。但一些最好的演员是商业演员。他们只是从来没有找到正确的路线或合适的经纪人。他们仍然在那里，而且他们是非凡的演员。但在商业试镜期间添加笑话是我训练大脑寻找流行时刻的方法。我会在我的大脑中想到第五个最有趣的笑话，因为前四个可能会被其他人想到。

paras.en: That mindset succeeds in scenarios where I have fearless directors who’ve proven themselves. It’s usually the great directors like Marty Scorsese or Peter Farrelly or Damien Chazelle who don’t have to worry about notes from everyone. They know I’ve done the work and have their vision in mind, so they’ll take the handcuffs off me. They’ll be like, “Just add stuff. We trust you. Go.” They know that before a job, I’ll literally sit in a hotel room for two weeks and have food sent up while I make sure I’m doing everything I can for them. I don’t want to let anyone down.
paras.zh: 当我拥有无畏的董事并证明了自己的能力时，这种心态就会成功。通常像马蒂·斯科塞斯、彼得·法拉利或达米恩·查泽雷这样的伟大导演不必担心每个人的笔记。他们知道我已经完成了工作并考虑到了他们的愿景，所以他们会取下我的手铐。他们会说，“只需添加一些东西即可。我们相信你。走吧。”他们知道，在工作之前，我实际上会在酒店房间里坐两个星期，让食物送上来，同时确保我为他们做了一切。我不想让任何人失望。

paras.en: You’re also asked to play showbiz people fairly often. The Boys, Babylon, The Big Cigar and A Complete Unknown are only a few examples, as is your current role as Irwin Winkler in I Play Rocky. Do you have any theories why this has become your niche?
paras.zh: 你还经常被要求扮演演艺界的人物。 《男孩们》、《巴比伦》、《大雪茄》和《完全未知》只是几个例子，你目前在《我玩洛奇》中扮演的欧文·温克勒也是如此。你有什么理论来解释为什么这会成为你的利基市场吗？

paras.en: I feel like I have a face like that. I also do a lot of period pieces and play a lot of lawyers. That’s just what’s filming now. But I think it’s all because I know those characters well from when I started out in Los Angeles.
paras.zh: 我感觉我也有一张这样的脸。我也拍了很多古装片，扮演了很多律师。这就是现在正在拍摄的内容。但我认为这都是因为我从洛杉矶开始就很了解这些角色。

paras.en: I owe a lot to Chris O’Donnell. When he was Robin [in Batman & Robin], he had a production company at Warner Bros. His sisters and my sister are really good friends. And because I had a finance degree from Boston College, I was like, If acting doesn’t work out, I can be an intern with them. To his credit, his company gave me a script and were like, “Hey, do coverage on this script.” So I did, and the coverage was called “brilliant.” But it was only brilliant because I literally just went to grad school where I learned arc and character. I literally just wrote papers for three years.
paras.zh: 我非常感谢克里斯·奥唐纳。当他还是罗宾（《蝙蝠侠与罗宾》）时，他在华纳兄弟拥有一家制作公司。他的姐妹和我的姐妹是非常好的朋友。因为我拥有波士顿学院的金融学位，所以我想，如果表演不成功，我可以和他们一起实习。值得赞扬的是，他的公司给了我一个剧本，然后说：“嘿，对这个剧本进行报道。”我就这样做了，报道被称为“精彩”。但这只是因为我刚刚进入研究生院，在那里我学习了弧线和角色。我实际上只写了三年论文。

paras.en: Chris was like, “Be our story editor.” And I was like, “Chris, I came here to act.” Then he gave me the greatest gift ever when he said, “No, come and go as you please.” So I was able to walk onto the Warner Bros. and work for him, while also doing commercials and small TV jobs. Every time I tried to quit, they were like, “You’re a vice president right now.”
paras.zh: 克里斯说，“成为我们的故事编辑。”我当时想，“克里斯，我来这里是为了表演。”然后他给了我有史以来最棒的礼物，他说：“不，你想来就去，想走就走。”所以我能够走进华纳兄弟并为他工作，同时也做广告和小型电视工作。每次我试图辞职时，他们都会说，“你现在是副总统。”

paras.en: I set up movies. I learned the business. I would walk past The West Wing and ER stages, and I told myself that I wouldn’t set foot on those stages until I was invited. And I did eventually book those jobs. So I became comfortable being in that environment, and it wasn’t so daunting going into those rooms.
paras.zh: 我设置了电影。我学会了生意。我会走过西翼和急诊室的舞台，我告诉自己，在受到邀请之前我不会踏上这些舞台。我最终确实预订了这些工作。所以我在那个环境中变得很舒服，进入那些房间并不那么令人畏惧。

paras.en: It’s because of all those early experiences that I have a lot of friends who are producers, writers and directors. So I know this world well, and when someone says, “Play this showbiz part,” I’m like, “Trust me, I got it.”
paras.zh: 正是因为这些早期的经历，我有了很多制片人、作家和导演朋友。所以我很了解这个世界，当有人说“扮演这个演艺圈的角色”时，我会说，“相信我，我明白了。”

paras.en: You worked with Peter Farrelly on Green Book and Dear Santa. Did he go straight to you for Irwin Winkler?
paras.zh: 您与彼得·法拉利合作拍摄了《绿皮书》和《亲爱的圣诞老人》。他直接去找你找欧文·温克勒吗？

paras.en: It wasn’t straight to me, but I love Peter forever. I want to tell the world that there’s honestly no small parts, and you never know what’s going to come around. And that’s why this movie was so super meta for me. They wanted to get a name, because there weren’t a lot of names [in this cast]. But they were also living in the world of, If we’re going to cast Anthony Ippolito as Sylvester Stallone, then let’s give other people shots too.
paras.zh: 这对我来说并不直接，但我永远爱彼得。我想告诉世界，老实说，没有小部件，你永远不知道会发生什么。这就是为什么这部电影对我来说是如此超级元。他们想要一个名字，因为[这个演员]的名字并不多。但他们也生活在这样的世界里：如果我们要让安东尼·伊波利托扮演西尔维斯特·史泰龙，那么我们也给其他人机会。

paras.en: After Green Book, Peter was like, “You need your Paul Giamatti [in Sideways] part. You need a bigger part in a movie.” [I Play Rocky casting director] Rick Montgomery cast me in commercials years ago, and [producer] Toby Emmerich also ran New Line when I had small parts in Horrible Bosses and Final Destination 5.
paras.zh: 《绿皮书》之后，彼得说，“你需要保罗·吉亚玛蒂（《杯酒人生》中的角色）。你需要在电影中扮演更重要的角色。” [《我扮演洛奇》选角导演] 里克·蒙哥马利 (Rick Montgomery) 几年前就让我出演广告，[制片人] 托比·艾默里奇 (Toby Emmerich) 也在我在《恐怖老板》和《死神来了 5》中扮演小角色时负责了新线。

paras.en: So they all knew me from these small parts, and they all said, “He’s ready to have a bigger part. Come audition for this.” Then they just believed in me enough to give me a shot. Someone will ultimately give you a chance, just like they once gave it to Sylvester Stallone and now Anthony Ippolito and me.
paras.zh: 所以他们都是从这些小角色中认识我的，他们都说，“他已经准备好扮演更大的角色了。来试镜吧。”然后他们就足够相信我，给了我一个机会。最终会有人给你机会，就像他们曾经给西尔维斯特·史泰龙，现在给安东尼·伊波利托和我一样。

paras.en: Everything is driven by the same dozen names now, so it’s nice to hear that Farrelly is looking elsewhere.
paras.zh: 现在一切都由同样的十几个名字驱动，所以很高兴听到法雷利正在寻找其他地方。

paras.en: Yeah, he’s incredibly loyal. If you look at his movies, the same people always come back. When you go out for drinks with Pete, 32 people show up with him. I love that idea of a family. Working with friends is the best way to go to work, and that’s another reason why I get repeat business.
paras.zh: 是的，他非常忠诚。如果你看他的电影，总是同样的人回来。当你和皮特出去喝酒时，有 32 个人和他一起出现。我喜欢家庭的想法。与朋友一起工作是最好的工作方式，这也是我获得回头客的另一个原因。

paras.en: When it’s four in the morning on a Friday night and you’ve been shooting 12 hours, we’re still cheerleaders for each other. I love those kinds of sets. It kills me when I see people being cancers or want to get off set. Again, I know what my friend went through to be here after four years. So I always say, “Let’s deliver this moment the best way we can because we’re never coming back.”
paras.zh: 当周五晚上凌晨 4 点，你已经拍摄了 12 个小时时，我们仍然是彼此的啦啦队队长。我喜欢这类套装。当我看到人们患有癌症或想要摆脱困境时，我会感到很伤心。我再次知道我的朋友四年后来到这里经历了什么。所以我总是说，“让我们以最好的方式度过这一刻，因为我们永远不会回来了。”

paras.en: What went through your mind when you first witnessed Anthony Ippolito’s take on Sly?
paras.zh: 当你第一次目睹安东尼·伊波利托 (Anthony Ippolito) 对斯莱 (Sly) 的表演时，你的想法是什么？

paras.en: It was at a table read, and while everybody does a version of Sylvester Stallone, I was like, We’re living and dying on this kid. This is the moment. And as soon as he opened his mouth, it was so subtle and soulful and full of heart. It honestly surpassed what my expectation was going to be. I have been doing this a long time, and this is the biggest part I’ve ever gotten in a movie. It’s so beautiful for me, personally. But I can’t help but get so psyched for this kid because he’s so spectacular.
paras.zh: 那是在一张桌子上读的，当每个人都在读西尔维斯特·史泰龙的版本时，我想，我们的生死存亡都在这个孩子身上。这就是现在。而他一开口，又是那么的含蓄深情，饱含深情。老实说，它超出了我的预期。我这样做已经很长时间了，这是我在一部电影中得到的最重要的部分。就我个人而言，这对我来说非常美丽。但我情不自禁地为这个孩子感到兴奋，因为他太出色了。

paras.en: I’ve been around some incredible performances. I watched Leo just destroy on The Wolf of Wall Street. And Margot Robbie, I still wish she got her flowers for Babylon. There’s even a scene with me and Laura Dern on Big Little Lies. When you’re an actor in a scene with them and the camera’s not on you, there’s just a moment when you become an audience member. And you’re like, Oh shit, it’s happening. You can feel it in the room and you want to deliver for them and be there for them. And that’s what happened with Anthony.
paras.zh: 我经历过一些令人难以置信的表演。我在《华尔街之狼》中看到了里奥的毁灭。还有玛格特·罗比，我仍然希望她能为巴比伦送花。甚至还有我和劳拉·邓恩在《大小谎言》中的一场戏。当你作为演员与他们一起演出而镜头不在你身上时，你就会成为一名观众。你会想，哦，该死，它正在发生。你可以在房间里感受到它，你想为他们提供服务并为他们服务。这就是安东尼身上发生的事情。

paras.en: He was in the zone. That’s what basketball players say when the net looks like the size of an ocean and they can’t miss. That’s what it felt like watching Anthony. He was so good that I kept thinking, Did Sylvester Stallone travel through space and time to possess this kid’s body? That’s how special it was. Then Pete would call cut, and Anthony would come back online and say, “Hey, what are we getting for dinner tonight?” And I was just like, “What is going on right now?” Peter and I were like, “Is he the world’s greatest actor?” He also played Rocky and Sylvester Stallone, and it was just crazy to watch him play two different characters.
paras.zh: 他就在这个区域。当篮球网看起来像海洋那么大并且他们不会投丢时，篮球运动员就会这么说。这就是看安东尼的感觉。他太棒了，我一直在想，西尔维斯特·史泰龙是否穿越时空来占有这个孩子的身体？这就是它的特别之处。然后皮特会打电话挂断，安东尼会回到网上并说：“嘿，我们今晚吃什么？”我当时就想，“现在发生了什么事？”彼得和我问，“他是世界上最伟大的演员吗？”他还扮演了洛基和西尔维斯特·史泰龙，看着他扮演两个不同的角色真是太疯狂了。

paras.en: I also watched Timothée Chalamet be Bob Dylan, and that was another time where I was like, “Holy shit.” But Timmy would stay in character, unlike Anthony. So everyone has their own method, and there is no right way.
paras.zh: 我还看过蒂莫西·柴勒梅德扮演鲍勃·迪伦，那是另一次我想，“天哪。”但与安东尼不同的是，蒂米会保持自己的性格。所以每个人都有自己的方法，没有绝对正确的方法。

paras.en: There’s no love lost between Stallone and Winkler in recent years. Sly resents the fact that Winkler retains full ownership of the Rocky franchise and that he doesn’t have a piece of the pie to leave for his family. Did you and Farrelly ever discuss planting that seed of acrimony for where their relationship would end up?
paras.zh: 近年来，史泰龙和温克勒之间并没有失去爱情。斯莱对温克勒保留了《洛奇》系列的全部所有权并且没有给家人留下一块蛋糕感到不满。你和法雷利有没有讨论过为他们的关系的结局播下尖刻的种子？

paras.en: Producers are observers. They are there to eliminate risk, put out fires and make sure that the art happens. Sometimes, they have to guide it and have their influence, but that’s what they are. Bob Chartoff and Irwin Winkler were the greatest producers and the ultimate backstop to any ball getting past the catcher. So that’s what I had to deal with in my role.
paras.zh: 生产者是观察者。他们的职责是消除风险、扑灭火灾并确保艺术得以实现。有时，他们必须引导它并发挥影响力，但这就是他们的本质。鲍勃·查托夫（Bob Chartoff）和欧文·温克勒（Irwin Winkler）是最伟大的生产者，也是任何球越过捕手的终极后盾。这就是我在角色中必须处理的问题。

paras.en: The first time you meet my character, he’s all business. He’s not mean to Sly, but he just doesn’t look the part for the role being cast. But then he’s intrigued by this smart guy sitting in front of him, and then they eventually read his scripts to see that there’s talent there. At first, Winkler believes in the project, and then he learns to believe in the person behind it.
paras.zh: 当你第一次见到我的角色时，他只是在做生意。他对斯莱并不刻薄，但他只是看起来不适合所扮演的角色。但随后他对坐在他面前的这个聪明人感兴趣，然后他们最终阅读了他的剧本，发现其中有才华。起初，温克勒相信这个项目，然后他学会相信项目背后的人。

paras.en: The end of the movie shows the real-life clip of when Rocky won best picture at the 1977 Oscars. Bob Chartoff and Irwin Winkler stood up, and Irwin Winkler immediately grabbed Sylvester Stallone to join them on stage, which is rare. It’s usually just the producers who accept the best picture award.
paras.zh: 电影的结尾展示了《洛奇》获得 1977 年奥斯卡最佳影片奖时的真实片段。鲍勃·查托夫和欧文·温克勒站了起来，欧文·温克勒立即拉着西尔维斯特·史泰龙一起上台，这很少见。通常只有制片人才能获得最佳影片奖。

paras.en: But Winkler grabbed Sylvester Stallone and put his arm around him with such love. It was like, This is my son. I believe in you so much. I mortgaged my house for you. I didn’t just bet on a movie. I bet on a child that I love. It’s the idea that you would do anything for your kids, and like I said, I literally work for my children. The money comes in the door, and it goes right to give them every opportunity to succeed in life.
paras.zh: 但温克勒抓住了西尔维斯特·史泰龙，用手臂充满爱意地搂住了他。就像，这是我的儿子。我非常相信你。我把我的房子抵押给你了。我不只是赌一部电影。我把赌注押在我爱的孩子身上。这是一种你愿意为你的孩子做任何事情的想法，就像我说的，我确实是在为我的孩子工作。金钱进来了，它给了他们一切在生活中取得成功的机会。

paras.en: Whatever the extraneous stuff is between them now, I was meant to portray that period of time in the late ‘70s. I was there to share the message that if you really fucking do the work and you believe in yourself — and then you surround yourself with like-minded people who truly believe in you as well — then anything is possible. Maybe you too will one day win an Oscar. That was a special moment in all of their lives, and that’s what I needed to play and had to play.
paras.zh: 不管他们之间现在有什么无关的事情，我的本意就是描绘 70 年代末的那段时光。我在那里分享的信息是，如果你真的他妈的做这项工作并且你相信自己 - 然后你周围都是志同道合的人，他们也真正相信你 - 那么一切皆有可能。也许有一天你也会赢得奥斯卡奖。那是他们一生中的一个特殊时刻，这就是我需要并且必须扮演的角色。

paras.en: In a perfect world, a clause would kick in after x amount of years so that the original creator receives at least a sliver of the pie. But like you said, Winkler and Chartoff risked their homes on a complete unknown. They also gave him profit participation on the first film, as well as most, if not all, of the future films. So I hate to both-sides the issue, but I really do see both sides here.
paras.zh: 在一个完美的世界中，一个条款将在 x 年后生效，以便原始创建者至少收到一小部分馅饼。但正如你所说，温克勒和查托夫在完全未知的情况下冒着家园的危险。他们还让他参与第一部电影以及大多数（如果不是全部）未来电影的利润参与。所以我讨厌这个问题的双方，但我确实在这里看到了双方。

paras.en: Of course, I thought about all of that and who these people are today and yesterday. But my job was to play that moment in time in which greatness happened. It was a beautiful thing, even if you’re always battling for what you want and going at it. That’s why I have that moment after Winkler found out that Sly and Carl Weathers had never boxed before.
paras.zh: 当然，我想到了所有这些以及这些人今天和昨天是谁。但我的工作是及时演绎伟大事件发生的那一刻。这是一件美好的事情，即使你总是在为自己想要的东西而奋斗并为之奋斗。这就是为什么我在温克勒发现斯莱和卡尔·韦瑟斯以前从未打过拳击之后那一刻。

paras.en: Yeah, Winkler went out and got the world’s greatest boxing choreographer, but then Sly kicked him out. All the script had was Winkler saying, “It’s a boxing movie!” So I said to Peter, “The producer’s job is to put out fires, so he would lose his mind right now. This is a handcuffs-off moment. Let me riff and play a little bit here.” It was a scary moment because it was late at night right before Thanksgiving, and everybody wanted to go home for Thanksgiving. But here I was adding a lot to the scene.
paras.zh: 是的，温克勒出去请了世界上最伟大的拳击编舞，但后来斯莱把他踢了出去。剧本里只有温克勒说：“这是一部拳击电影！”所以我对彼得说：“制片人的工作就是救火，所以他现在会失去理智。这是一个松开手铐的时刻。让我在这里即兴发挥一下。”这是一个可怕的时刻，因为感恩节前的深夜，每个人都想回家过感恩节。但在这里我给场景添加了很多东西。

paras.en: To Peter’s credit, he let me go. I made that line up about The Godfather: “It’s not about the mafia. It’s about a nice Italian family that loves pasta.” Then, because he’s angry, he has to get the fuck out of the room. So I went up the stairs toward the door, and I added the lines about how this “happens to be” a set of stairs and how this “happens to be” a door as he walks out. So you do go at it when you’re making films because you’re passionate about the product.
paras.zh: 值得称赞的是，彼得让我走了。我对《教父》做了这样的台词：“这不是关于黑手党。这是关于一个热爱意大利面的美好意大利家庭。”然后，因为他很生气，他必须离开房间。所以我走上楼梯，朝门口走去，当他走出去时，我添加了一些关于这“恰好是”一组楼梯以及这如何“恰好是”一扇门的台词。所以当你拍电影时你确实会这么做，因为你对产品充满热情。

paras.en: Yeah, the “happens to be” scene is your “hello, college!” scene of this movie. Winkler’s meltdown is rooted in director John G. Avildsen’s position that Rocky isn’t a boxing movie. He made the point that it’s a character study about a guy who “happens to be” a boxer. Plus, it hits close to home because every entertainment journalist has written some version of that “happens to be” line about a story in which the surrounding world is incidental.
paras.zh: 是的，“碰巧”的场景就是你的“你好，大学！”这部电影的场景。温克勒的崩溃源于导演约翰·G·艾维尔森的立场，即《洛奇》不是一部拳击电影。他指出，这是一项关于一个“碰巧是”拳击手的人的性格研究。另外，它切中要害，因为每个娱乐记者都写过“碰巧是”这句台词的某个版本，讲述的是一个故事，其中周围的世界是偶然的。

paras.en: Those improvised lines came from being in the zone. It’s the best when it happens. I also didn’t know that guy was going to ask me to take off his jacket. We were just playing in the moment. They let this little chemistry experiment happen.
paras.zh: 这些临时的台词来自于在这个区域。当它发生的时候就是最好的。我也不知道那个家伙会要求我脱掉他的夹克。我们当时只是在玩。他们让这个小化学实验发生了。

paras.en: The Rocky and Apollo fight is ultimately saved for the closing credits, serving as the punchline to the “happens to be” bit. I Play Rocky is also a character study that happens to have boxing in it.
paras.zh: 洛奇和阿波罗的战斗最终被保留在片尾字幕中，作为“碰巧是”的点睛之笔。 《我玩洛奇》也是一项角色研究，其中恰好有拳击内容。

paras.en: Was that fight always intended for the credits? Or did they realize in the edit that it would make for a great gag?
paras.zh: 这场战斗总是为了片酬吗？或者他们在剪辑中意识到这会成为一个很棒的笑话？

paras.en: It had another great ending as well. Rocky was boxing, and when they called cut, he didn’t want to hear it. Then he was like, “I can go again.” He’d been going and going for 28 days, and then his wife came up to say, “It’s over.” And he was like, “No, no, I can do one more.”And she was like, “No, it’s over. You did it.” I could cry right now just thinking about how they ended it.
paras.zh: It had another great ending as well.洛基正在拳击，当他们叫停时，他不想听。 Then he was like, “I can go again.”他一直这样走啊走28天，然后他的妻子走过来说：“结束了。”他说，“不，不，我可以再做一个。”而她说，“不，结束了。你做到了。”一想到他们是如何结束这一切的，我现在就想哭。

paras.en: But Anthony’s earlier moment where he was hitting the door as Rocky and going, “It stinks! My life stinks!” — how were we going to top how extraordinary that was? We couldn’t top that. Showing it toward the end also has a beautiful message, so that’s moviemaking. You’re learning and adapting and changing as you’re going.
paras.zh: 但安东尼早期的那一刻，他以洛基的身份敲门，说道：“太臭了！我的生活太臭了！” ——我们怎样才能超越它的非凡之处呢？我们无法超越这一点。在最后展示它也有一个美丽的信息，所以这就是电影制作。你在前进的过程中不断学习、适应和改变。

paras.en: Peter also edits as he’s going, and he knows the movie so well. Like Avildsen in the movie, I would add something, and Peter would be like, “We got it. Cut. Moving on.” And I’d be like, “What do you mean you got it? I only said the line once.” And he was like, “No, no, it’s great.” This is the first movie I saw six weeks after filming it, so I remembered every second of filming. And when some of those moments came up, I was like, He was right. That is great. We didn’t need another angle.
paras.zh: 彼得也在边剪辑边剪辑，他非常了解这部电影。就像电影中的艾维尔森一样，我会添加一些东西，彼得会说，“我们明白了。剪掉。继续。”我会说，“你明白是什么意思？我只说过一次这句话。”他说：“不，不，这太棒了。”这是我拍摄六周后看的第一部电影，所以我记得拍摄的每一秒。当其中一些时刻出现时，我想，他是对的。那太好了。我们不需要另一个角度。

paras.en: If you had to guess, how much of Rocky did Farrelly recreate?
paras.zh: 如果你必须猜的话，法雷利再现了多少洛基？

paras.en: Oh God, if I was going to throw out a number, maybe 26.9 percent. I don’t know. They shot that boxing scene for a week, and that was the longest, most expensive part of the shoot.
paras.zh: 天哪，如果我要抛出一个数字，也许是 26.9%。我不知道。他们花了一周的时间拍摄拳击场景，这是整个拍摄过程中时间最长、成本最高的部分。

paras.en: I wish I could’ve seen Amazon’s response to it ending up in the closing credits.
paras.zh: 我希望我能在片尾字幕中看到亚马逊对此的回应。

paras.en: (Laughs.) Again, to Peter’s credit, he said, “What do we think the best part of the story is?” That’s an amazing thing. The great directors are fearless. They don’t operate from fear. They trust their instincts and their gut. They have great editors too.
paras.zh: （笑）彼得再次说道：“我们认为这个故事最好的部分是什么？”这是一件了不起的事情。伟大的导演都是无所畏惧的。他们的行动并非出于恐惧。他们相信自己的直觉和直觉。他们也有很棒的编辑。

paras.en: Some locations probably don’t exist in the same form anymore, but for places like Rocky’s apartment, did you revisit as many original spots as possible from Rocky?
paras.zh: 有些地点可能不再以相同的形式存在，但对于像洛奇的公寓这样的地方，你是否尽可能多地重访了洛奇的原始地点？

paras.en: We shot at the same apartment he lived in, and it’s still a rough neighborhood to this day. We heard people around the neighborhood say, “Oh my God, this feels just like yesterday.” Some of the same people lived there 50 years ago.
paras.zh: 我们在他住的同一间公寓里拍摄，直到今天，这里仍然是一个简陋的社区。我们听到附近的人说：“天哪，这感觉就像昨天一样。” 50 年前，有些人就住在那里。

paras.en: Then we went to the Rocky Steps [at the Philadelphia Museum of Art], which was amazing. AnnaSophia Robb and I ran up the stairs with Anthony. Then I came back down the stairs, and Tracy Letts was there, so I have the greatest video of me and Tracy Letts running up the stairs together. I have to post it. It’s so beautiful that all these people come from around the world to run up the stairs in their gray sweatsuits. I have another little video of Anthony waiting in line to take a picture next to the statue of Rocky, dressed as Rocky.
paras.zh: 然后我们去了洛基台阶（费城艺术博物馆），那真是太棒了。安娜索菲亚·罗伯、我和安东尼一起跑上楼梯。然后我从楼梯上下来，特雷西·莱茨也在那里，所以我有我和特雷西·莱茨一起跑上楼梯的最精彩的视频。我必须发布它。这里太美了，所有这些来自世界各地的人都穿着灰色运动服跑上楼梯。我还有另一个小视频，安东尼打扮成洛基，在洛基雕像旁边排队拍照。

paras.en: So it was really special to be in Philadelphia. It’s a super-duper city, man. You feel the lunch-pale vibe. We all knew how special this movie is to so many people around the world, and while Sylvester, Irwin Winkler and SteadiCam creator Garrett Brown are still alive, we didn’t want to let them down. We truly felt that way.
paras.zh: 所以来到费城真的很特别。这是一个超级城市，伙计。你感受到午餐的苍白氛围。我们都知道这部电影对世界各地的许多人来说有多么特别，虽然西尔维斯特、欧文·温克勒和斯坦尼康创始人加勒特·布朗还活着，但我们不想让他们失望。我们确实有这样的感觉。

paras.en: Overall, the movie is largely about the power of no. Sly said no to Winkler and Chartoff countless times before he got the deal he thought he wanted at the time. Have you had a chance to say no to something that ultimately proved to be the best decision?
paras.zh: 总的来说，这部电影主要讲述的是“不”的力量。斯莱无数次对温克勒和查托夫说“不”，才得到了他当时认为想要的交易。您是否有机会对最终被证明是最佳决定的事情说不？

paras.en: My whole life is built on not understanding what the word no means. I was supposed to work on Wall Street, but then I decided to walk away to be an actor. I was told, “You can’t be an actor,” and I was like, “Yes, I can.”
paras.zh: 我的一生都建立在不理解“不”这个词的含义之上。我本来应该在华尔街工作，但后来我决定离开去当一名演员。有人告诉我，“你不能成为一名演员”，我说，“是的，我可以。”

paras.en: To me, no just means not now, and my whole life is built on that premise. Nothing is impossible. That’s why I love the movie business, and that’s what made Irwin and Bob incredible producers. They didn’t understand the word no either. If something went wrong on a film, they fixed it.
paras.zh: 对我来说，“不”就意味着“现在不”，我的整个生活都建立在这个前提之上。没有什么是不可能的。这就是我热爱电影事业的原因，也是欧文和鲍勃成为令人难以置信的制片人的原因。他们也不明白“不”这个词。如果电影出现问题，他们会修复它。

paras.en: Marty Scorsese talks about this all the time [from his experiences with Winkler]. He says, “All this craziness was happening in the background, and Irwin Winkler never let me know any of it. I was just there to be free and think about the project.” So I wanted to put a little of that into I Play Rocky [when Winkler and Chartoff opt not to tell Sly they’ve mortgaged their homes to keep the movie going].
paras.zh: 马蒂·斯科塞斯（Marty Scorsese）一直在谈论这一点（来自他与温克勒的经历）。他说：“所有这些疯狂的事情都是在幕后发生的，欧文·温克勒从来没有让我知道任何事情。我只是在那里自由地思考这个项目。”所以我想在《我玩洛奇》中加入一些内容（当温克勒和查托夫选择不告诉斯莱他们已经抵押了自己的房子以继续电影的拍摄时）。

paras.en: I’ve always loved movies and shows about the making of famous movies or shows. Of all your other projects, is there one that would make for a compelling behind-the-scenes narrative à la I Play Rocky?
paras.zh: 我一直很喜欢有关著名电影或节目制作的电影和节目。在你所有的其他项目中，有没有一个项目能够像《我玩洛奇》那样，打造引人入胜的幕后故事？

paras.en: Oh, it’d be Coyote vs. Acme. My dear friend, Dave Green, directed it, and the world almost never saw it. It was going to be thrown in a vault because an accountant made a decision. We should always be art over commerce, especially when you’ve chosen to make movies for a living. I had a front row seat to what Dave went through, and he was so classy through the whole process.
paras.zh: 哦，那就是 Coyote 与 Acme 的比赛。我亲爱的朋友戴夫·格林执导了这部电影，但世人几乎从未见过它。因为会计师做出了决定，所以它将被扔进金库。我们应该始终将艺术置于商业之上，尤其是当你选择以拍电影为生时。我坐在前排见证了戴夫的经历，他在整个过程中表现得非常优雅。

paras.en: Another heartbreaking aspect to the story is that [Looney Tunes character voice actor] Eric Bauza just passed away. It’s a bummer. He was a generational talent, and he was also one of the classiest, nicest guys you’ve ever met. It just kills me. He has an eight-year-old kid and a fiancée. He literally stood up for the movie while presenting at an award show and said, “Release Coyote vs. Acme!” He said that to the corporation that paid him all his money and fed him because he voiced Looney Tunes characters.
paras.zh: 这个故事的另一个令人心碎的方面是[乐一通角色配音演员]埃里克·鲍扎刚刚去世。真是太糟糕了。他是一代天才，也是你见过的最优雅、最友善的人之一。这简直要了我的命。他有一个八岁的孩子和一个未婚妻。他在颁奖典礼上发言时确实为这部电影站了起来，并说道：“释放土狼大战阿克米！”他对那家给他所有钱并养活他的公司说这句话，因为他为乐一通中的角色配音。

paras.en: On set, it was amazing what we did because we had no money. I wasn’t even playing that part [of Acme lawyer, Bill Pelicanos] the week before. They were like, “John Cena is going to do it. Do you want to be a sidekick?” And I was like, “Yes! I want my hair to look exactly like his, and I also want to be bald in a scene.” And they were like, “We can’t afford any of that.” And I was like, “I’m calling in favors for hair.” Everyone was doing favors for everybody on that movie. We believed in the art.
paras.zh: 在片场，我们所做的事情令人惊奇，因为我们没有钱。一周前我什至没有扮演[Acme律师比尔·佩里卡诺斯]的角色。他们的反应是，“约翰·塞纳会这么做。你想当配角吗？”我当时想，“是的！我希望我的头发看起来和他一模一样，而且我也想在场景中秃头。”他们说，“我们负担不起这些。”我当时想，“我正在呼吁人们帮忙做头发。”在那部电影中，每个人都在为每个人做事。我们相信艺术。

paras.en: It was so meta because it was about fighting big corporations. Everyone was doing that movie for the right reason. So that would truly make for a special behind-the-scenes movie. I also just found out it can get nominated for best animated feature because over 75 percent of the project is animated. I really hope it gets its flowers.
paras.zh: 它是如此元，因为它是关于与大公司作战的。每个人都出于正确的原因拍那部电影。所以这将真正成为一部特殊的幕后电影。我还刚刚发现它可以获得最佳动画长片提名，因为该项目超过 75% 的内容都是动画。我真的希望它能开花。

paras.en: If Babylon got the I Play Rocky treatment, what would the behind the scenes of the “hello, college!” sequence look like?
paras.zh: 如果巴比伦得到了《I Play Rocky》的待遇，那么“你好，大学！”的幕后会是什么样子呢？序列是什么样的？

paras.en: Well, we shot that 10-minute scene over three days. It was one of the greatest, most fun shooting experiences of my life because, once again, Damien let me go. I auditioned during COVID, when you couldn’t be in the room together, and I got a note back from Damien saying, “It feels like you want to really let it go.” At first, I was like, I want to stay close to the lines because this is Damien Chazelle. I’ve never auditioned for him. I love this dude. I want to be in his movie so badly.
paras.zh: 嗯，我们花了三天时间拍摄了那个 10 分钟的场景。这是我一生中最伟大、最有趣的拍摄经历之一，因为达米安再一次放走了我。我在新冠疫情期间进行了试镜，当时你们不能一起在房间里，我收到了达米安的回信，上面写着：“感觉你真的想放手。”起初，我想，我想靠近队伍，因为这是达米安·查泽雷(Damien Chazelle)。我从未为他试镜。我爱这个家伙。我非常想出演他的电影。

paras.en: But once he said, “Go,” I added so many horrible things. Then I handed it in, and 20 minutes later, I got the call that I got the part. When I showed up on set, I saw that the lines I had added were in the movie, and that’s when I knew I was going to riff even more. Damien ended up letting everybody play.
paras.zh: 但一旦他说“走”，我就添加了很多可怕的东西。然后我就交了，20分钟后，我接到电话说我收到了这个零件。当我出现在片场时，我看到我添加的台词在电影中，那时我知道我要重复更多。达米安最终让每个人都玩。

paras.en: My close-ups were on the last day, and I had basically already lost my voice. It ended up being gone for a month. But something came out of me that day to make it all happen. When I did the first take of my close-up, they were like, “Great. That was amazing. We got it.” But I was like, “Let’s keep going. I have four more ideas. I’m going to lose my voice. I want to get it all.” We still had a game left to play, and I didn’t want to celebrate yet.
paras.zh: 我的特写是最后一天，我基本上已经失声了。结果一个月就不见了。但那天我身上的某种力量让这一切发生了。当我第一次拍摄特写镜头时，他们说：“太棒了。太棒了。我们做到了。”但我当时想，“让我们继续吧。我还有四个想法。我要失去我的声音了。我想得到这一切。”我们还有一场比赛要打，我还不想庆祝。

paras.en: Everybody knew how special and spectacular that scene was, and everyone was cheering for everybody when it was their take. Those special days also had moments in the zone. I was able to be conscious of how amazing this was and still deliver new stuff.
paras.zh: 每个人都知道那个场景是多么特别和壮观，当每个人都在为自己的镜头欢呼时。那些特殊的日子也有在该区域的时刻。我能够意识到这是多么令人惊奇，并且仍然提供新的东西。

paras.en: Did they actually keep the stage extra warm given the nature of the scene?
paras.zh: 考虑到场景的性质，他们真的让舞台变得格外温暖吗？

paras.en: I mean, it was hot, but that was mostly just incredible makeup. They put this gel on your head that looks like sweat. Those were three days of magic, man. Damien had a big board of all the shots he wanted, and we just checked them off as we went. It was awesome.
paras.zh: 我的意思是，天气很热，但这主要是令人难以置信的化妆。他们把这种凝胶放在你的头上，看起来像汗水。那真是神奇的三天，伙计。达米恩（Damien）有一个大板子，里面有他想要的所有镜头，我们只是边走边核对它们。太棒了。

paras.en: What about The Wolf of Wall Street? How would you dramatize one of those days?
paras.zh: 《华尔街之狼》怎么样？你会如何戏剧化那些日子？

paras.en: That was an amazing brotherhood. I’m still friends with so many of those guys. Jon Bernthal lived across the hall from me. Kenny Choi lived downstairs. Brian Sacca and Ethan Suplee were also close, and we had a blast. We knew how powerful that story was.
paras.zh: 那是一段了不起的兄弟情谊。我仍然和很多这样的人是朋友。乔·博恩瑟住在我对面的大厅里。肯尼·崔住在楼下。 Brian Sacca 和 Ethan Suplee 也很亲近，我们玩得很开心。我们知道这个故事有多么强大。

paras.en: Leo sometimes likes to stay in character, but he joked, “If I stayed in character this whole time, I would have a nervous breakdown.” So we got the real Leo. We got to bro out with a buddy. He’s the man of our times. He’s the great actor. He’s charming. He’s the best storyteller. He wanted us all to have a great time. He was also producing, so he made sure that we met the real Jordan Belfort and learned how to sell from the guy. The idea was that we needed to really see who this guy is and how these people truly operate.
paras.zh: Leo有时喜欢保持角色，但他开玩笑说：“如果我一直保持角色，我会精神崩溃。”这样我们就得到了真正的狮子座。我们得和一个朋友一起出去玩。他是我们这个时代的风云人物。他是一位伟大的演员。他很迷人。他是最好的讲故事的人。他希望我们大家都度过愉快的时光。他同时也在制作，所以他确保我们见到了真正的乔丹·贝尔福特，并向他学习了如何销售。我们的想法是，我们需要真正了解这个人是谁以及这些人如何真正运作。

paras.en: As I mentioned earlier, the greatness of Marty is that he let us all riff and play. So I riffed with Jonah [Hill] and Leo, and that was another magical experience because I probably made up 80 percent of the lines I said in that movie. Marty was always like, “It’s too clean. Mess it up. Go.”
paras.zh: 正如我之前提到的，马蒂的伟大之处在于他让我们所有人即兴发挥。所以我和乔纳·希尔（Jonah Hill）和利奥（Leo）即兴表演，那是另一种神奇的经历，因为我在那部电影中所说的台词可能有 80% 都是我编的。马蒂总是说，“太干净了。把它弄乱。走吧。”

paras.en: When I auditioned, I used my finance degree to make up my own monologue, and Marty knew it. So he memorized it and read it back to me. I was like, This is the greatest day of my life. Then, on the first day of rehearsal, Marty and Leo asked me questions about finance. I was like, I can’t believe I’m sitting here answering their finance questions. This is crazy. Am I an actor? Am I a consultant? What is happening?
paras.zh: 当我试镜时，我用我的金融学位来编造自己的独白，马蒂知道这一点。所以他记下来并读给我听。我当时想，这是我一生中最伟大的一天。然后，在排练的第一天，马蒂和利奥问了我有关财务的问题。我当时想，我不敢相信我坐在这里回答他们的财务问题。这太疯狂了。我是演员吗？我是顾问吗？怎么了？

paras.en: Years from now, when you write your memoir, how will you sum up the 2026 chapter?
paras.zh: 多年后，当你写回忆录时，你会如何总结2026年的章节？

paras.en: “He was the hardest working person on the set, and he was always classy.” The title of the biography should be P.J. Byrne: Over the Shoulder and Out of Focus.
paras.zh: “他是片场最努力的人，而且总是很优雅。”传记的标题应该是 P.J. Byrne: Over the Shoulder and Out of Focus。

paras.en: I Play Rocky is now playing in movie theaters nationwide.
paras.zh: 《我玩洛奇》现已在全国电影院上映。

articles.title: Bassam Tariq Says Marvel’s Scrapped ‘Blade’ Reboot Taught Him “Life’s Too Short to Make Sh** Films”
articles.author: McKinley Franklin

paras.en: Bassam Tariq is opening up about what he learned working on Marvel‘s scrapped Blade reboot.
paras.zh: 巴萨姆·塔里克（Bassam Tariq）公开了他在漫威废弃的《刀锋战士》重启工作中学到的东西。

paras.en: In an interview with The New Arab published Friday, the Your Mother Your Mother Your Mother director was asked what his time working in the “studio system” taught him about how he wants to approach filmmaking. Tariq said it felt “dangerous” to begin casting without “a proper script,” and that he prefers to “have full control over my script.”
paras.zh: 在周五出版的《新阿拉伯》采访中，这位《你妈妈你妈妈你妈妈》导演被问及他在“工作室系统”工作的时间教会了他如何进行电影制作。塔里克表示，在没有“合适的剧本”的情况下开始选角感觉“危险”，他更喜欢“完全控制我的剧本”。

paras.en: “It was funny and strange to start casting and building without a proper script. You’re sitting there and explaining to actors what their role will be, and they just have to believe you,” he said. “That’s also very dangerous because if the text comes and it doesn’t add up to what you were saying, your credibility gets completely shot. All I have is my integrity, and I’ve been thinking about that a lot.”
paras.zh: “在没有合适的剧本的情况下开始选角和制作是很有趣和奇怪的。你坐在那里向演员解释他们的角色是什么，他们只需要相信你，”他说。 “这也非常危险，因为如果收到的短信与你所说的不相符，你的可信度就会完全受到打击。我所拥有的就是我的正直，我一直在思考这一点。”

paras.en: In 2021, it was reported that Tariq was attached to helm Marvel’s Blade film; Mahershala Ali was announced as the project’s star seven years ago at Comic-Con 2019. The actor confirmed in a July interview with GQ that he would not be leading Blade.
paras.zh: 2021年，有报道称塔里克将执导漫威的《刀锋》电影；马赫沙拉·阿里七年前在 2019 年动漫展上被宣布为该项目的明星。这位演员在 7 月接受《GQ》采访时证实，他不会主演《刀锋战士》。

paras.en: The Hollywood Reporter exclusively reported in September 2022 that Tariq had exited the project, with the director saying in a statement at the time, “It’s been an honor working with the wonderful folks at Marvel. We were able to put together a killer cast and crew. Eager to see where the next director takes the film.”
paras.zh: 《好莱坞报道》于 2022 年 9 月独家报道，塔里克已退出该项目，导演当时在一份声明中表示，“与漫威的优秀人员合作是一种荣幸。我们能够组建一支出色的演员和工作人员。渴望看到下一任导演将这部电影带向何方。”

paras.en: Tariq continued in his interview with The New Arab, “If you’re the bearer of bad news to your actors, but you’re not the one making any of these decisions — and it’s actually coming from a corporate entity — that’s not a great way to be a director. I know some people can take that and run with it, but I learned I was losing credibility with my actors, and it wasn’t a healthy way to operate as a filmmaker.”
paras.zh: 塔里克在接受《新阿拉伯》采访时继续说道，“如果你向你的演员传达坏消息，但你不是做出任何决定的人——而且它实际上来自一个公司实体——那么这不是成为一名导演的好方法。我知道有些人可以接受并接受它，但我知道我正在失去演员的信任，这不是作为一名电影制片人的健康运作方式。”

paras.en: In short, the director said his “big lesson” was that he wanted to have full control of the scripts of his films, noting “life’s too short to make shit films.” Tariq added, “If we disagree, it’s between them and me. It’s quite sad because we had such high hopes for what we wanted to build.”
paras.zh: 简而言之，导演说他的“重要教训”是他想完全控制自己的电影剧本，并指出“生命太短，不能拍烂电影”。塔里克补充道，“如果我们意见不一致，那是他们和我之间的事情。这很令人难过，因为我们对我们想要建造的东西抱有很高的期望。”

paras.en: Ali said in a September interview with GQ that he agrees the failed film is Kevin Feige’s “biggest failure.”
paras.zh: 阿里在 9 月份接受《GQ》采访时表示，他同意这部失败的电影是凯文·费奇“最大的失败”。

paras.en: When asked why the film didn’t happen with the interviewer, the Oscar winner said, “That’s a Kevin Feige question.” He continued, “They had, as you said, a two-time Oscar-winning actor under contract and you got billions of dollars. That’s a question for them. I don’t mean anything personal to you, but I don’t know why it didn’t. To this day, I don’t know why it didn’t happen. I just know that it was — Kevin, he said it was the biggest failure of his career and I agree.”
paras.zh: 当被问及为什么这部电影没有与采访者进行对话时，这位奥斯卡奖得主说：“这是凯文·费奇的问题。”他继续说道，“正如你所说，他们与一位两届奥斯卡奖得主的演员签订了合同，而你却获得了数十亿美元。这是他们的问题。我对你没有任何个人的意思，但我不知道为什么没有发生。直到今天，我不知道为什么它没有发生。我只知道那是——凯文，他说这是他职业生涯中最大的失败，我同意。”

articles.title: Under Pressure From Struggling Members, SAG-AFTRA Vows to Advocate for Universal Healthcare
articles.author: Katie Kilkenny

paras.en: Actors have become increasingly vocal in recent months about their struggles amid the slowdown in production of film and television shows, drawing attention to performers’ hardships in qualifying for their union health plan and even paying their dues.
paras.zh: 近几个月来，演员们越来越多地表达自己在电影和电视节目制作放缓中的挣扎，引起人们对演员在获得工会健康计划资格甚至缴纳会费方面的困难的关注。

paras.en: Facing pressure and online criticism to do something more for floundering members, on Friday the actors’ union SAG-AFTRA announced that its national board had voted unanimously to create a public policy-focused task force to advocate for universal healthcare. The group’s new President’s Healthcare Task Force will “mobilize SAG-AFTRA’s collective strength, public influence, and institutional capacity to advance universal access to affordable, comprehensive, and reliable health care,” the union stated.
paras.zh: 面对压力和网络批评，要求为陷入困境的成员采取更多措施，演员工会 SAG-AFTRA 周五宣布，其全国委员会一致投票决定成立一个以公共政策为重点的工作组，以倡导全民医疗保健。该联盟表示，该组织新成立的总统医疗保健工作组将“动员 SAG-AFTRA 的集体力量、公众影响力和机构能力，以促进普遍获得负担得起的、全面的和可靠的医疗保健”。

paras.en: According to union president Sean Astin, the SAG-AFTRA Health Plan is on strong financial footing but “a subsantial majority of our members do not qualify” by either not earning the requisite minimum of $28,090 or working 108 applicable days per year.
paras.zh: 工会主席 Sean Astin 表示，SAG-AFTRA 健康计划拥有强大的财务基础，但“我们绝大多数会员不符合资格”，因为他们要么没有赚取最低 28,090 美元的最低工资，要么每年工作 108 天。

paras.en: “This Taskforce seeks a new level of participation in the national movement to expand care for everyone,” Astin added. “We will actively engage with policymakers, gather allies and provide a structured way for our members to participate formally in the process. The President’s Healthcare Taskforce will be an instrument of support in the movement for universal healthcare. The President’s Healthcare Taskforce will be an instrument of support in the movement for universal healthcare.”
paras.zh: 阿斯汀补充道：“该工作组寻求在全国运动中的参与达到新的水平，以扩大对每个人的照顾。” “我们将积极与政策制定者接触，聚集盟友，并为我们的成员提供一种结构化的方式来正式参与这一进程。总统的医疗保健工作组将成为全民医疗保健运动的支持工具。总统的医疗保健工作组将成为全民医疗保健运动的支持工具。”

paras.en: It’s a step, though far from a quick-fix solution to the problems that members have grown louder about in recent weeks. In late October, American Horror Story and Glee actor Cheyenne Jackson launched the “One Job Away” campaign to draw attention to actors in need of one or a few more jobs to qualify for health insurance. “This is systematic. This is like across the whole swath of SAG actors working right now,” he told The Hollywood Reporter at the time.
paras.zh: 这是一个步骤，尽管远非解决近几周成员们呼声越来越高的问题的快速解决方案。十月下旬，《美国恐怖故事》和《欢乐合唱团》演员夏延·杰克逊发起了“一份工作离开”活动，以吸引需要一份或多份工作以获得健康保险资格的演员的关注。 “这是系统性的。这就像现在所有演员工会的演员一样，”他当时告诉《好莱坞报道》。

paras.en: According to the latest terms the union negotiated with studios and streamers earlier this year, aimed at addressing healthcare inflation, eligibility premiums and the earnings threshold for health insurance will rise slightly in 2027, with more increases coming in the years after.
paras.zh: 根据今年早些时候工会与电影公司和流媒体商定的旨在解决医疗保健通胀问题的最新条款，健康保险的资格保费和收入门槛将在 2027 年小幅提高，并在随后的几年中进一步提高。

paras.en: Some members have also recently faulted the labor group for dropping its COVID-era policy of keeping performers who were behind on their dues in the union. As of Nov. 1, SAG-AFTRA returned to terminating the memberships of actors who owed dues and, according to Variety, thousands have been dropped from the labor group as a result.
paras.zh: 一些成员最近还指责该劳工组织放弃了新冠病毒时代将拖欠会费的表演者留在工会的政策。据 Variety 报道，自 11 月 1 日起，SAG-AFTRA 重新终止了拖欠会费的演员的会员资格，结果导致数千名演员被从劳工组织中除名。

paras.en: As these concerns were developing, its national board extended union staff leader Duncan Crabtree-Ireland’s contract until 2032 on Oct. 24 and reportedly gave him a 15 percent raise, drawing some further scrutiny. Prior to the reported raise, Crabtree-Ireland, whose title has been expanded to deem him the chief executive officer of the union, was already the highest-paid labor leader in Hollywood with a published gross salary of $1,068,535. The union explained at the time, “The extended term provides for added stability and continuity for the union during a time of unprecedented industry disruption.” But some members found the timing insensitive.
paras.zh: 随着这些担忧的加剧，其国家委员会于 10 月 24 日将工会工作人员领导人邓肯·克拉布特里-爱尔兰 (Duncan Crabtree-Ireland) 的合同延长至 2032 年，并据报道给了他 15% 的加薪，引发了一些进一步的审查。在报道加薪之前，克拉布特里-爱尔兰（其头衔已扩大为工会首席执行官）已经是好莱坞收入最高的劳工领袖，公布的总工资为 1,068,535 美元。工会当时解释说：“在前所未有的行业混乱时期，延长任期为工会提供了更多的稳定性和连续性。”但一些成员发现时机不敏感。

paras.en: Once seen as a progressive pipe dream, universal healthcare may be becoming more politically palatable after a midterm election that hinged on affordability concerns and amid rampant healthcare inflation. But achieving it would, to say the least, be politically complex and require immense support from many quarters. Still, at a time of major healthcare challenges across the country, the union can at least point to its advocacy as a form of action.
paras.zh: 一度被视为进步的白日梦的全民医疗保健可能在中期选举之后在政治上变得更加容易接受，而中期选举取决于负担能力问题和猖獗的医疗保健通胀。但至少可以说，实现这一目标在政治上是复杂的，并且需要多方面的大力支持。尽管如此，在全国面临重大医疗保健挑战之际，工会至少可以将其倡导作为一种行动形式。

articles.title: Europe's cyber weak spot is the everyday businesses nobody thought to protect

paras.en: Cyberattacks on refrigerators in French supermarkets in October spurred Swedish chain Coop to act. But it wasn't fast enough.
paras.zh: 10 月份法国超市冰箱遭到网络攻击，促使瑞典连锁店 Coop 采取了行动。但速度还不够快。

paras.en: Attackers hit refrigeration systems in seven of its stores in early November. The affected stores had been scheduled for security upgrades just two days later, a company spokesperson told CNBC.
paras.zh: 11 月初，攻击者袭击了其 7 家商店的制冷系统。公司发言人告诉 CNBC，受影响的商店已计划在两天后进行安全升级。

paras.en: Mundane but essential equipment, used by everyday businesses, has become a favorite target of cyber saboteurs in recent weeks.
paras.zh: 最近几周，日常企业使用的平凡但必不可少的设备已成为网络破坏者最喜欢的目标。

paras.en: Experts are warning that a combination of known vulnerabilities, basic security failures and ambiguity over whether suppliers or their clients are responsible are making things worse, as AI makes cyber threats faster and more sophisticated.
paras.zh: 专家警告说，已知的漏洞、基本的安全故障以及供应商或其客户是否应承担责任的模糊性等综合因素正在使情况变得更糟，因为人工智能使网络威胁变得更快、更复杂。

paras.en: Guy Segal, CEO of cybersecurity firm Sygnia, told CNBC that his company handled 285% more incidents in October than a year earlier, with demand forcing it to turn away some businesses seeking emergency assistance.
paras.zh: 网络安全公司 Sygnia 首席执行官盖伊·西格尔 (Guy Segal) 告诉 CNBC，该公司 10 月份处理的事件比一年前增加了 285%，需求迫使该公司拒绝了一些寻求紧急援助的企业。

paras.en: "It's going to get worse before it's going to get better," Segal said.
paras.zh: “在好转之前，情况会变得更糟，”西格尔说。

paras.en: The recent cyberattacks targeted refrigeration systems across hundreds of European supermarkets, remotely altering temperature settings and forcing retailers to discard spoiled food.
paras.zh: 最近的网络攻击针对数百家欧洲超市的制冷系统，远程改变温度设置并迫使零售商丢弃变质的食物。

paras.en: France has since accused a cyber unit with links to Iran's Revolutionary Guard Corps of the attacks, an allegation Tehran denies.
paras.zh: 此后，法国指责与伊朗革命卫队有联系的一个网络单位发动了这些袭击，但德黑兰否认了这一指控。

paras.en: Fredrik Blix, a cybersecurity researcher at Stockholm University, told CNBC that thousands of industrial control systems remain accessible over the public internet, sometimes despite manufacturers' warnings.
paras.zh: 斯德哥尔摩大学网络安全研究员弗雷德里克·布利克斯 (Fredrik Blix) 告诉 CNBC，尽管制造商发出了警告，但仍有数千个工业控制系统可以通过公共互联网访问。

paras.en: Segal said that basic cyber protection measures such as multi-factor authentication and basic network segmentation are more important than ever.
paras.zh: 西格尔表示，多因素身份验证和基本网络分段等基本网络保护措施比以往任何时候都更加重要。

paras.en: He said risks to major civic infrastructure like the electrical grid were front of mind and so "usually pretty well protected."
paras.zh: 他表示，电网等主要民用基础设施面临的风险是首要考虑因素，因此“通常受到很好的保护”。

paras.en: "There are always those civil supply chain components that are way, way less protected. Could be supermarkets, could be gas stations, could be… the screens on the Tube," Segal said, referring to London's underground rail system.
paras.zh: “总有一些民用供应链组件受到的保护要少得多。可能是超市，可能是加油站，可能是......地铁上的屏幕，”西格尔说，指的是伦敦的地铁系统。

paras.en: The supermarket attacks showed "this is the new normal, and definitely it's a wake-up call for every company out there," Segal added.
paras.zh: 西格尔补充说，超市袭击事件表明“这是新常态，这绝对是对每家公司的警钟”。

paras.en: Segal said that inexpensive AI tools mean technical expertise and resources are no longer needed to launch attacks. He described one recent incident in which clients suffered breaches within six hours of a vulnerability becoming known, as perpetrators used AI to act faster — a process that might have taken weeks a year earlier.
paras.zh: 西格尔表示，廉价的人工智能工具意味着不再需要技术专业知识和资源来发动攻击。他描述了最近发生的一起事件，在该事件中，客户在漏洞曝光后的六小时内就遭受了攻击，因为犯罪者使用人工智能来更快地采取行动——这一过程在一年前可能需要几周的时间。

paras.en: Segal, whose firm helps companies respond to breaches and strengthen their defenses, warned that businesses without prearranged incident-response support could struggle to secure emergency assistance, as overwhelmed cybersecurity firms prioritize existing clients.
paras.zh: 西格尔的公司帮助公司应对违规行为并加强防御，他警告说，没有预先安排的事件响应支持的企业可能难以获得紧急援助，因为不堪重负的网络安全公司会优先考虑现有客户。

paras.en: In one case, he said, Sygnia had to turn down a company because no response teams were available. Segal added that the company in question had already been turned down by ten other providers.
paras.zh: 他说，在一个案例中，Sygnia 不得不拒绝一家公司，因为没有响应团队。西格尔补充说，该公司已被其他十家提供商拒绝。

paras.en: Jacob Silverman, CEO of risk advisory firm Kroll, told CNBC earlier this month that the company was operating at full capacity in its incident-response business amid what he described as "the most rapid uptick in threat activity that we've ever seen."
paras.zh: 风险咨询公司 Kroll 首席执行官雅各布·西尔弗曼 (Jacob Silverman) 本月早些时候向 CNBC 表示，该公司的事件响应业务正在满负荷运营，他将其描述为“我们所见过的威胁活动增长最快的时期”。

paras.en: Segal argued that retailers should treat cybersecurity risks with the same seriousness as fire safety and food hygiene, including when outsourcing maintenance.
paras.zh: 西格尔认为，零售商应该像对待消防安全和食品卫生一样严肃地对待网络安全风险，包括在外包维护时。

paras.en: When Ahold Delhaize stores in Belgium and Luxembourg were attacked on Nov. 2, it exposed how different independent store operators had responded to the warnings following the earlier attacks in France.
paras.zh: 11 月 2 日，比利时和卢森堡的 Ahold Delhaize 商店遭到袭击，这暴露了不同的独立商店经营者如何应对法国早些时候发生的袭击后发出的警告。

paras.en: Retailers had been warned about the vulnerabilities following earlier attacks in France, and those that implemented the recommended protections were spared, CEO Frans Muller told investors in an earnings call earlier this month, but smaller operators with fewer technical resources had struggled to make the necessary changes.
paras.zh: 首席执行官弗兰斯·穆勒(Frans Muller)在本月早些时候的财报电话会议上告诉投资者，继法国早些时候发生的袭击事件后，零售商已收到有关漏洞的警告，而那些实施了建议保护措施的零售商则幸免于难，但技术资源较少的小型运营商却难以做出必要的改变。

paras.en: Coop, whose stores are owned by regional consumer cooperatives or operated by franchises, told CNBC that public attention on the recent attacks was the main driver of security improvements. It said the vulnerability at the affected stores had since been addressed.
paras.zh: Coop 的商店由地区消费者合作社拥有或由特许经营商经营，他告诉 CNBC，公众对最近袭击事件的关注是安全改善的主要推动力。该公司表示，受影响商店的漏洞已得到解决。

paras.en: The financial consequences of cyberattacks can be substantial. Ahold Delhaize told investors in November that a separate October cyberattack on its online operations and supply chain would reduce fourth-quarter sales by 200 million euros ($219 million).
paras.zh: 网络攻击的财务后果可能是巨大的。 Ahold Delhaize 在 11 月份告诉投资者，10 月份对其在线业务和供应链的单独网络攻击将导致第四季度销售额减少 2 亿欧元（2.19 亿美元）。

paras.en: Danish shipping giant Maersk, which suffered an estimated $250 million to $300 million in losses from the 2017 NotPetya cyberattack, has spent nearly a decade strengthening its defenses.
paras.zh: 丹麦航运巨头马士基在 2017 年 NotPetya 网络攻击中遭受了约 2.5 亿至 3 亿美元的损失，该公司花了近十年的时间加强防御。

paras.en: CEO Vincent Clerc told CNBC earlier this month that the experience had prompted significant investment in security capabilities, but warned that AI was enabling attackers to become more effective.
paras.zh: 首席执行官 Vincent Clerc 本月早些时候向 CNBC 表示，这一经历促使人们对安全能力进行了大量投资，但警告称，人工智能正在使攻击者变得更加有效。

paras.en: "Everybody is in a race" to boost defenses, he said.
paras.zh: 他说，“每个人都在竞赛”以加强防御。

paras.en: Research by cybersecurity firm Censys found that the number of internet-exposed refrigeration controllers made by Danfoss and Copeland exposed to cyber hacking fell 53% globally between Oct. 9 and Nov. 5.
paras.zh: 网络安全公司 Censys 的研究发现，10 月 9 日至 11 月 5 日期间，全球范围内遭受网络黑客攻击的丹佛斯和谷轮制造的暴露于互联网的制冷控制器数量下降了 53%。

paras.en: However, more than 3,100 remained exposed, and Censys said it could not determine whether the decline reflected permanent security improvements or equipment simply being taken offline.
paras.zh: 然而，仍有超过 3,100 台设备仍处于暴露状态，Censys 表示，无法确定数量下降是否反映了永久性安全改进或设备只是被下线。

paras.en: A Copeland spokesperson confirmed that some of its refrigeration systems were affected by the vulnerability and said it had contacted customers to reinforce cybersecurity guidance, including keeping devices off the public internet and updating software.
paras.zh: 谷轮发言人证实，其部分制冷系统受到该漏洞的影响，并表示已联系客户以加强网络安全指导，包括使设备远离公共互联网和更新软件。

paras.en: Danfoss didn't respond to CNBC requests for comment.
paras.zh: 丹佛斯没有回应 CNBC 的置评请求。

paras.en: In the U.K., a covert cybersecurity operation has been underway to protect tens of thousands of refrigeration systems at supermarkets, warehouses, restaurants and other businesses, the BBC reported on Friday. After researchers discovered a major vulnerability in late October, cybersecurity specialists, IT teams and the U.K.'s National Cyber Security Centre worked to alert dozens of companies and secure their systems before hackers could exploit the flaw.
paras.zh: 据英国广播公司周五报道，英国正在进行一项秘密网络安全行动，以保护超市、仓库、餐馆和其他企业的数万个制冷系统。研究人员于 10 月底发现一个重大漏洞后，网络安全专家、IT 团队和英国国家网络安全中心努力向数十家公司发出警报，并在黑客利用该漏洞之前保护其系统。

paras.en: The EU's Cyber Resilience Act will also impose stricter security requirements on manufacturers of connected products from December 2027.
paras.zh: 自 2027 年 12 月起，欧盟《网络弹性法案》还将对互联产品制造商提出更严格的安全要求。

paras.en: But the legislation does not require all existing equipment to be made compliant with the new standards.
paras.zh: 但立法并不要求所有现有设备都符合新标准。

paras.en: Blix told CNBC on Nov. 6 that European authorities should take a more proactive approach to reducing vulnerabilities by identifying exposed industrial control systems and contacting their operators before attacks occur.
paras.zh: Blix 于 11 月 6 日向 CNBC 表示，欧洲当局应采取更主动的方法来减少漏洞，识别暴露的工业控制系统并在攻击发生前联系其运营商。

paras.en: "What worries me is that we don't really do anything," he said, adding that "we are shuffling a lot of papers" and "doing a lot of risk assessments" but failing to take meaningful action.
paras.zh: “令我担心的是，我们并没有真正采取任何行动，”他说，并补充说，“我们正在整理大量文件”并“进行大量风险评估”，但未能采取有意义的行动。

articles.title: An early breakdown in the polar vortex is threatening already depleted gas stocks

paras.en: An unprecedented early breakdown of the stratospheric polar vortex and a record-breaking El Niño event has put energy traders on alert this winter, with analysts warning the weather and climate phenomena could have an outsized impact on Europe.
paras.zh: 平流层极地涡旋史无前例的早期崩溃和破纪录的厄尔尼诺事件使能源交易商在今年冬天保持警惕，分析师警告天气和气候现象可能对欧洲产生巨大影响。

paras.en: Meteorologists are currently observing a record early breakdown of the polar vortex, a large-scale circulation of strong winds that typically keeps extremely cold air over the North Pole.
paras.zh: 气象学家目前正在观察创纪录的极涡早期崩溃，这是一种大规模的强风环流，通常会使北极上空保持极冷的空气。

paras.en: Changes in the strength and shape of the polar vortex can influence weather patterns much lower down in the atmosphere, potentially bringing in colder weather to parts of Europe and North America.
paras.zh: 极涡强度和形状的变化可能会影响大气层下部的天气模式，可能会给欧洲和北美部分地区带来更冷的天气。

paras.en: This year, however, the collapse of the stratospheric polar vortex, or SPV, is taking place at the same time as an unusually powerful El Niño, a climate event that can boost global temperatures and disrupt rainfall.
paras.zh: 然而今年，平流层极地涡旋（SPV）的崩溃与异常强大的厄尔尼诺现象同时发生，厄尔尼诺现象是一种可能导致全球气温升高并扰乱降雨的气候事件。

paras.en: The collision of these two events raises the risk of a prolonged cold spell that could lift heating demand and force European countries to draw down already-low reserves faster. That would leave the continent more reliant on imported liquefied natural gas (LNG) at a time when supplies from the Middle East are disrupted.
paras.zh: 这两个事件的碰撞增加了长期寒流的风险，这可能会提高供暖需求，并迫使欧洲国家更快地动用本已较低的储备。在中东供应中断之际，这将使非洲大陆更加依赖进口液化天然气（LNG）。

paras.en: To be sure, Europe's natural gas storage levels started the winter at their lowest level in more than a decade.
paras.zh: 可以肯定的是，欧洲的天然气储存水平在入冬之初就处于十多年来的最低水平。

paras.en: The International Energy Agency warned earlier this month that low European storage levels and limited storage options in several LNG-importing countries in Asia and South America could intensify the competition for cargoes and put upward pressure on prices during periods of high demand.
paras.zh: 国际能源署本月早些时候警告称，欧洲存储水平较低以及亚洲和南美洲几个液化天然气进口国的存储选择有限，可能会加剧货物竞争，并在需求旺盛期间给价格带来上行压力。

paras.en: Simon Lee, a lecturer in atmospheric science at the U.K.'s University of St Andrews, said the combination of a sudden stratospheric warming (SSW) with an El Niño event is not necessarily unusual, but meteorologists had been expecting a polar vortex breakdown in February — not as early as November.
paras.zh: 英国圣安德鲁斯大学大气科学讲师西蒙·李 (Simon Lee) 表示，平流层突然变暖 (SSW) 与厄尔尼诺事件的结合并不一定不寻常，但气象学家一直预计极地涡旋会在 2 月份破裂，而不是早在 11 月份。

paras.en: The early SPV disruption is an "extremely rare" event that could influence winter weather in northwest Europe and the eastern U.S., Lee said, increasing the chance of colder conditions although likely not to the extent that a polar vortex event caused parts of Niagara Falls to partially freeze in January 2014.
paras.zh: 李说，早期的 SPV 中断是一种“极其罕见”的事件，可能会影响欧洲西北部和美国东部的冬季天气，增加出现寒冷天气的可能性，尽管可能不会达到 2014 年 1 月极地涡旋事件导致尼亚加拉瀑布部分地区部分结冰的程度。

paras.en: "Geopolitics and weather are the two key volatility drives for energy and now they seem to be happening at the same time — and that's always the biggest risk for markets," Florence Schmit, senior energy strategist at Rabobank, told CNBC.
paras.zh: 荷兰合作银行高级能源策略师弗洛伦斯·施密特 (Florence Schmit) 告诉 CNBC：“地缘政治和天气是能源波动的两个关键驱动因素，现在它们似乎同时发生，而这始终是市场面临的最大风险。”

paras.en: For months, meteorologists expected an El Niño event would result in a milder winter in Europe and relatively muted heating demand, Schmit said, which was broadly seen as welcome news given ongoing concerns over the continent's tight regional supplies for gas and crude oil.
paras.zh: 施密特表示，几个月来，气象学家预计厄尔尼诺现象将导致欧洲冬季气候温和，供暖需求相对减弱，鉴于人们对欧洲大陆天然气和原油供应紧张的持续担忧，这被广泛视为好消息。

paras.en: The prospect of a colder-than-expected winter due to an early breakdown of the polar vortex could be "incredibly difficult" for Europe to navigate, Schmit warned. She noted that the region's gas storages have seen "very, very strong withdrawals" over the last two weeks, "which is quite unusual for this time of year."
paras.zh: 施密特警告说，由于极地涡旋提前崩溃，冬季可能比预期更冷，这对欧洲来说可能会“极其困难”。她指出，过去两周该地区的天然气储存量“非常非常强劲”，“这在一年中的这个时候是很不寻常的”。

paras.en: "If you continue to see the same storage withdrawals over the next couple of months, that means energy prices will spike again — and they won't spike because of geopolitics. This time it will be the weather driving that spike and that volatility," Schmit said.
paras.zh: “如果在接下来的几个月里继续看到同样的存储提款，这意味着能源价格将再次飙升——而且它们不会因为地缘政治而飙升。这一次将是天气推动价格上涨和波动，”施密特说。

paras.en: European gas prices have soared to levels not seen since the 2022 energy crisis in recent weeks, notching 103.9 euros ($113.99) per megawatt hour in late October. European benchmark Dutch TTF futures for December delivery stood at around 87.28 euros on Friday afternoon.
paras.zh: 最近几周，欧洲天然气价格飙升至 2022 年能源危机以来的最高水平，10 月底达到每兆瓦时 103.9 欧元（113.99 美元）。周五下午，12 月交割的欧洲基准荷兰 TTF 期货价格约为 87.28 欧元。

paras.en: "We have never seen an early breakdown of the polar vortex and a super el Nino in the same winter so we have no historical precedent on how this will impact global gas demand," David Lewis, principal research analyst of gas and liquified natural gas at Wood Mackenzie, told CNBC by email.
paras.zh: 伍德麦肯兹天然气和液化天然气首席研究分析师戴维·刘易斯（David Lewis）通过电子邮件告诉 CNBC：“我们从未在同一个冬季看到极地涡旋和超级厄尔尼诺现象的早期崩溃，因此我们没有这将如何影响全球天然气需求的历史先例。”

paras.en: El Niño is commonly associated with milder winters, while a SSW event typically leads to colder temperatures and higher snowfall, Lewis said, noting this could materialize in December and January within Europe.
paras.zh: 刘易斯说，厄尔尼诺现象通常与较温和的冬季有关，而南海事件通常会导致气温下降和降雪量增加，并指出这可能会在欧洲的 12 月和 1 月发生。

paras.en: "So far, the start of the European winter heating season has been quite cold but more importantly has seen low wind speeds across Northern Europe," Lewis said.
paras.zh: 刘易斯说：“到目前为止，欧洲冬季供暖季节的开始相当寒冷，但更重要的是北欧各地的风速较低。”

paras.en: "The drawdown in stocks in the first half of November has been amongst the highest on record. With inventories starting the winter at their lowest level on record, any further deterioration in temperatures or wind speeds will have an outsized impact on European balances and lead to higher prices across Europe," he added.
paras.zh: 他补充道：“11月上半月的库存下降幅度是有记录以来最高的。入冬时库存处于有记录以来的最低水平，气温或风速的任何进一步恶化都将对欧洲收支平衡产生巨大影响，并导致整个欧洲的价格上涨。”

articles.title: How China is using summits to expand its global influence

paras.en: SHENZHEN, China — For a second year in a row, Chinese President Xi Jinping has brought Russian President Vladimir Putin together with another major world leader on mainland Chinese shores.
paras.zh: 中国深圳——中国国家主席习近平连续第二年在中国大陆会见了俄罗斯总统弗拉基米尔·普京和另一位世界主要领导人。

paras.en: U.S. President Donald Trump had a trilateral meeting with Xi and Putin on Thursday, after the three met the prior evening during a welcome banquet for the Asia-Pacific Economic Leaders' Meeting in Shenzhen. It marked the first time they had met together in person.
paras.zh: 美国总统唐纳德·特朗普周四与习近平和普京举行了三边会晤，此前三人前一天晚上在深圳举行的亚太经济领导人会议欢迎宴会上进行了会面。这是他们第一次面对面见面。

paras.en: In September 2025, Xi, Putin and Indian Prime Minister Narendra Modi briefly laughed together for a friendly photo-op alongside an annual meeting of the Shanghai Cooperation Organization in Tianjin, China. The gathering followed easing tensions between Beijing and New Delhi.
paras.zh: 2025 年 9 月，习近平、普京和印度总理纳伦德拉·莫迪在中国天津举行的上海合作组织年会上短暂地进行了友好合影。这次聚会是在北京和新德里之间的紧张局势缓和之后举行的。

paras.en: China's "ability to engage directly with the world major powers" reflects the country's influence across the Global South and Eurasia, said Jodie Wen, postdoctoral fellow at the Center for International Security and Strategy at Tsinghua University. "China hopes to play a more constructive role in this conflict-[ridden], unstable world."
paras.zh: 清华大学国际安全与战略中心博士后研究员朱迪·温表示，中国“与世界大国直接接触的能力”反映了该国在南半球和欧亚大陆的影响力。 “中国希望在这个充满冲突、不稳定的世界中发挥更具建设性的作用。”

paras.en: In the future, "China will hope to provide more platforms" within its borders for countries to discuss issues, she said.
paras.zh: 她说，未来，“中国希望在境内提供更多平台”，供各国讨论问题。

paras.en: China has increasingly played the role of broker, for instance, providing the forum for restoring diplomatic ties between Saudi Arabia and Iran in 2023.
paras.zh: 例如，中国越来越多地扮演中间人的角色，为沙特阿拉伯和伊朗在2023年恢复外交关系提供论坛。

paras.en: By participating in and hosting different multilateral organizations, China has stayed in the Western orbit while cultivating relations with non-Western countries. The two photo-ops last year and this year reflect only a portion of Xi's large number of meetings with different world leaders.
paras.zh: 中国通过参加和主办不同的多边组织，在保持西方轨道的同时，发展与非西方国家的关系。去年和今年的两张照片仅反映了习近平与不同世界领导人的大量会晤的一部分。

paras.en: Xi has hosted more than 40 heads of state so far this year, including at least eight around the APEC meetings in Shenzhen this week. That's on top of receiving over 60 state visits in 2025, according to CNBC analysis of official Chinese readouts.
paras.zh: 今年迄今为止，习近平已接待了 40 多位国家元首，其中包括本周在深圳举行的 APEC 会议期间至少接待了 8 位国家元首。根据 CNBC 对中国官方数据的分析，这还不包括 2025 年接待 60 多次国事访问。

paras.en: Domestic Chinese media have highlighted how Xi has met with many foreign leaders around the China-hosted events.
paras.zh: 中国国内媒体重点报道了习近平在中国主办的活动期间会见许多外国领导人的情况。

paras.en: "Beijing sees these multilateral platforms as opportunities to expand its international influence and demonstrate its commitment to multilateralism, while bilateral diplomacy remains equally important," said Yue Su, principal economist for China at EIU.
paras.zh: 经济学人智库中国首席经济学家苏跃表示：“北京将这些多边平台视为扩大其国际影响力和展示其对多边主义承诺的机会，而双边外交仍然同样重要。”

paras.en: But she noted that different countries increasingly pursue different geopolitical and economic priorities, making it challenging to reach consensus even through multilateral organizations.
paras.zh: 但她指出，不同国家越来越多地追求不同的地缘政治和经济优先事项，因此即使通过多边组织也很难达成共识。

paras.en: "Against this backdrop, China's diplomatic priorities are increasingly focused on delivering tangible economic benefits through trade, investment, financial connectivity and technology cooperation," she said.
paras.zh: “在此背景下，中国的外交重点越来越注重通过贸易、投资、金融互联互通和技术合作提供切实的经济利益，”她说。

paras.en: On Thursday, Xi announced at the APEC Economic Leaders' Meeting that China would provide $20 million in support for the Asia Pacific region. He also advocated for the development of an "Asia-Pacific community with a shared future," an iteration of his commonly used slogan on a "shared future" for humanity more broadly.
paras.zh: 周四，习近平在亚太经合组织领导人非正式会议上宣布，中国将向亚太地区提供2000万美元的支持。他还主张发展“亚太命运共同体”，这是他常用的人类“命运共同体”口号的重复。

paras.en: The Shenzhen summit can create meaningful outcomes for crisis management, as well as diplomatic space for future negotiations, Tsinghua University's Wen said. She added that it's important for leaders to come together in person in order to avoid misunderstandings and further tensions.
paras.zh: 清华大学温家宝表示，深圳峰会可以为危机管理创造有意义的成果，并为未来谈判提供外交空间。她补充说，领导人亲自聚在一起很重要，以避免误解和进一步的紧张局势。

paras.en: Trump said Thursday at the trilateral that the U.S., China and Russia are "uniquely positioned" to discuss reducing nuclear weapons at their historic meeting. A Chinese readout subsequently said the three leaders discussed Ukraine, the Middle East and the Korean Peninsula.
paras.zh: 特朗普周四在三边会议上表示，美国、中国和俄罗斯处于“独特的地位”，可以在历史性会议上讨论削减核武器问题。中国随后发布的消息称，三位领导人讨论了乌克兰、中东和朝鲜半岛问题。

paras.en: —CNBC's Matthew Tan contributed to this report.
paras.zh: —CNBC 的 Matthew Tan 对本报告做出了贡献。

articles.title: Dueling claims of Riemann hypothesis proofs emerge

paras.en: The latest explosion in the “mathocalypse,” like many before it, is already igniting controversy just hours after it happened.
paras.zh: 与之前的许多爆炸一样，“数学灾难”的最新爆炸在发生数小时后就已经引发了争议。

paras.en: This morning Anthropic employee Levent Alpöge posted a Claude-generated proof that he claimed solved the Riemann hypothesis, the most famous open problem in all of mathematics, using a large language model. The claim goes even further, stating that the proof has resolved the much stronger and harder generalized Riemann hypothesis.
paras.zh: 今天早上，Anthropic 员工 Levent Alpöge 发布了克劳德生成的证明，声称他使用大型语言模型解决了黎曼假设，这是所有数学中最著名的开放问题。这种说法甚至更进一步，指出证明已经解决了更强、更难的广义黎曼假设。

paras.en: But now two top mathematicians are saying that a human may have produced just such a proof months ago, purportedly without any assistance from artificial intelligence. Such a proof would be the most remarkable mathematical achievement in decades, all the more notable for being accomplished by a person amid the ongoing AI arms race to conquer math. But the proof has not actually been verified by anyone—and other mathematicians are already expressing skepticism of its validity.
paras.zh: 但现在两位顶尖数学家表示，人类可能在几个月前就得出了这样的证明，据称没有人工智能的任何帮助。这样的证明将是几十年来最引人注目的数学成就，更值得注意的是，它是由一个在正在进行的人工智能军备竞赛中征服数学的人完成的。但这个证明实际上还没有得到任何人的验证——其他数学家已经对其有效性表示怀疑。

paras.en: If you're enjoying this article, consider supporting our award-winning journalism by subscribing. By purchasing a subscription you are helping to ensure the future of impactful stories about the discoveries and ideas shaping our world today.
paras.zh: 如果您喜欢这篇文章，请考虑通过订阅来支持我们屡获殊荣的新闻报道。通过购买订阅，您将有助于确保有关塑造当今世界的发现和想法的影响力故事的未来。

paras.en: The human claim was posted by Ravi Vakil, president of the American Mathematical Society and a mathematician at Stanford University. He said in blog post on Friday that the prover was Alessandro Masullo, a young mathematician, also at Stanford. According to the post, the proof was in the hands of Brian Conrad, a Stanford mathematician and an expert on the subject, who has been giving Masullo feedback over the past few months. Conrad has confirmed to Scientific American that the details of the blog post are true.
paras.zh: 人类的说法是由美国数学会主席、斯坦福大学数学家拉维·瓦基尔（Ravi Vakil）发布的。他在周五的博客文章中表示，证明者是同样来自斯坦福大学的年轻数学家亚历山德罗·马苏洛 (Alessandro Masullo)。根据这篇文章，证据掌握在斯坦福大学数学家、该领域专家布莱恩·康拉德 (Brian Conrad) 手中，他在过去几个月里一直在向马苏洛提供反馈。康拉德已向《科学美国人》证实该博文的细节是真实的。

paras.en: Asked directly whether he thinks Masullo’s work will prove valid, Conrad says more work is needed. “To judge the success of the method requires the paper to reach a stage of more final revision,” he says. “It’s undergoing major revision.”
paras.zh: 当被直接问及他认为马苏洛的工作是否有效时，康拉德表示还需要做更多的工作。 “要判断该方法是否成功，需要论文达到更最终修改的阶段，”他说。 “它正在进行重大修改。”

paras.en: As to why the decision was made to post Masullo’s work, Conrad says the choice was between “two unpalatable options”: either announce it now, as was done via Vakil’s blog post, or “remain silent and let a period of time go by, only to post something later.”
paras.zh: 至于为什么决定发布 Masullo 的作品，康拉德表示，这是在“两个令人不快的选择”之间做出的选择：要么像瓦基尔的博客文章那样立即宣布，要么“保持沉默，等待一段时间，然后再发布一些东西。”

paras.en: Editor’s Note (11/20/26): This is a developing story and will be updated.
paras.zh: 编者注（11/20/26）：这是一个正在发展的故事，将会更新。

articles.title: The AI Riemann hypothesis proof is almost certainly true, independent mathematicians attest

paras.en: Mathematicians are now almost certain the earth-shattering artificial-intelligence-created proof of the Riemann hypothesis is real.
paras.zh: 数学家们现在几乎可以肯定，人工智能创造的黎曼假设的惊天动地的证明是真实的。

paras.en: This morning Anthropic mathematician Levent Alpöge claimed to have used the company’s Claude AI model to solve the Riemann problem, perhaps the most important open quandary in mathematics. The hypothesis, first posed in 1859 by mathematician Bernhard Riemann, suggests that a hidden pattern underlies the distribution of the prime numbers—those numbers that are divisible only by themselves and 1.
paras.zh: 今天早上，人择数学家 Levent Alpöge 声称已经使用该公司的 Claude AI 模型解决了黎曼问题，这可能是数学中最重要的开放难题。该假说由数学家伯恩哈德·黎曼 (Bernhard Riemann) 于 1859 年首次提出，认为素数分布背后隐藏着一种隐藏模式，这些素数只能被它们本身和 1 整除。

paras.en: If you're enjoying this article, consider supporting our award-winning journalism by subscribing. By purchasing a subscription you are helping to ensure the future of impactful stories about the discoveries and ideas shaping our world today.
paras.zh: 如果您喜欢这篇文章，请考虑通过订阅来支持我们屡获殊荣的新闻报道。通过购买订阅，您将有助于确保有关塑造当今世界的发现和想法的影响力故事的未来。

paras.en: Now researchers have verified that the proof does seem to do what Alpöge claims. Alpöge initially checked the work by writing out the proof using the programming language Lean; if a Lean-coded proof compiles error-free, this is usually taken as confirmation that the logic and math in each step is correct.
paras.zh: 现在研究人员已经证实，该证据似乎确实符合 Alpöge 所声称的那样。 Alpöge 最初通过使用 Lean 编程语言写出证明来检查工作；如果精益编码证明编译无错误，这通常被视为确认每个步骤中的逻辑和数学是正确的。

paras.en: But some questions remained. For instance, does the proof really address the Riemann hypothesis, or does it establish a subtly different point or idea? “The first question which one has to ask when judging a PDF which comes with some Lean code is: ‘what is the statement of the theorem in the Lean code, and does this correspond to the actual theorem statement,’” explained mathematician Kevin Buzzard of Imperial College London in a blog post.
paras.zh: 但仍然存在一些问题。例如，这个证明是否真正解决了黎曼假设，或者它是否建立了一个略有不同的观点或想法？ “在判断带有精益代码的 PDF 时，人们必须问的第一个问题是：‘精益代码中的定理陈述是什么，这是否对应于实际的定理陈述，’”伦敦帝国理工学院的数学家 Kevin Buzzard 在一篇博客文章中解释道。

paras.en: A second question was whether the Lean code would successfully compile for other mathematicians. Independent researchers, including Andrew Sutherland, a mathematician at the Massachusetts Institute of Technology, have now separately compiled Alpöge’s result in Lean without issues.
paras.zh: 第二个问题是精益代码是否可以为其他数学家成功编译。包括麻省理工学院数学家安德鲁·萨瑟兰在内的独立研究人员现在已经在精益中单独编译了 Alpöge 的结果，没有出现任何问题。

paras.en: “The Lean proof has been compiled and independently rechecked by the Lean kernel with only the three standard axioms,” Sutherland says. “Honestly the chance that anything is fishy here is approximately zero.”
paras.zh: “精益证明已经由精益内核仅使用三个标准公理进行了编译和独立重新检查，”萨瑟兰说。 “老实说，这里出现任何可疑情况的可能性几乎为零。”

paras.en: Researchers are still making sure that the proof does not include any hack, dodge or shortcut that changed the meaning of the initial hypothesis or any other mathematical rules or truths. This process, called a “comparator run,” typically takes a matter of hours.
paras.zh: 研究人员仍在确保证明不包括任何改变最初假设或任何其他数学规则或真理含义的黑客、闪避或捷径。这个过程称为“比较器运行”，通常需要几个小时。

paras.en: “We still await a successful comparator run, which will check that (a) the code does not do anything nefarious like redefine the meaning of any of the symbols in the statement and (b) (assuming it’s run in paranoid mode) the code compiles with several independent kernels (so the code is not just exploiting an as yet unknown bug in Lean’s official kernel,” Buzzard wrote on an online chat server for the Lean community.
paras.zh: “我们仍在等待成功的比较器运行，它将检查（a）代码没有做任何邪恶的事情，比如重新定义语句中任何符号的含义，以及（b）（假设它在偏执模式下运行）代码使用几个独立的内核进行编译（因此代码不仅仅是利用 Lean 官方内核中的未知错误，”Buzzard 在 Lean 社区的在线聊天服务器上写道。

paras.en: Editor’s Note (11/20/26): This is a developing story and will be updated.
paras.zh: 编者注（11/20/26）：这是一个正在发展的故事，将会更新。

articles.title: Math Puzzle: The longest shuffle
