articles.title: Iraqi security forces deploy in Iran-backed militia stronghold
articles.author: Reuters

paras.en: JURF AL-SAKHAR, Iraq — Iraqi security forces deployed in Jurf al-Sakhar, a stronghold of the Kataib Hezbollah armed group, on Friday under a deal that seeks to limit the reach of Iran’s most powerful Shi’ite militia ally in the country without provoking a confrontation.
paras.zh: 伊拉克尤尔夫萨哈尔——周五，伊拉克安全部队部署在真主党旅武装组织尤尔夫萨哈尔的据点，该协议旨在限制伊朗最强大的什叶派民兵盟友在该国的影响力，同时又不引发对抗。

paras.en: Prime Minister Ali al-Zaidi this week ordered security forces to move against the heavily armed Kataib Hezbollah, which officials accused of running an oil smuggling network siphoning state-owned oil worth hundreds of millions of dollars in Jurf al-Sakhar.
paras.zh: 总理阿里·扎伊迪本周下令安全部队对全副武装的卡塔布真主党采取行动，该组织官员被指控在尤尔夫萨哈尔经营一个石油走私网络，窃取价值数亿美元的国有石油。

paras.en: The hardline Kataib Hezbollah (Battalions of the Party of God), branded a terrorist group by the United States, has rejected the smuggling accusations, which have led to arrests that prompted fears of an armed response. The group is among those that have claimed attacks on US forces in Gulf states since the start of the US-Israeli war on Iran.
paras.zh: 被美国称为恐怖组织的强硬派真主党旅否认了走私指控，这些指控导致了逮捕行动，引发了人们对武装回应的担忧。自美以对伊朗战争爆发以来，该组织是声称对驻海湾国家美军发动袭击的组织之一。

paras.en: A convoy of vehicles flying Iraqi flags headed into Jurf al-Sakhar on Friday and soldiers took up positions in the center after senior security officials told a press conference that government forces would protect the town.
paras.zh: 周五，一支悬挂伊拉克国旗的车队驶入尤尔夫萨哈尔，高级安全官员在新闻发布会上表示，政府部队将保护该城镇，士兵们在中心就位。

paras.en: Members of the Kataib Hezbollah group stood near their group’s flags.
paras.zh: 卡塔布真主党组织的成员站在该组织的旗帜附近。

paras.en: “From Jurf al-Sakhar, we begin asserting state authority across all of Iraq, confronting corruption and weapons beyond state control,” Zaidi told government troops who entered the town, speaking from a military operations center in Baghdad.
paras.zh: 扎伊迪在巴格达的军事行动中心对进入该镇的政府军说：“从尤尔夫·萨哈尔开始，我们开始在整个伊拉克维护国家权威，对抗腐败和国家无法控制的武器。”

paras.en: “Our decision is firm: No weapons outside state authority, no weapons but Iraq‘s, no decisions but Iraq‘s, and no flag shall fly higher than the Iraqi flag.”
paras.zh: “我们的决定是坚定的：没有国家权力之外的武器，没有伊拉克以外的武器，没有伊拉克以外的任何决定，没有任何旗帜可以飘扬得比伊拉克国旗更高。”

paras.en: Under the arrangement, brokered by Shi’ite politicians, Kataib members were expected to withdraw to other parts of Iraq, a major oil producer and ally of both the US and Iran.
paras.zh: 根据什叶派政界人士的安排，卡塔布成员预计将撤至伊拉克其他地区。伊拉克是主要石油生产国，也是美国和伊朗的盟友。

paras.en: “God willing, things will be safe and secure with the presence of the security forces,” said resident Mohamed Ali.
paras.zh: 居民穆罕默德·阿里说：“上帝保佑，有安全部队在场，一切都会安全无忧。”

paras.en: Senior Iranian representative visited Baghdad, sources say
paras.zh: 消息人士称，伊朗高级代表访问了巴格达

paras.en: The deal will include the opening of a security headquarters in Jurf al-Sakhar on Saturday to oversee the handover. Iraq‘s energy police have begun securing an oil pipeline in Jurf al-Sakhar, the state news agency reported.
paras.zh: 该协议将包括周六在尤尔夫萨哈尔开设安全总部，以监督移交工作。据国家通讯社报道，伊拉克能源警察已开始保护尤尔夫萨哈尔的一条石油管道。

paras.en: “Today is a historic moment in which the Iraqi Armed Forces prove that they are the nation’s shield, safety valve, and the guardian ensuring security stability for the Iraqi people,” Sabah al-Numan, spokesperson for the commander-in-chief of the Iraqi armed forces, told the press conference.
paras.zh: 伊拉克武装部队总司令发言人萨巴赫·努曼在新闻发布会上表示：“今天是一个历史性时刻，伊拉克武装部队证明了他们是国家的盾牌、安全阀和确保伊拉克人民安全稳定的守护者。”

paras.en: Reflecting the sensitivity of the situation, Iraqi Shi’ite political figures said Esmail Qaani, commander of Iran’s Revolutionary Guards’ Quds Force, arrived in Baghdad on Monday to help defuse tensions with Kataib Hezbollah.
paras.zh: 伊拉克什叶派政治人物表示，伊朗革命卫队圣城旅指挥官埃斯梅尔·卡尼周一抵达巴格达，以帮助缓和与真主党旅的紧张关系，这反映了局势的敏感性。

paras.en: So far, nine senior security and oil officials have been dismissed following an investigation focused on Jurf al-Sakhar in Babil province, about 50 km (30 miles) south of Baghdad.
paras.zh: 迄今为止，在针对巴比伦省（巴格达​​以南约 50 公里（30 英里））的 Jurf al-Sakhar 进行调查后，已有 9 名高级安全和石油官员被解雇。

paras.en: Any direct confrontation with Iran’s heavily armed militia allies in Iraq could be risky.
paras.zh: 与伊朗在伊拉克​​全副武装的民兵盟友的任何直接对抗都可能存在风险。

paras.en: After one of Zaidi’s predecessors ordered a similar crackdown on those armed groups five years ago, the prime minister’s Baghdad home was hit in a drone strike that authorities described at the time as an assassination attempt.
paras.zh: 五年前，扎伊迪的一位前任下令对这些武装团体进行类似的镇压，之后总理的巴格达住所遭到无人机袭击，当局当时称这是一次暗杀企图。

paras.en: US President Donald Trump has pressured Zaidi to disarm the militias that have struck US troops and facilities in Saudi Arabia and the United Arab Emirates in solidarity with Tehran since the US and Israel launched attacks on Iran in February.
paras.zh: 自美国和以色列二月份对伊朗发动袭击以来，美国总统唐纳德·特朗普向扎伊迪施压，要求其解除袭击美国驻沙特阿拉伯和阿拉伯联合酋长国军队和设施的民兵武装，以声援德黑兰。

paras.en: Kataib Hezbollah and other militias, all of whom report directly to Iran’s Revolutionary Guards, have refused to hand over their weapons to the state.
paras.zh: 卡塔布真主党和其他民兵都直接向伊朗革命卫队报告，但拒绝将武器交给国家。

paras.en: Founded in the aftermath of the 2003 US-led invasion of Iraq, Kataib is among the most influential members of the Islamic Resistance in Iraq, the umbrella group of hardline Shi’ite armed organisations supported by Iran.
paras.zh: 卡塔布成立于 2003 年美国领导的入侵伊拉克之后，是伊拉克伊斯兰抵抗组织最有影响力的成员之一，该组织是伊朗支持的强硬什叶派武装组织的伞形组织。

paras.en: Kataib Hezbollah quickly developed a reputation for deadly attacks against military and diplomatic targets during the US-led counterinsurgency war and sectarian conflict of the 2000s, using snipers, rockets, mortars and roadside bombs.
paras.zh: 在 2000 年代美国领导的平叛战争和教派冲突中，卡塔布真主党使用狙击手、火箭、迫击炮和路边炸弹对军事和外交目标发动致命袭击，从而迅速赢得了声誉。

paras.en: Since the 2003 US-led invasion toppled Iran’s arch-enemy, longtime Sunni leader Saddam Hussein, Tehran has steadily expanded its influence in Iraq through close ties with heavily armed Shi’ite militias and political parties.
paras.zh: 自2003年美国领导的入侵推翻了伊朗的宿敌、逊尼派长期领导人萨达姆·侯赛因以来，德黑兰通过与全副武装的什叶派民兵和政党的密切联系，稳步扩大了其在伊拉克的影响力。

paras.en: Iraqi security officials say the militias’ arsenals include assault rifles, machineguns, anti-tank guided missiles, mortars, precision-guided rockets, armed drones and some short-range ballistic and cruise missile capabilities.
paras.zh: 伊拉克安全官员表示，民兵的武器库包括突击步枪、机枪、反坦克制导导弹、迫击炮、精确制导火箭、武装无人机以及一些短程弹道导弹和巡航导弹能力。

paras.en: Kataib has its own political party, called Huquq, or Rights, with five lawmakers. An Iraqi official report said the group also generates cash through businesses such as construction, housing, trade, tourism and currency exchange, though Kataib denies this and says it is dedicated to security.
paras.zh: 卡塔布有自己的政党，称为“Huquq”或“权利”，有五名议员。伊拉克官方报告称，该组织还通过建筑、住房、贸易、旅游和货币兑换等业务赚取现金，但卡塔布否认这一点，并表示其致力于安全。

paras.en: Pro-Iranian militias, including Kataib, enjoy a semi-official status in Iraq, which critics say encourages them to act with impunity. A shadowy group with no announced leadership structure, Kataib Hezbollah has thousands of hardened fighters.
paras.zh: 包括卡塔布在内的亲伊朗民兵在伊拉克享有半官方地位，批评者称这鼓励他们肆无忌惮地行事。卡塔布真主党是一个没有公布领导结构的神秘组织，拥有数千名顽强的战士。

paras.en: It forms several battalions in Iraq‘s Popular Mobilization Forces (PMF), a grouping of armed factions set up in 2014 to fight Islamic State and subsequently recognized as an official security force.
paras.zh: 它在伊拉克人民动员部队 (PMF) 中组建了多个营，该部队是 2014 年为打击伊斯兰国而成立的武装派别组织，随后被承认为官方安全部队。

paras.en: Fighters receive state salaries and Kataib Hezbollah members, including some designated as terrorists by the US, hold senior positions in the PMF. While it is technically under the command of Iraq‘s prime minister as part of the PMF, the group often operates outside the chain of command.
paras.zh: 战士们领取国家工资，卡塔布真主党成员，包括一些被美国认定为恐怖分子的成员，在 PMF 中担任高级职务。虽然从技术上讲，该组织是伊拉克总理的指挥下，属于人民动员部队的一部分，但该组织经常在指挥系统之外开展活动。

articles.title: Man in hospital after stabbing in Melbourne's CBD

paras.en: A man has been taken to hospital with serious injuries after a stabbing in Melbourne's CBD this afternoon.
paras.zh: 今天下午，墨尔本中央商务区发生刺伤事件，一名男子伤势严重，被送往医院。

paras.en: Police believe the 24-year-old was stabbed by another man on Bourke Street, near the corner of Elizabeth Street, about 2.30pm.
paras.zh: 警方认为，下午 2 点 30 分左右，这名 24 岁的男子在靠近伊丽莎白街拐角处的伯克街被另一名男子刺伤。

paras.en: The men are not believed to know each other, police say.
paras.zh: 警方称，据信这些人并不认识。

paras.en: Police are making extensive inquiries into the whereabouts of the alleged offender, who they say fled along Elizabeth Street towards Little Bourke Street.
paras.zh: 警方正在对嫌疑人的下落进行广泛调查，称嫌疑人沿着伊丽莎白街逃往小伯克街。

paras.en: Paramedics took the injured man to the Royal Melbourne Hospital in a critical condition with upper body injuries.
paras.zh: 医护人员将受伤男子送往皇家墨尔本医院，伤势危急，上半身受伤。

paras.en: Police described the man's injuries as serious.
paras.zh: 警方称该男子伤势严重。

paras.en: Investigators are urging anyone with information or footage to contact Crime Stoppers on 1800 333 000.
paras.zh: 调查人员敦促任何有信息或录像的人联系灭罪热线：1800 333 000。

articles.title: Victoria Point woman waited seven hours for ambulance before death

paras.en: Brisbane woman waited almost seven hours for ambulance before death

paras.en: A 63-year-old Brisbane woman died after waiting seven hours for an ambulance last month.
paras.zh: 上个月，一名 63 岁的布里斯班妇女在等待救护车七个小时后死亡。

paras.en: Her death is one of a number that have been labelled "avoidable".

paras.en: The woman's death will be investigated by the Queensland Ambulance Service.
paras.zh: 昆士兰救护车服务中心将对这名妇女的死亡进行调查。

articles.title: Aussie bowlers no longer in control of public perception of legacies
articles.author: Russell Jackson

paras.en: Three days ago — an eon in the context of Australian cricket's most embarrassing and avoidable omnishambles — former Australian wicketkeeper Ian Healy offered a reasonable take on Australia's famed bowling group.
paras.zh: 三天前——在澳大利亚板球史上最尴尬和最可避免的混乱的背景下——前澳大利亚守门员伊恩·希利对澳大利亚著名的保龄球团体提出了合理的看法。

paras.en: "I would say it taints their personal legacies … I don't think it's going to taint their performance legacies," Healy said. "Personally now, they're not as credible as they once were, unless they change something drastically in the next few days."
paras.zh: “我想说这会玷污他们的个人遗产……我不认为这会玷污他们的表演遗产，”希利说。 “就我个人而言，他们现在不像以前那么可信了，除非他们在未来几天内做出重大改变。”

paras.en: Healy's personal stake in this is self-evident: his niece is married to Mitchell Starc. And in a fast-evolving crisis, his qualifiers were understandable, although we will get to Josh Hazlewood's version of drastic intervention later.
paras.zh: 希利的个人利益是不言而喻的：他的侄女嫁给了米切尔·斯塔克。在一场快速演变的危机中，他的预选赛是可以理解的，尽管我们稍后会讨论乔什·黑兹尔伍德的激烈干预版本。

paras.en: Healy was right to differentiate between the professional and personal: one need not disparage all the hard work, all the joy, all the winning they have given Australians, by admitting that Australia's bowlers have, in recent times, irreparably damaged their own and Australia's credibility.
paras.zh: 希利区分职业和个人的观点是正确的：人们不必承认澳大利亚保龄球手最近不可挽回地损害了他们自己和澳大利亚的信誉，从而贬低他们为澳大利亚人带来的所有辛勤工作、所有快乐和所有胜利。

paras.en: The bowlers also surely must concede that the precise and absolute truth of what happened in 2018 no longer matters to most fans. In fact, their carefully-worded prevarications and collective obsession with semantic distinctions project an air of guilt almost comically out of proportion with the original offence.
paras.zh: 保龄球手们也肯定必须承认，2018 年发生的事情的准确和绝对真相对大多数球迷来说已经不再重要。事实上，他们措辞谨慎的搪塞和对语义区别的集体痴迷，投射出一种与最初的罪行几乎不成比例的内疚气氛，几乎可笑地。

paras.en: No matter what they saw or heard, barely anyone believes what they are saying about it.
paras.zh: 无论他们看到或听到什么，几乎没有人相信他们所说的。

paras.en: Even if players have publicly approved of Cricket Australia's "truth forum", the rest of us surely agree it is as likely to establish an agreed and convincing set of facts as it is to locate Jimmy Hoffa.
paras.zh: 即使球员们公开认可澳大利亚板球协会的“真相论坛”，我们其他人肯定也同意，它就像找到吉米·霍法一样，有可能建立一套一致同意且令人信服的事实。

paras.en: So, to extend Healy's thought, what is their legacy, exactly?
paras.zh: 那么，延伸一下希利的思想，他们的遗产到底是什么？

paras.en: They can hardly blame us for pondering it now in unflattering light. Because the obsession with the "legacy" of Australia's bowlers predates Usman Khawaja's book.
paras.zh: 他们很难责怪我们现在以不讨人喜欢的眼光来思考这个问题。因为对澳大利亚保龄球手“遗产”的痴迷早于乌斯曼·卡瓦贾（Usman Khawaja）的书。

paras.en: In the past 12 months, the idea has been fairly rammed down our throats as justification for keeping the gang together for a marathon 12 months of Test engagements against South Africa, New Zealand, India and England. The last hurrah for a golden generation, they said.
paras.zh: 在过去的 12 个月里，这个想法已经被我们强行灌输给我们，作为让大家团结起来，与南非、新西兰、印度和英格兰进行为​​期 12 个月的马拉松式测试的理由。他们说，这是黄金一代的最后一次欢呼。

paras.en: It could be argued that the very concept was rendered pointless weeks ago, before Sandpapergate's flare-up, on Australia's disastrous recent tour of South Africa.
paras.zh: 可以说，几周前，在“沙纸门”事件爆发之前，在澳大利亚最近灾难性的南非之行中，这个概念就变得毫无意义了。

paras.en: It is one of the ironies of the present crisis engulfing the bowlers: it has precluded lengthier analysis of their deep and abject failure in the most recent Cape Town Test.
paras.zh: 这是当前席卷保龄球手的危机的讽刺之一：它阻碍了对他们在最近的开普敦测试中的深刻而悲惨的失败进行更长时间的分析。

paras.en: All the noise coming from within the team, of course, suggested this was a mere setback: South Africa are world champions for a reason, ya know? Geez, I guess we shouldn't have bowled first. Oh well, onward and upward, eh?
paras.zh: 当然，来自球队内部的所有噪音都表明这只是一次挫折：南非成为世界冠军是有原因的，你知道吗？天哪，我想我们不应该先投球。哦，好吧，向前向上，嗯？

paras.en: Actually, it was proof not just of muddled selection priorities and dwindling returns from old stagers, but a deeper crisis of philosophy and proof that the bowlers, in particular, were not operating in a meritocracy.
paras.zh: 事实上，这不仅证明了选择优先顺序混乱和老选手回报率下降，而且证明了更深层次的哲学危机，并证明投球手尤其没有在精英体制中运作。

paras.en: Having played out of his skin in the second Test, Scott Boland was dropped for Nathan Lyon, who was in turn out-bowled by Simon Harmer, an off-spinner most Australians had previously thought of as a glorified clubbie.
paras.zh: 在第二次测试中，斯科特·博兰德（Scott Boland）表现不佳，被内森·里昂（Nathan Lyon）淘汰，而内森·里昂（Nathan Lyon）又被西蒙·哈默（Simon Harmer）击倒，西蒙·哈默（Simon Harmer）是大多数澳大利亚人之前认为是光荣的俱乐部成员的旋转选手。

paras.en: And Harmer didn't merely take wickets. He publicly called out and dismantled the Australian captain in a manner that should have caused far more alarm than whatever Cummins did or didn't see as a 24-year-old.
paras.zh: 哈默不仅仅拿下三柱门。他公开斥责并拆散了这位澳大利亚船长，这种方式应该比康明斯作为一个 24 岁的年轻人所做或没有看到的任何事情引起更多的警惕。

paras.en: To delve into another modern-day obsession — being "aura" — the loss went far deeper than a 2-1 scoreline. Before its present distraction, Australian cricket pretended otherwise, but symbolic damage was done on a scale we will see more clearly in a few years.
paras.zh: 深入探讨现代人的另一种痴迷——“光环”——这场失利比 2-1 的比分要深刻得多。在目前的干扰之前，澳大利亚板球界假装并非如此，但象征性的损害所造成的规模我们将在几年后更清楚地看到。

paras.en: Which brings us to Josh Hazlewood. On a very simple level, his claim yesterday that he would "review" his place in the Australian team if Cummins lost the captaincy was an impassioned if artless expression of loyalty and solidarity with the skipper in times of disloyalty.
paras.zh: 这让我们想到了乔什·黑兹尔伍德。简单地说，他昨天声称，如果康明斯失去队长职务，他将“重新审视”自己在澳大利亚队的位置，这是在不忠诚的情况下对队长的忠诚和声援的热情而朴素的表达。

paras.en: More so, it smacked of the cart being placed a hell of a long way in front of the horse. It was an expression of entitlement that brought to mind another unflattering scene from a year ago, of an "absolutely filthy" Nathan Lyon sulking away to a sideline TV reporter after being omitted from last December's pink-ball Test. There have been others.
paras.zh: 更重要的是，它有一种马车被放在马前面很远的地方的味道。这是一种权利的表达，让人想起一年前的另一个不讨人喜欢的场景，“绝对肮脏”的内森·里昂(Nathan Lyon)在去年12月的粉球测试中被淘汰后，向场边的电视记者生闷气。还有其他人。

paras.en: For a long time now — long before Sandpapergate reared up again — there has been an inescapable sense that Australia's senior players see themselves not as members of a team chosen by an independent selection panel, nor as merely a self-selecting elite within that team, but as the self-appointed bosses of Australian Test cricket.
paras.zh: 很长一段时间以来，早在“沙纸门”事件再次兴起之前，人们就有一种不可避免的感觉，即澳大利亚的资深球员不认为自己是由独立选拔小组选出的球队的成员，也不是球队中自我选拔的精英，而是自封的澳大利亚板球对抗赛的老板。

paras.en: It is hard to escape the feeling that it is this self-absorbed culture of entitlement and the desire to control its own narrative — much more so than anything that happened in 2018 — that now defines what the public thinks of Australia's bowlers.
paras.zh: 很难不让人感觉到，正是这种自我陶醉的权利文化和控制自己叙述的欲望——比 2018 年发生的任何事情都要严重——现在决定了公众对澳大利亚保龄球手的看法。

paras.en: And yes, it is true that those who've thrown their weight around like this are, by most definitions, indisputably Australia's best. And it is also true that they have sometimes needed to exercise their collective power for the benefit of others, too, as in their pay negotiations.
paras.zh: 是的，确实，按照大多数定义，那些像这样努力的人无疑是澳大利亚最优秀的人。确实，他们有时也需要为了他人的利益而行使集体权力，例如在薪酬谈判中。

paras.en: But what is the average fan — who, by the time the Perth Test rolls around in nine days, will have been subjected to weeks of a melodrama which is only a paternity test and a few exploding boats away from a Home and Away plot — to make of a 35-year-old multi-millionaire threatening to take his ball and go home if his mate's not in charge?
paras.zh: 但是，当珀斯测试在九天后开始时，普通球迷将经历数周的情节剧，这只是一场亲子鉴定和远离主客场情节的几艘爆炸船，他们会怎么理解一位 35 岁的千万富翁威胁说，如果他的伴侣不负责，他就要拿走他的球回家？

paras.en: "The cartel". It has always had a faintly sinister ring to it, don't you think? Some of the behaviour is, frankly, gangsterism, albeit in the territory mined by Martin Scorsese and David Chase — the petty spats over matters of honour and respect, the fragile egos and wounded pride.
paras.zh: “卡特尔”。它总是带有一丝险恶的气息，你不觉得吗？坦率地说，其中一些行为是黑帮行为，尽管是在马丁·斯科塞斯和大卫·蔡斯的地盘上——围绕荣誉和尊重、脆弱的自尊和受伤的自尊心等问题发生的小口角。

paras.en: In this light, we now see Cameron Bancroft as the hapless 'Spider', egged on and then assassinated. Perhaps we suddenly respect Steve Smith a little more for silently doing all that time for crimes he didn't commit.
paras.zh: 从这个角度来看，我们现在将卡梅伦·班克罗夫特视为倒霉的“蜘蛛”，在怂恿下被暗杀。也许我们突然对史蒂夫·史密斯多了几分尊重，因为他一直默默地为他没有犯下的罪行做出了贡献。

paras.en: Which leaves us with how Australia proceeds in the short-term. Cricket Australia, more to blame for the mess than any player, confirmed on Saturday that Cummins would be retained as captain. It was the most predictable and probably the most sensible course of action based on a sober appraisal of all relevant facts, but it did also have the unfortunate effect of validating Hazlewood's veiled threat.
paras.zh: 这让我们剩下澳大利亚短期内的进展如何。澳大利亚板球协会周六证实，康明斯将继续担任队长，该协会对这场混乱负有最大的责任。基于对所有相关事实的清醒评估，这是最可预测的，也可能是最明智的行动方针，但它也确实产生了验证黑兹尔伍德隐秘威胁的不幸后果。

paras.en: Even granting the need to extinguish a tabloid bin-fire, and acknowledging the overwhelming good Cummins has done for Australian cricket, there is an irony in this: backing him in as leader guarantees him a higher work and stress load than he would ideally be shouldering at this point of his career. In an ideal world, free of this scandal, honest conversations about succession planning would already be happening.
paras.zh: 即使承认有必要扑灭小报的垃圾箱大火，并承认康明斯为澳大利亚板球运动做出了巨大的贡献，但其中存在着讽刺之处：支持他作为领导者保证了他比他在职业生涯此时理想的情况下承担更高的工作和压力负担。在一个没有丑闻的理想世界中，关于继任计划的诚实对话已经发生。

paras.en: Hazlewood's interjection and the self-conferred gravitas of his Test spot, meanwhile, sit somewhat at odds with the prevailing views of his contemporaries. Only a week ago, players' union boss Paul Marsh admitted there was "decreasing" support among players for the idea of Test cricket as the pinnacle of the sport.
paras.zh: 与此同时，黑兹尔伍德的感叹和他在测试地点所表现出的庄重感，与他同时代人的普遍观点有些不一致。就在一周前，球员工会主席保罗·马什承认，球员们对板球测试赛作为这项运动巅峰的想法的支持“正在下降”。

paras.en: Fans, by extension, are now buffeted by administrators who care too little about Test cricket and a few players who care too much.
paras.zh: 推而广之，球迷们现在受到了对板球测试赛太不关心的管理人员和一些过于关心板球比赛的球员的打击。

paras.en: In the time since Sandpapergate, Cricket Australia has had six chairmen, four CEOs, three men's head coaches and capped 21 new Test players. That a few mainstays attained an over-mighty status is perhaps natural enough, but it is surely time that senior players are reminded that Test selection is not their birthright.
paras.zh: 自 Sandpapergate 事件以来，澳大利亚板球协会已经有 6 名主席、4 名首席执行官、3 名男子主教练以及 21 名新测试球员。一些中流砥柱获得超强地位也许是很自然的事情，但现在确实是时候提醒资深玩家了，测试选择并不是他们与生俱来的权利。

paras.en: Australia's next 15 Tests would have been brutally difficult in any context. Against such a draining and unpleasant backdrop, the degree of difficulty for an aging and now embittered group of old hands has only increased.
paras.zh: 澳大利亚接下来的 15 场测试在任何情况下都将异常艰难。在这样一个令人筋疲力尽、令人不快的背景下，对于一群上了年纪、现在心怀怨恨的老手来说，难度只会增加。

paras.en: And that really is the stuff of "legacy" — not just everything in totality, but the aftertaste left by the final few bites.
paras.zh: 这确实是“遗产”的东西——不仅仅是所有的一切，还有最后几口留下的余味。

articles.title: A Montrealer died in Istanbul. Authorities blame food poisoning but what we found suggests something else
articles.author: Michelle Gagnon, Jacaudrey Charbonneau, Judith Plamondon

paras.en: A Montrealer died in Istanbul. Authorities blame food poisoning but what we found suggests something else
paras.zh: 一名蒙特利尔人在伊斯坦布尔去世。当局归咎于食物中毒，但我们的发现表明了其他原因

paras.en: Illegal use of pesticide in Turkey linked to deaths of other tourists and residents
paras.zh: 土耳其非法使用农药导致其他游客和居民死亡

paras.en: Bérengère Deveaux-Cattino, a healthy 24-year-old Montrealer, died suddenly in Istanbul on June 17, 2025.
paras.zh: Bérengère Deveaux-Cattino 是一名健康的 24 岁蒙特利尔人，于 2025 年 6 月 17 日在伊斯坦布尔突然去世。

paras.en: A Turkish autopsy report concluded the cause of death was food poisoning.
paras.zh: 土耳其尸检报告得出结论，死因是食物中毒。

paras.en: But for her family, that doesn't add up.
paras.zh: 但对于她的家人来说，这并不算什么。

paras.en: A joint investigation into Deveaux-Cattino's death by Enquête and the fifth estate revealed a different poison at work and 12 similar deaths.
paras.zh: Enquête 和第五庄园对 Deveaux-Cattino 的死亡事件进行了联合调查，发现了不同的中毒行为以及 12 起类似的死亡事件。

paras.en: The recent medical school graduate had decided to celebrate by taking a trip with a few of her closest friends.
paras.zh: 这位刚从医学院毕业的人决定与她的几个最亲密的朋友一起旅行来庆祝。

paras.en: "She'd never been to Turkey," said her sister, Éléonore Deveaux-Cattino. "She thought it was a super beautiful, vibrant country."
paras.zh: “她从未去过土耳其，”她的妹妹埃莱奥诺尔·德沃-卡蒂诺 (Éléonore Deveaux-Cattino) 说。 “她认为这是一个超级美丽、充满活力的国家。”

paras.en: The group hit the tourist trail and its highlights, including the requisite balloon ride in Cappadocia.
paras.zh: 该团队参观了旅游路线及其亮点，包括卡帕多西亚必不可少的热气球之旅。

paras.en: Bérengère Deveaux-Cattino had never been to Turkey before her trip in 2025, says her sister, Éléonore Deveaux-Cattino. ‘She thought it was a super beautiful, vibrant country.’ (Radio-Caanda)
paras.zh: Bérengère Deveaux-Cattino 的姐姐 Éléonore Deveaux-Cattino 表示，她在 2025 年旅行之前从未去过土耳其。 “她认为这是一个超级美丽、充满活力的国家。”（Radio-Caanda）

paras.en: With only two days to go, Bérengère and one of her friends headed for Istanbul, a city she'd longed to visit.
paras.zh: 只剩两天了，贝伦盖尔和她的一位朋友前往伊斯坦布尔，这是她一直渴望参观的城市。

paras.en: - Watch the full documentary, "The Invisible Killer," from the fifth estate on YouTube or CBC-TV on Friday at 9 p.m.
paras.zh: - 周五晚上 9 点在 YouTube 或 CBC-TV 上观看来自第五庄园的完整纪录片“隐形杀手”

paras.en: They checked into Room 108 at the Seven Days Hotel and went straight out to explore. They soaked up the sights and street food, then settled down for a proper meal, a chicken casserole followed by Turkish tea and baklava.
paras.zh: 他们住进了7天酒店108房间，直接出去探索。他们欣赏了景点和街头美食，然后坐下来享用一顿美餐，先是砂锅鸡，然后是土耳其茶和果仁蜜饼。

paras.en: The next morning, they woke violently ill.
paras.zh: 第二天早上，他们醒来时病得很重。

paras.en: The details of those final days come from Laurie, the woman who travelled to Istanbul with Bérengère. What happened on that trip left her traumatized and we've agreed to protect her identity and not use her real name.
paras.zh: 最后几天的细节来自与贝伦盖尔一起前往伊斯坦布尔的劳里。那次旅行中发生的事情让她受到了创伤，我们同意保护她的身份，不使用她的真实姓名。

paras.en: She said that within minutes of waking, Bérengère was throwing up.
paras.zh: 她说贝伦盖尔醒来几分钟后就开始呕吐。

paras.en: "Then I started feeling unwell," Laurie said, "and suddenly we were taking turns running to the bathroom to vomit until we realized that whatever it was, it wasn't just going to pass."
paras.zh: “然后我开始感觉不舒服，”劳里说，“突然我们轮流跑到卫生间呕吐，直到我们意识到无论是什么，它都不会消失。”

paras.en: They called the front desk and an ambulance took them to hospital.
paras.zh: 他们打电话给前台，救护车将他们送往医院。

paras.en: ‘My sister is younger than me,’ said Éléonore Deveaux-Cattino, right. ‘I’d never imagined a life without her.’ (Submitted by Deveaux-Cattino family)
paras.zh: “我妹妹比我年轻，”埃莱奥诺尔·德沃-卡蒂诺（右）说道。 “我从未想象过没有她的生活。”（由 Deveaux-Cattino 家族提交）

paras.en: That same day, across the ocean in Montreal, Éléonore Deveaux-Cattino saw her screen light up: Laurie was FaceTiming her.
paras.zh: 同一天，在大洋彼岸的蒙特利尔，埃莱奥诺尔·德沃·卡蒂诺 (Éléonore Deveaux-Cattino) 看到她的屏幕亮了起来：劳里正在与她进行 FaceTime 通话。

paras.en: "I thought: 'This isn't normal. Something's off. This is going to be bad news,'" said Deveaux-Cattino. "She says 'Élo, we're in the hospital in Istanbul, and things aren't going well. I've been told to contact the family.'"
paras.zh: “我想：‘这不正常。有些事情不对劲。这将是个坏消息，’”德沃-卡蒂诺说。 “她说‘埃洛，我们在伊斯坦布尔的医院里，情况不太顺利。我被告知要联系家人。’”

paras.en: Deveaux-Cattino and her father, Henri Cattino, scrambled to find flights to Istanbul. While waiting for their connection in Paris, Deveaux-Cattino called the embassy.
paras.zh: 德沃-卡蒂诺和她的父亲亨利·卡蒂诺忙着寻找飞往伊斯坦布尔的航班。在巴黎等待联系时，德沃-卡蒂诺给大使馆打了电话。

paras.en: "I said: 'Please, can you tell me if my sister has died?'" said Deveaux-Cattino. ”And she said: 'I'm very sorry, Éléonore, but your sister is dead.'"
paras.zh: “我说：‘请问你能告诉我我妹妹是否死了吗？’”德沃-卡蒂诺说。 “她说：‘我很抱歉，埃莱奥诺尔，但你的妹妹死了。’”

paras.en: Three days into their trip to Istanbul in November 2025, the Böcek family from Hamburg fell ill. Five days later, all four family members were dead, poisoned by phosphine gas. (@ismailsaymaz/X)
paras.zh: 2025 年 11 月，来自汉堡的 Böcek 一家前往伊斯坦布尔，三天后就病倒了。五天后，四名家庭成员全部死于磷化氢气体中毒。 （@ismailsaymaz/X）

paras.en: The Deveaux-Cattinos repatriated Bérengère's body and asked the Quebec coroner's office to examine it. They buried their daughter and sister without confirmation of the cause of death.
paras.zh: 德沃-卡蒂诺家族将贝伦盖尔的尸体运回国，并要求魁北克验尸官办公室对其进行检查。他们在没有确认死因的情况下埋葬了女儿和妹妹。

paras.en: As they waited for answers from Turkey, the family speculated about what else could explain Bérengère's death: Organ trafficking? Alcohol poisoning? Medical malpractice?
paras.zh: 在等待土耳其的答复时，贝伦盖尔的家人猜测还有什么可以解释贝伦盖尔的死亡：器官贩运？酒精中毒？医疗事故？

paras.en: Then, in November, as we were investigating, a diplomatic source texted with a tip that pointed to an entirely different explanation.
paras.zh: 然后，在 11 月份，当我们进行调查时，一位外交消息人士发短信指出了完全不同的解释。

paras.en: "A family of four has just died in Istanbul. Watch this report."
paras.zh: “一个四口之家刚刚在伊斯坦布尔去世。请观看这份报告。”

paras.en: The Böceks, a Turkish-German family from Hamburg, were visiting Istanbul. Their hotel was blocks from where Bérengère and Laurie stayed. All four fell ill and died within days of each other.
paras.zh: 博切克一家是来自汉堡的土耳其裔德国家庭，当时正在伊斯坦布尔访问。他们的旅馆距离贝伦盖尔和劳里住的地方只有几个街区。四个人都相继患病并在几天之内去世。

paras.en: Investigators initially suspected food poisoning there, too. But within days, authorities concluded that another poison had been at work: aluminum phosphide, a highly toxic agricultural pesticide used to kill rodents and insects.
paras.zh: 调查人员最初怀疑那里也发生了食物中毒。但几天之内，当局得出结论，另一种毒物在起作用：磷化铝，一种用于杀死啮齿动物和昆虫的剧毒农业杀虫剂。

paras.en: Exterminators call aluminum phosphide "the bomb." It is used in pellet form. Once the pellets are exposed to air, they release phosphine gas. Exterminators say that when placed in a sealed room, the gas kills every living, breathing thing within 72 hours. In Turkey, it's illegal to use in urban areas.
paras.zh: 消灭者称磷化铝为“炸弹”。它以颗粒形式使用。一旦颗粒暴露在空气中，就会释放磷化氢气体。灭虫人员称，当被放置在密封房间中时，气体会在 72 小时内杀死所有有生命、会呼吸的生物。在土耳其，在城市地区使用是违法的。

paras.en: But, like all big cities, Istanbul has a bedbug problem.
paras.zh: 但是，像所有大城市一样，伊斯坦布尔也存在臭虫问题。

paras.en: Exterminator Birkan Cihan said he can barely keep up with calls from desperate home and hotel owners. Some ask whether he treats bedbugs with "gas." He doesn't.
paras.zh: 灭虫员比尔坎·吉汉 (Birkan Cihan) 表示，他几乎无法接到绝望的家庭和酒店业主的电话。有人问他是否用“气体”治疗臭虫。他不知道。

paras.en: "We tell them their neighbours could die from it, and that they could, too. But they say: 'We have no choice, it's the only thing that works,'" Cihan said
paras.zh: “我们告诉他们，他们的邻居可能会因此而死亡，他们也可能会因此而死亡。但他们说：‘我们别无选择，这是唯一有效的办法，’”吉汉说

paras.en: The phosphine gas these pellets emit is so potent and volatile that it can spread through a building, even if the area being treated is sealed.
paras.zh: 这些颗粒释放的磷化氢气体非常有效且易挥发，即使被处理的区域被密封，它也可以在建筑物中扩散。

paras.en: In the case of the Böcek family, fumigation in the neighbouring room was determined to be what killed all four of them.
paras.zh: 就 Böcek 一家而言，隔壁房间的熏烟被确定是导致他们四人死亡的原因。

paras.en: Investigations by Enquête and the fifth estate have found similar cases. In 2012, two sisters from Quebec, Audrey and Noémi Bélanger, died of phosphine poisoning in Thailand.
paras.zh: Enquête 和第五产业的调查也发现了类似案件。 2012年，来自魁北克省的两姐妹奥黛丽·贝兰格和诺埃米·贝兰格在泰国因磷化氢中毒身亡。

paras.en: In 2012, two sisters from Quebec, Audrey and Noémi Bélanger, died of phosphine poisoning in Thailand. (Submitted by Bélanger family)
paras.zh: 2012年，来自魁北克省的两姐妹奥黛丽·贝兰格和诺埃米·贝兰格在泰国因磷化氢中毒身亡。 （贝兰热家族提交）

paras.en: Just before Christmas 2025, the Deveaux-Cattinos received the autopsy report from Turkey. It concluded that food poisoning caused Bérengère's death. Unconvinced, they handed the report to the Quebec coroner's office.
paras.zh: 就在 2025 年圣诞节前夕，德沃-卡蒂诺夫妇收到了来自土耳其的尸检报告。结论是食物中毒导致了贝伦盖尔的死亡。他们不相信，将报告交给了魁北克验尸官办公室。

paras.en: "The coroner here ran some tests, and she couldn't confirm that food poisoning was the cause of death because, usually, there are signs of intestinal irritation," Éléonore Deveaux-Cattino said. "There were none in my sister's case."
paras.zh: 埃莱奥诺尔·德沃-卡蒂诺说：“验尸官进行了一些测试，但她无法确认食物中毒是死因，因为通常会有肠道刺激的迹象。” “我姐姐的箱子里没有。”

paras.en: We showed the Turkish autopsy report to another Quebec pathologist. Although not authorized to speak publicly, he also questioned the autopsy's conclusions.
paras.zh: 我们向另一位魁北克病理学家展示了土耳其尸检报告。尽管没有被授权公开发言，他也对尸检结论提出质疑。

paras.en: "Two young, healthy women who end up in the hospital with food poisoning — OK, I'll buy that. But to die of it so quickly, without any signs of bloody diarrhea or other complications, that doesn't make any sense."
paras.zh: “两名年轻、健康的女性最终因食物中毒入院——好吧，我会买这个。但这么快就死了，没有任何血性腹泻或其他并发症的迹象，这没有任何意义。”

paras.en: Turkish freelance journalist Ayse Adanali covered the story of the death of the Böcek family in Istanbul in 2025. (Radio-Canada)
paras.zh: 土耳其自由记者 Ayse Adanali 报道了 2025 年伊斯坦布尔 Böcek 一家的死亡故事。（加拿大广播电台）

paras.en: In Turkey, we started working with Ayse Adanali, a freelance Turkish journalist who'd covered the Böcek story.
paras.zh: 在土耳其，我们开始与艾斯·阿达纳利 (Ayse Adanali) 合作，她是一位报道过博切克故事的土耳其自由记者。

paras.en: Together, we documented nearly 30 cases of phosphine poisoning, including a dozen deaths, since 2023 in Turkey.
paras.zh: 自 2023 年以来，我们总共记录了土耳其近 30 起磷化氢中毒案件，其中包括十几人死亡。

paras.en: Some were tourists, like the two Dutch teenagers found dead by their father in their Istanbul hotel room in August 2025. But most of the victims were Turkish, like Karan Yazıcı, a three-year-old boy poisoned in Istanbul in April 2025 following a fumigation in the neighbouring apartment.
paras.zh: 其中一些是游客，比如 2025 年 8 月在伊斯坦布尔酒店房间里被父亲发现的两名荷兰青少年。但大多数受害者是土耳其人，比如 2025 年 4 月在伊斯坦布尔的三岁男孩卡兰·亚兹奇 (Karan Yazıcı) 在邻近公寓熏蒸后中毒身亡。

paras.en: The majority of the victims are women and children. Members of the same family were often poisoned together. While some survived, others died. In most cases, food poisoning was initially blamed for making them sick.
paras.zh: 大多数受害者是妇女和儿童。同一家族的成员经常一起中毒。虽然有些人幸存下来，但其他人却死了。在大多数情况下，最初将他们生病归咎于食物中毒。

paras.en: Şebnem Korur Fincancı is a human rights activist, professor emeritus and leading forensic pathologist in Turkey.
paras.zh: Şebnem Korur Fincancı 是土耳其的人权活动家、名誉教授和领先的法医病理学家。

paras.en: She's studied aluminum phosphide and knows how difficult it is to identify victims poisoned by phosphine gas.
paras.zh: 她研究过磷化铝，知道识别磷化氢气体中毒的受害者有多么困难。

paras.en: Turkish forensic pathologist Şebnem Korur Fincancı has studied aluminum phosphide and knows how difficult it is to identify victims poisoned by phosphine gas. (Radio-Canada)
paras.zh: 土耳其法医病理学家 Şebnem Korur Fincancı 研究了磷化铝，知道识别磷化氢气体中毒的受害者有多么困难。 （加拿大广播电台）

paras.en: She'd never heard about Bérengère; her death had not been covered by Turkish media.
paras.zh: 她从未听说过贝伦盖尔；她从未听说过贝伦盖尔。土耳其媒体没有报道她的死亡。

paras.en: "This is not food poisoning," she said after reading the Turkish autopsy report.
paras.zh: “这不是食物中毒，”她在看完土耳其尸检报告后说道。

paras.en: "I don't think that this is food poisoning because there is no story of diarrhea, only throwing up."
paras.zh: “我不认为这是食物中毒，因为没有腹泻的故事，只有呕吐。”

paras.en: She added that the timing of Bérengère's decline suggests food poisoning couldn't be the culprit.
paras.zh: 她补充说，贝伦盖尔衰落的时间表明食物中毒不可能是罪魁祸首。

paras.en: "Rather, it is the pesticide poisoning."
paras.zh: “确切地说，是农药中毒。”

paras.en: Fincancı sees one undeniable detail in this report, a finding common to all victims of phosphine gas poisoning she's examined: something called metabolic acidosis, which increases the levels of acidity in the body.
paras.zh: Fincancı 在这份报告中看到了一个不可否认的细节，这是她检查过的所有磷化氢气体中毒受害者的共同发现：一种称为代谢性酸中毒的现象，它会增加体内的酸度水平。

paras.en: "There is the metabolic acidosis, which also indicates the pesticide intoxication," she said. 'It is one of the main findings of these kinds of cases."
paras.zh: “存在代谢性酸中毒，这也表明农药中毒，”她说。 “这是此类案件的主要调查结果之一。”

paras.en: She believes there could be more cases of phosphine poisoning than currently reported.
paras.zh: 她认为磷化氢中毒的病例可能比目前报道的还要多。

paras.en: "With all these misdiagnoses, we have to consider the situation."
paras.zh: “由于所有这些误诊，我们必须考虑这种情况。”

paras.en: Bérengère Deveaux-Cattino and her friend, Laurie, stayed at the Seven Days Hotel in Istanbul. (Radio-Canada)
paras.zh: Bérengère Deveaux-Cattino 和她的朋友 Laurie 住在伊斯坦布尔的七天酒店。 （加拿大广播电台）

paras.en: We scoured hundreds of Google and Tripadvisor reviews for the Seven Days Hotel to see if they'd had a bedbug problem around the time of Bérengère and Laurie's stay.
paras.zh: 我们在 Google 和 Tripadvisor 上搜索了数百条关于七天酒店的评论，看看他们在贝伦盖尔和劳里入住期间是否存在臭虫问题。

paras.en: One stood out: A tourist claiming he'd been bitten 150 times during his stay in June 2025.
paras.zh: 其中一个引人注目：一名游客声称他在 2025 年 6 月逗留期间被咬了 150 次。

paras.en: We tracked him down. He confirmed he stayed in Room 107, the room next door to where the two women stayed 10 days later.
paras.zh: 我们追踪到了他。他证实自己住在107号房间，10天后，这两个女人就住在107号房间的隔壁。

paras.en: The windows in those two rooms open onto each other.
paras.zh: 这两个房间的窗户相互打开。

paras.en: That left one critical question: Had Room 107 been treated after his stay? And, if so, with what?
paras.zh: 这就留下了一个关键问题：107 号房间在他入住后是否得到了处理？如果是的话，用什么？

paras.en: We contacted hotel manager Bahattin Demir. He remembered Bérengère and Laurie and had gone to the hospital after they'd been admitted.
paras.zh: 我们联系了酒店经理 Bahattin Demir。他记得贝伦盖尔和劳里，并在他们入院后去了医院。

paras.en: We told him about the tourist in Room 107 and asked him whether extermination work in that room could have killed Bérengère.
paras.zh: 我们向他讲述了 107 号房间里那位游客的事，并问他那个房间的灭绝工作是否会杀死贝伦盖尔。

paras.en: "I don't think so, because if it was that product, I'm sure that, you know, everybody would have this problem," he said.
paras.zh: “我不这么认为，因为如果是那个产品，我确信每个人都会遇到这个问题，”他说。

paras.en: Inside Room 108 at the Seven Days Hotel where Bérengère Deveaux-Cattino and Laurie stayed. (Radio-Canada)
paras.zh: Bérengère Deveaux-Cattino 和 Laurie 入住的七日酒店 108 号房间内。 （加拿大广播电台）

paras.en: He said exterminators spray the rooms in the hotel monthly. He offered to contact them and find out what product they use, but then wrote back, referring us to them for more details.
paras.zh: 他说除虫人员每月都会在酒店的房间里喷洒杀虫剂。他主动提出联系他们并了解他们使用的产品，但随后回信，将我们推荐给他们以了解更多详细信息。

paras.en: The extermination company is called Wolves.
paras.zh: 这个消灭公司叫做狼队。

paras.en: A contact called them for us. We're protecting her identity because undercover work can lead to jail time in Turkey.
paras.zh: 一位联系人帮我们打电话给他们。我们正在保护她的身份，因为在土耳其从事卧底工作可能会导致入狱。

paras.en: Posing as an Air BnB owner in Istanbul's Fatih district, she claimed to be struggling with bedbugs.
paras.zh: 她冒充伊斯坦布尔法提赫区爱彼迎 (Air BnB) 业主，声称自己正在与臭虫作斗争。

paras.en: He didn't name the product specifically, but his detailed description is similar to how aluminum phosphide is used.
paras.zh: 他没有具体命名该产品，但他的详细描述与磷化铝的使用方式类似。

paras.en: "For 72 hours, nobody goes in, the doors are locked and nothing living enters."
paras.zh: “72小时内，没有人进去，门锁着，没有活人进入。”

paras.en: - Deaths of Quebec women in Thailand may have been caused by pesticide
paras.zh: - 泰国魁北克妇女死亡可能是农药造成的

paras.en: - Phosphine pesticide used to kill bedbugs causes Fort McMurray baby's death
paras.zh: - 用于杀死臭虫的磷化氢农药导致麦克默里堡婴儿死亡

paras.en: We called Wolves for an interview. The employee who answered the phone was not authorized to speak, but denied using aluminum phosphide.
paras.zh: 我们打电话给狼队进行采访。接听电话的员工无权发言，但否认使用磷化铝。

paras.en: Neither the hospital that treated Bérengère nor the Forensic Medical Centre where her autopsy was performed replied to our inquiries.
paras.zh: 治疗贝伦盖尔的医院和对她进行尸检的法医中心都没有回复我们的询问。

paras.en: The tourism police similarly declined our interview request.
paras.zh: 旅游警察同样拒绝了我们的采访请求。

paras.en: Going over notes Laurie had shared, we noticed she and Bérengère had left the window open the first night. But the next evening, to avoid being woken by the call to prayer, they closed it and turned on the air conditioning. And that was the night they got sick.
paras.zh: 回顾劳里分享的笔记，我们注意到她和贝伦盖尔第一晚没有关窗。但第二天晚上，为了避免被祈祷声吵醒，他们关上了门，打开了空调。就在那天晚上，他们生病了。

paras.en: We asked pathologist Şebnem Korur Fincancı whether phosphine gas residue could build up in air conditioners.
paras.zh: 我们询问病理学家 Şebnem Korur Fincancı 空调中是否会积聚磷化氢气体残留物。

paras.en: The Böceks' case went to trial in June 2026. The defendants were charged with criminal negligence causing the deaths of this family of four. The ruling came down within days. The owners of the extermination company were found guilty and sentenced to 18 years in prison. The hotel owner and employees received 12 to 13 years.
paras.zh: Böceks 的案件于 2026 年 6 月开庭审理。被告被指控犯有刑事过失罪，导致一家四口死亡。几天之内，裁决就下来了。灭绝公司的老板被判有罪并被判处 18 年监禁。酒店老板和员工被判12至13年监禁。

paras.en: While awaiting the verdict, the paternal grandfather, Yilmaz Böcek, commented that even the stiffest penalty could never bring back his children and grandchildren.
paras.zh: 在等待判决期间，祖父伊尔马兹·博切克 (Yilmaz Böcek) 表示，即使是最严厉的惩罚也无法让他的子孙复活。

paras.en: Éléonore Deveaux-Cattino wants Bérengère to be remembered.
paras.zh: 埃莱奥诺尔·德沃-卡蒂诺希望人们记住贝伦盖尔。

paras.en: "My sister is younger than me. I'd never imagined a life without her. We used to be two against the world … now I'm all alone," she said.
paras.zh: “我姐姐比我年轻。我从来没有想象过没有她的生活。我们曾经是两个人对抗世界……现在我孤身一人，”她说。

paras.en: "But I'm stubborn. And since she can no longer speak, I'll speak for her. I'll never let her go."
paras.zh: “但我很固执。既然她已经不能说话了，我就为她说话。我永远不会让她走。”

paras.en: In the summer of 2026, the government of Canada added a new entry to its travel advisory for Turkey, alerting travellers to "cases of poisoning linked to the use of chemical pesticides in tourist accommodations in Istanbul."
paras.zh: 2026 年夏天，加拿大政府在土耳其旅行建议中添加了一个新条目，提醒旅行者注意“与伊斯坦布尔旅游住宿中使用化学农药有关的中毒案件”。

paras.en: After this story first aired on Oct. 15, 2026, Turkish consular officials contacted us, confirming the investigation into Bérengère Deveaux-Cattino's death in Istanbul remains open.
paras.zh: 本报道于 2026 年 10 月 15 日首次播出后，土耳其领事官员联系了我们，确认对贝伦盖尔·德沃·卡蒂诺在伊斯坦布尔死亡事件的调查仍在进行中。

articles.title: Former White House press secretary Katie Zacharia investigated by California state bar
articles.author: Rhianna Schmunk

paras.en: Former White House press secretary Katie Zacharia investigated by California state bar
paras.zh: 前白宫新闻秘书凯蒂·扎卡里亚 (Katie Zacharia) 受到加州律师协会调查

paras.en: Watchdog group filed complaint saying Zacharia misrepresented herself as a lawyer
paras.zh: 看门狗组织提出投诉，称扎卡里亚谎称自己是律师

paras.en: California's state bar is investigating former White House press secretary Katie Zacharia after a complaint she represented herself as a lawyer without having ever passed the bar exam.
paras.zh: 加州律师协会正在调查前白宫新闻秘书凯蒂·扎卡里亚(Katie Zacharia)，此前她被投诉在未通过律师考试的情况下以律师身份代理自己。

paras.en: The State Bar of California confirmed its investigation into Zacharia, who was removed from her role as press secretary after a rocky five days, in a letter to a watchdog group published Thursday.
paras.zh: 加利福尼亚州律师协会在周四发表的一封致监督组织的信中证实了对扎卡里亚的调查，扎卡里亚在经历了五天的动荡后被解除了新闻秘书的职务。

paras.en: In a statement on Thursday, the state bar declined to comment further but noted the existence of an investigation doesn't mean "a non-licensee" has practised law without authorization.
paras.zh: 在周四的一份声明中，州律师协会拒绝进一步置评，但指出调查的存在并不意味着“非执照持有者”未经授权就执业。

paras.en: "Our investigations are confidential, so we cannot share anything more, regardless of whether or not a complainant has made their own disclosure," its email read.
paras.zh: 电子邮件中写道：“我们的调查是保密的，因此无论投诉人是否自行披露，我们都不能透露更多信息。”

paras.en: The watchdog group Campaign for Accountability filed a complaint last month, asking the state bar to investigate whether Zacharia broke the law by describing herself as a lawyer in interviews.
paras.zh: 监督组织“问责运动”上个月提出申诉，要求州律师调查扎卡里亚在接受采访时自称律师是否违法。

paras.en: Zacharia graduated from Pepperdine University's law school in California in 2011, but was never admitted to the bar.
paras.zh: 扎卡里亚 2011 年毕业于加利福尼亚州佩珀代因大学法学院，但从未获得律师资格。

paras.en: "Zacharia may have thought she was just playing a lawyer on TV, but by repeatedly holding herself out as an attorney on news programs, she was pretending to have authority she lacks," Campaign for Accountability executive director Michelle Kuppersmith said in a statement.
paras.zh: 问责运动执行董事米歇尔·库珀史密斯在一份声明中表示：“扎卡里亚可能认为她只是在电视上扮演律师，但通过在新闻节目中反复表现出自己是律师的身份，她假装拥有自己所缺乏的权威。”

paras.en: The organization published a response from the state bar on Thursday. In that letter, the bar confirmed the complaint had been "forwarded for further investigation" and would be assigned to an investigator and legal adviser.
paras.zh: 该组织周四发布了州律师协会的回应。在这封信中，律师事务所确认投诉已“转交进一步调查”，并将指派一名调查员和法律顾问。

paras.en: Under the state's business code, anyone "holding himself or herself out as practicing or entitled to practice law" without being an active licensee of the bar is guilty of a misdemeanor. The violation is punishable by up to a year in county jail, a fine of $1,000 or both."
paras.zh: 根据该州的商业法，任何人如果没有成为律师事务所的有效持照人，“声称自己从事法律工作或有权从事法律工作”，则犯有轻罪。违规行为可被判处最高一年的县监禁、1000 美元的罚款，或两者并罚。”

paras.en: Katie Zacharia listens to U.S. President Donald Trump outside the White House after her only briefing as press secretary last month. (Kevin Lamarque/Reuters)
paras.zh: 凯蒂·扎卡里亚 (Katie Zacharia) 上个月作为新闻秘书唯一一次通报情况后，在白宫外聆听美国总统唐纳德·特朗普 (Donald Trump) 的讲话。 （凯文·拉马克/路透社）

paras.en: U.S. President Donald Trump announced Zacharia's appointment as press secretary in October, following Karoline Leavitt's resignation from the role in August.
paras.zh: 继卡罗琳·莱维特 (Karoline Leavitt) 于 8 月辞职后，美国总统唐纳德·特朗普 (Donald Trump) 于 10 月宣布任命扎卡里亚 (Zacharia) 为新闻秘书。

paras.en: Zacharia held only one, shaky briefing before she was removed from her role, making her the shortest-serving White House press secretary in history.
paras.zh: 扎卡里亚在被免职之前只举行了一次不稳定的简报会，这使她成为历史上任期最短的白宫新闻秘书。

paras.en: She had also faced a flurry of headlines questioning whether she had misrepresented herself as a lawyer when she spoke as a commentator on television.
paras.zh: 她还面临一系列头条新闻，质疑她在电视上以评论员身份发言时是否歪曲了自己的律师身份。

paras.en: In an October interview, she said she was preparing to take the California bar exam at a time when she had just gotten married and was preparing to move to China to join her new husband.
paras.zh: 在10月份的一次采访中，她说她正准备参加加州律师考试，当时她刚刚结婚，并准备搬到中国与新丈夫团聚。

paras.en: Zacharia said it was appropriate to use the title when she was offering legal analysis and said she had worked as a lawyer in China. U.S. President Donald Trump had also described her as "an attorney."
paras.zh: 扎卡里亚表示，在提供法律分析时使用这个头衔是合适的，并表示她曾在中国担任律师。美国总统唐纳德·特朗普也称她为“律师”。

articles.title: Trump threatens to penalize U.S. tech companies that build AI data centres in other countries

paras.en: Trump threatens to penalize U.S. tech companies that build AI data centres in other countries
paras.zh: 特朗普威胁要惩罚在其他国家建立人工智能数据中心的美国科技公司

paras.en: Democrats debating best way to quickly establish guardrails in the next Congress
paras.zh: 民主党人在下一届国会辩论快速建立护栏的最佳方法

paras.en: U.S. tech companies that build artificial intelligence data centres in other countries will face "a tremendous tax," U.S. President Donald Trump said on Friday.
paras.zh: 美国总统唐纳德·特朗普周五表示，在其他国家建立人工智能数据中心的美国科技公司将面临“巨额税收”。

paras.en: "We're not allowing data centres to go into other countries because China will take all of them, and we're not allowing that to happen," Trump said in a White House press briefing. "And we're going to put tremendous penalties on companies that try and do it."
paras.zh: 特朗普在白宫新闻发布会上表示：“我们不允许数据中心进入其他国家，因为中国将占领所有这些国家，我们不会允许这种情况发生。” “我们将对试图这样做的公司处以巨额处罚。”

paras.en: Trump did not provide details on how he would enforce such a policy and said he hadn't yet told his own officials about his plan.
paras.zh: 特朗普没有提供有关如何执行此类政策的细节，并表示他尚未向自己的官员透露他的计划。

paras.en: The president urged Americans to welcome data centre construction in their communities and extract concessions from the developers, repeating a point he made before the midterm elections.
paras.zh: 总统敦促美国人欢迎在他们的社区建设数据中心，并从开发商那里获得让步，重申了他在中期选举前提出的观点。

paras.en: - U.S. further restricts China's access to AI chips in wake of Nvidia scandal
paras.zh: - 英伟达丑闻后，美国进一步限制中国获得人工智能芯片

paras.en: - Trump says he's working on a 'fair' trade deal with Canada
paras.zh: - 特朗普表示他正在与加拿大达成“公平”贸易协议

paras.en: "You ought to take advantage of the data centres," Trump said. "Make them pay you, make them pay your community, but don't shut them off."
paras.zh: “你应该利用数据中心，”特朗普说。 “让他们付钱给你，让他们付钱给你的社区，但不要阻止他们。”

paras.en: "We want them to build it here," he added.
paras.zh: “我们希望他们在这里建造它，”他补充道。

paras.en: The U.S. Senate on Thursday approved bipartisan legislation aimed at speeding up permitting reviews to build power plants, transmission lines and other energy infrastructure as lawmakers seek to increase the nation's energy supplies to meet surging demand and lower electricity prices.
paras.zh: 美国参议院周四批准了两党立法，旨在加快对建设发电厂、输电线路和其他能源基础设施的许可审查，立法者寻求增加国家能源供应，以满足不断增长的需求并降低电价。

paras.en: The legislation's sweeping changes would shorten the timeline to start big energy projects and make sure data centres pay for the energy they use and upgrades to the larger transmission network.
paras.zh: 该立法的彻底改变将缩短启动大型能源项目的时间，并确保数据中心为其使用的能源付费并升级到更大的传输网络。

paras.en: Trump praised the Senate bill, which now goes to the House.
paras.zh: 特朗普赞扬了参议院的法案，该法案现已提交众议院。

paras.en: "It's going to cause tremendous amounts of new building," he said.
paras.zh: “这将导致大量新建筑的出现，”他说。

paras.en: A tougher regulatory environment for AI giants and data centre developers is expected to follow, even if Trump — a champion of the industry — stalls any federal crackdown. The data centres powering the AI boom have become politically toxic.
paras.zh: 即使该行业的拥护者特朗普阻止任何联邦镇压，预计人工智能巨头和数据中心开发商将面临更严格的监管环境。推动人工智能繁荣的数据中心已经具有政治毒性。

paras.en: Anger over data centres and rising electricity prices helped usher in a midterms wave of Democrats pledging to clamp down on the energy-hungry behemoths.
paras.zh: 对数据中心和不断上涨的电价的愤怒引发了中期选举浪潮，民主党人承诺打击能源巨头。

paras.en: Democrats have been publicly and privately discussing what their first steps could be on artificial intelligence when they take the majority in January. Top policy proposals could be regulating data centres, safety standards and stepping up monitoring and research.
paras.zh: 民主党人一直在公开和私下讨论，当他们在一月份获得多数席位时，他们在人工智能方面的第一步可能是什么。最重要的政策建议可能是监管数据中心、安全标准以及加强监测和研究。

paras.en: Colorado Sen. John Hickenlooper said Friday that there hasn't been enough progress in Congress since Democrats formed a working group on AI three years ago and convened tech leaders from across the country to figure out next steps.
paras.zh: 科罗拉多州参议员约翰·希肯卢珀 (John Hickenlooper) 周五表示，自三年前民主党成立人工智能工作组并召集全国各地的技术领导人制定下一步行动以来，国会尚未取得足够的进展。

paras.en: While Republicans who have led the House and Senate for the past two years have said that AI should be a priority, they have focused mostly on innovation and there has been no major push to establish safeguards or increase monitoring of the technology.
paras.zh: 尽管过去两年领导众议院和参议院的共和党人表示人工智能应该成为优先事项，但他们主要关注创新，并且没有大力推动建立保障措施或加强对该技术的监控。

paras.en: "There's a perception that we haven't done anything," Hickenlooper said.
paras.zh: “人们认为我们什么也没做，”希肯卢珀说。

paras.en: House Democrats have also been discussing a way forward on AI and have proposed a robust package of proposals. This week, three Democrats announced the launch of the House AI Safety and Innovation caucus to address security risks.
paras.zh: 众议院民主党人也一直在讨论人工智能的前进方向，并提出了一系列强有力的提案。本周，三名民主党人宣布成立众议院人工智能安全与创新核心小组，以应对安全风险。

paras.en: With host communities across the U.S. turning against the gargantuan data centres, America's technology giants are promising to take fewer taxpayer handouts, keep fewer secrets or shower more money onto the communities willing to allow the server warehouses.
paras.zh: 随着美国各地的托管社区开始反对庞大的数据中心，美国的科技巨头承诺减少纳税人的施舍，保留更少的秘密，或者向愿意允许建立服务器仓库的社区提供更多资金。

paras.en: Besides ramping up financial incentives, officials with Google and Meta said in interviews with The Associated Press they are trying to address mistrust by being more transparent with communities where they would like to build.
paras.zh: 除了加大财政激励力度外，谷歌和 Meta 的官员在接受美联社采访时表示，他们正试图通过对他们想要建立的社区提高透明度来解决不信任问题。

paras.en: Companies are also making pledges to reduce their impact on the environment and offering assurances that data centres will boost local property values — all while maintaining AI is a positive force for the American economy.
paras.zh: 公司还承诺减少对环境的影响，并保证数据中心将提升当地房地产价值，同时保持人工智能对美国经济的积极力量。

paras.en: The Trump administration on Monday issued new rules to restrict remote access to advanced U.S. computing chips and servers, marking the latest step to limit China's abilities to use U.S. chips to train its best AI models.
paras.zh: 特朗普政府周一发布了新规则，限制远程访问先进的美国计算芯片和服务器，这是限制中国使用美国芯片训练其最佳人工智能模型的最新举措。

articles.title: Russian ornithologist jailed over small donations to Navalny's foundation

paras.en: Boris Rosenfeld shows DW a photo of him with his daughter Sofia and can't hold back tears. "This was the last time we saw her. Then she left for Moscow, and this whole case began," he says.
paras.zh: 鲍里斯·罗森菲尔德向德国之声展示了一张他和女儿索菲亚的照片，他忍不住流下了眼泪。 “这是我们最后一次见到她。然后她去了莫斯科，整个案件就开始了，”他说。

paras.en: Helives in Israel, while Sofia is in Russia. For more than a month now, she has been behind bars on charges of financing extremism. The case goes back to two donations totaling 2,000 rubles (about $30) to the late opposition politician Alexei Navalny'sAnti-Corruption Foundation (FBK), which the Russian authorities have since designated as extremist.
paras.zh: 他住在以色列，而索菲亚则住在俄罗斯。一个多月以来，她因涉嫌资助极端主义而入狱。此案可以追溯到已故反对派政治家阿列克谢·纳瓦尔尼的反腐败基金会 (FBK) 收到的两笔总计 2,000 卢布（约合 30 美元）的捐款，该基金会后来被俄罗斯当局认定为极端分子。

paras.en: On October 7, a court in Moscow sentenced Rosenfeld to three and a half years in a penal colony.
paras.zh: 10 月 7 日，莫斯科一家法院判处罗森菲尔德流放地三年半。

paras.en: A biologist who dedicated her life to Arctic birds
paras.zh: 一位将一生奉献给北极鸟类的生物学家

paras.en: Rosenfeld is a prominent ornithologist who has devoted her life to studying and protecting Arcticbirds. "Sofia was an avid young naturalist from childhood. She loved birds, horses and dogs," her father said as he leafed through a photo album.
paras.zh: 罗森菲尔德是一位著名的鸟类学家，一生致力于研究和保护北极鸟类。 “索菲亚从小就是一位狂热的博物学家。她喜欢鸟、马和狗，”她的父亲一边翻阅相册一边说道。

paras.en: Sofia was a teenager when the family moved to Israel but she returned to Russia a few years later and now holds both Russian and Israeli citizenship.
paras.zh: 全家搬到以色列时索菲亚十几岁，但几年后她回到俄罗斯，现在拥有俄罗斯和以色列公民身份。

paras.en: She studied biology at Moscow State University and developed a significant scientific career in Russia. Her colleague, Alexandra Panyutina, who now also lives in Israel, explained that Rosenfeld was devoted to her work from an early age.
paras.zh: 她在莫斯科国立大学学习生物学，并在俄罗斯发展了重要的科学事业。她的同事亚历山德拉·帕纽蒂娜 (Alexandra Panyutina) 现也居住在以色列，她解释说，罗森菲尔德从小就致力于工作。

paras.en: "Birds and the Arctic are the defining passions of her life," she said.
paras.zh: “鸟类和北极是她一生的最爱，”她说。

paras.en: Rosenfeld was among the first Russian researchers to develop a systematic approach to monitoring migratory bird populations. To support her research, she even developed a special aircraft.
paras.zh: 罗森菲尔德是最早开发系统方法来监测候鸟种群的俄罗斯研究人员之一。为了支持她的研究，她甚至开发了一种特殊的飞机。

paras.en: "They could fly at almost the same speed as the birds and observe them from a low altitude," says Dmitry (name changed), a colleague of Rosenfeld's. "It quickly became clear that this was a unique method."
paras.zh: “它们可以以与鸟类几乎相同的速度飞行，并从低空观察它们，”罗森菲尔德的同事德米特里（化名）说。 “很快就发现这是一种独特的方法。”

paras.en: Rosenfeld is considered to be one of the leading figures in Russian ornithology. Her work has extended well beyond Russia and she has been deeply involved in international research projects. In the field of migratory bird conservation, cross-border cooperation is essential.
paras.zh: 罗森菲尔德被认为是俄罗斯鸟类学领域的领军人物之一。她的工作范围远远超出了俄罗斯，并深入参与了国际研究项目。在候鸟保护领域，跨界合作至关重要。

paras.en: Helmut Kruckenberg, the head of the German Institute for Wetlands and Waterbird Research (IWWR), said Rosenfeld was highly respected within the international scientific community.
paras.zh: 德国湿地和水鸟研究所（IWWR）所长赫尔穆特·克鲁肯伯格表示，罗森菲尔德在国际科学界备受尊敬。

paras.en: "She has done an enormous amount for nature conservation and for the protection of Siberian and Arctic species," he said. "What is happening to her is simply beyond comprehension for us."
paras.zh: “她为自然保护以及西伯利亚和北极物种的保护做出了巨大的贡献，”他说。 “她身上发生的事情简直超出了我们的理解范围。”

paras.en: More than 225 cases over donations to FBK across Russia
paras.zh: 俄罗斯各地涉及向 FBK 捐款的案件超过 225 起

paras.en: In the summer of 2021, when Russian authorities designated Alexei Navalny's Anti-Corruption Foundation, also known as FBK, as an extremist organization, Rosenfeld was on a remote Arctic expedition without a phone or access to the internet. Therefore, she did not cancel her regular donations to the FBK immediately, doing so only after her return to the Russian capital Moscow.
paras.zh: 2021 年夏天，当俄罗斯当局将阿列克谢·纳瓦尔尼的反腐败基金会（也称为 FBK）指定为极端组织时，罗森菲尔德正在进行一次偏远的北极探险，没有电话或无法上网。因此，她并没有立即取消对FBK的定期捐款，而是在返回俄罗斯首都莫斯科后才取消。

paras.en: Her friend Olga (name changed) described Sofia as a person of absolute honesty. According to her, Rosenfeld's donations to Navalny's foundation reflected a genuine desire to fight corruption. Through her work in Russia's regions, she had seen plenty of it firsthand.
paras.zh: 她的朋友奥尔加（化名）形容索菲亚是一个绝对诚实的人。据她说，罗森菲尔德对纳瓦尔尼基金会的捐款反映了反腐败的真诚愿望。通过在俄罗斯各地区的工作，她亲眼目睹了很多事情。

paras.en: "She was never involved in political activism. Her donations were solely intended to support anti-corruption work," said her father Boris Rosenfeld. "It's unthinkable".
paras.zh: “她从未参与政治活动。她的捐款只是为了支持反腐败工作，”她的父亲鲍里斯·罗森菲尔德说。 “这是不可想象的”。

paras.en: For him and others close to her, the sentence came as a shock. Although prosecutors had requested a five-year prison term, friends and colleagues expected that she would receive a fine at most.
paras.zh: 对于他和其他与她关系密切的人来说，这句话令人震惊。尽管检察官要求判处五年徒刑，但朋友和同事预计她最多只会受到罚款。

paras.en: There were reasons for that expectation. According to calculations by independent media outlet Mediazona, about 85% of convictions in the 225 cases involving donations to Navalny's foundation have so far resulted in non-custodial sentences. Yet Rosenfeld got three and a half years in a penal colony.
paras.zh: 这种期望是有原因的。根据独立媒体 Mediazona 的计算，迄今为止，在涉及向纳瓦尔尼基金会捐款的 225 起案件中，约 85% 的定罪结果是非监禁判决。然而罗森菲尔德在流放地被关了三年半。

paras.en: A year of court hearings and travel restrictions
paras.zh: 一年的法庭听证会和旅行限制

paras.en: Just a few months after Rosenfeld defended her doctoral dissertation in October 2025, her home was searched. She was also subject to travel restrictions. She continued to work but she had to cancel her annual summer expedition to the Arctic.
paras.zh: 2025 年 10 月，罗森菲尔德完成博士论文答辩几个月后，她的家就遭到搜查。她还受到旅行限制。她继续工作，但不得不取消每年一度的北极夏季探险活动。

paras.en: Even on the day of the sentencing, her conversations with her colleagues focused largely on science: "We discussed how the work could continue in Sofia's absence," Olga said. "But no one really believed she would end up in prison."
paras.zh: 即使在宣判当天，她与同事的谈话也主要集中在科学上：“我们讨论了在索菲亚不在的情况下如何继续工作，”奥尔加说。 “但没有人真正相信她最终会入狱。”

paras.en: "The only thing we think about now is how to bring her here," Boris Rosenfeld says as he looks at the pictures from Sofia's last visit.
paras.zh: “我们现在唯一考虑的就是如何把她带到这里，”鲍里斯·罗森菲尔德看着索菲亚上次来访时的照片说道。

paras.en: Friends and colleagues who spoke to DW say that his daughter never considered leaving Russia, even as the prospect of a prison sentence loomed. "Sofia would never have left. She simply can't imagine life without geese," says Dmitry.
paras.zh: 接受德国之声采访的朋友和同事表示，他的女儿从未考虑过离开俄罗斯，尽管入狱的可能性迫在眉睫。 “索菲亚永远不会离开。她根本无法想象没有鹅的生活，”德米特里说。

paras.en: Now, her family, friends and colleagues are campaigning to have her sentence overturned. More than 1,000 people have signed an appeal to Russia's Presidential Council for Human Rights.
paras.zh: 现在，她的家人、朋友和同事正在发起运动，要求推翻对她的判决。已有1000多人签署了向俄罗斯总统人权委员会发出的呼吁。

paras.en: Boris Rosenfeld is also hoping for support from Israel but so far Israeli consular officials have not been granted access to his daughter in detention.
paras.zh: 鲍里斯·罗森菲尔德也希望得到以色列的支持，但迄今为止，以色列领事官员尚未获准探视他被拘留的女儿。

paras.en: The two continue to write to each other and he is trying to keep his spirits high: "She writes that she's trying to adjust to life in prison, and that it's hard," he says. "But she's a strong person."
paras.zh: 两人继续写信给对方，他努力保持高昂的情绪：“她写道，她正在努力适应监狱生活，这很难，”他说。 “但她是一个坚强的人。”

paras.en: This article was originally published in Russian.
paras.zh: 本文最初以俄语发表。

articles.title: Brazil ex-President Jair Bolsonaro taken to hospital over abdominal pain

paras.en: Convicted former Brazilian President Jair Bolsonaro, who is serving a 27-year sentence under house arrest over a coup attempt, has been hospitalized with abdominal pain.
paras.zh: 因政变未遂而被软禁 27 年的巴西前总统雅伊尔·博尔索纳罗 (Jair Bolsonaro) 因腹痛入院治疗。

paras.en: Bolsonaro's son Carlos wrote on X that the former far-right leader was taken to the hospital on Friday and was found to have "a near-complete intestinal obstruction."
paras.zh: 博尔索纳罗的儿子卡洛斯在 X 上写道，这位前极右翼领导人周五被送往医院，被发现患有“近乎完全性肠梗阻”。

paras.en: The DF Star Hospital in Brasília said that Bolsonaro was suffering from "abdominal distension" and was being examined.
paras.zh: 巴西利亚DF Star医院表示，博尔索纳罗患有“腹胀”，正在接受检查。

paras.en: Bolsonaro, who is 71 years old, has undergone several hospitalizations and surgeries since he was stabbed in the abdomen on the campaign trail for the 2018 elections.
paras.zh: 现年 71 岁的博索纳罗自从在 2018 年大选竞选期间腹部被刺伤以来，已经接受了多次住院治疗和手术。

paras.en: "He is being given medication for pain and an initial attempt to reverse the condition without the need for invasive intervention," Carlos said.
paras.zh: 卡洛斯说：“他正在接受止痛药物，并初步尝试在不需要侵入性干预的情况下扭转病情。”

paras.en: Son blames house arrest for Bolsonaro's health issues
paras.zh: 儿子将博尔索纳罗的健康问题归咎于软禁

paras.en: Bolsonaro was in power from 2019 to 2022. He was convicted last year for plotting a coup after his defeat to current President Luiz Inacio Lula da Silva in the 2022 election but claims being the victim of a left-wing judicial witch hunt.
paras.zh: 博尔索纳罗于 2019 年至 2022 年执政。去年，他在 2022 年选举中输给现任总统路易斯·伊纳西奥·卢拉·达席尔瓦后，因策划政变而被定罪，但他声称自己是左翼司法政治迫害的受害者。

paras.en: Bolsonaro was placed under humanitarian house arrest on medical grounds.
paras.zh: 博尔索纳罗因健康原因被软禁。

paras.en: Carlos on Friday railed against his father's detention, which he blamed for Bolsonaro's current health problems.
paras.zh: 卡洛斯周五谴责了他父亲的拘留，他将博尔索纳罗目前的健康问题归咎于父亲的拘留。

paras.en: Carlos said that the senior Bolsonaro's health was "deteriorating every day in prison due to his lack of mobility" and what he called "the psychological torture he suffers daily."
paras.zh: 卡洛斯表示，博尔索纳罗的健康状况“由于行动不便，在监狱里每天都在恶化”，他称之为“每天遭受的心理折磨”。

paras.en: Another one of Bolsonaro's sons, Flavio Bolsonaro, recently lost the October presidential election to incumbent President Lula. Flavio Bolsonaro left Brazil after the vote and now resides in Florida.
paras.zh: 博尔索纳罗的另一位儿子弗拉维奥·博尔索纳罗最近在十月份的总统选举中输给了现任总统卢拉。弗拉维奥·博尔索纳罗在投票后离开巴西，目前居住在佛罗里达州。

articles.title: Man convicted of arson over deadly 2025 Palisades fire in Los Angeles

paras.en: A US-French man has been convicted on federal arson charges connected with the 2025 Palisades fire in Los Angeles, California, which killed 12 people and devastated the seaside enclave of Pacific Palisades.
paras.zh: 一名美籍法国男子因与 2025 年加利福尼亚州洛杉矶帕利塞德火灾有关的联邦纵火罪被定罪，该火灾造成 12 人死亡，并摧毁了太平洋帕利塞德的海滨飞地。

paras.en: The weeks-long blaze destroyed some 6,800 homes and other structures, causing estimated property losses of $150 billion (€136.7 billion).
paras.zh: 长达数周的大火摧毁了约 6,800 栋房屋和其他建筑，造成的财产损失估计达 1,500 亿美元（1,367 亿欧元）。

paras.en: What was the man convicted of in the Palisades fire case?
paras.zh: 帕利塞兹火灾案中的男子被判什么罪？

paras.en: A US District Court jury in Los Angeles found the man guilty of starting a hilltop brush fire on January 1, 2025.
paras.zh: 洛杉矶美国地方法院陪审团裁定该男子于 2025 年 1 月 1 日引发山顶灌木丛火灾罪名成立。

paras.en: While the fire was initially suppressed, it continued smoldering underground and reignited days later amid fierce winds to become the highly destructive Palisades Fire.
paras.zh: 虽然大火最初被扑灭，但它继续在地下阴燃，几天后在狂风中重新点燃，成为极具破坏性的帕利塞兹大火。

paras.en: The man is set to be sentenced on March 17. First Assistant US Attorney Bill Essayli told reporters that he could face up to 40 years in prison.
paras.zh: 该男子将于 3 月 17 日被判刑。美国第一助理检察官 Bill Essayli 告诉记者，他可能面临最高 40 年的监禁。

paras.en: The man was arrested in October 2025, and already faced one trial five months ago that ended with a hung jury. The judge declared a mistrial in June, prompting federal prosecutors to retry the case under modified charges.
paras.zh: 该男子于 2025 年 10 月被捕，五个月前就已经面临过一次审判，但陪审团的结果却是悬而未决。法官于六月宣布审判无效，促使联邦检察官根据修改后的指控重审此案。

paras.en: Prosecutors said security camera footage and location data from the defendant's cellphone showed he was the only person nearby when the January 1 blaze began in the Santa Monica Mountains National Recreation Area.
paras.zh: 检察官表示，监控录像和被告手机的位置数据显示，1 月 1 日圣莫尼卡山国家休闲区发生大火时，他是附近唯一的人。

paras.en: At both trials, they characterized the man, a former Uber driver, as a loner who held a deep resentment against society, and particularly the wealthy.
paras.zh: 在这两次审判中，他们都将这名前优步司机描述为一个孤独的人，对社会，尤其是富人抱有深深的怨恨。

paras.en: The defense argued that the initial blaze could have been caused by fireworks, while prosecutors said there was no evidence that any had been set off in the area.
paras.zh: 辩方辩称，最初的火灾可能是由烟花引起的，而检察官表示，没有证据表明该地区曾燃放烟花。

paras.en: In March, the man denied in a court declaration that he had willfully started any fire, though he declined to testify in his own defense at either trial.
paras.zh: 今年三月，该男子在法庭声明中否认他故意纵火，但他拒绝在两次审判中为自己辩护作证。

paras.en: The Palisades blaze erupted almost at the same time as another wildfire that broke out in Eaton Canyon, some 30 miles (48 km) to the east.
paras.zh: 帕利塞兹大火几乎与东边约 30 英里（48 公里）的伊顿峡谷 (Eaton Canyon) 爆发的另一场野火同时爆发。

paras.en: That fire, believed to have been ignited by sparks from an electrical transmission tower, killed 19 people and devastated the Los Angeles suburb of Altadena.
paras.zh: 这场大火据信是由一​​座输电塔的火花引起的，造成 19 人死亡，洛杉矶郊区阿尔塔迪纳 (Altadena) 遭到严重破坏。

paras.en: Together, the two blazes rank as the deadliest wildfire disaster ever seen in Los Angeles County.
paras.zh: 这两场大火一起成为洛杉矶县有史以来最致命的野火灾难。

articles.title: Can Israel’s opposition bloc stay united against Netanyahu?

paras.en: As negotiations over the formation of Israel’s next government approach their first deadline of December 6, caretaker Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu appears to be seeking to exploit divisions within the opposition “change” alliance trying to oust him.
paras.zh: 随着有关组建以色列下一届政府的谈判临近 12 月 6 日的第一个最后期限，看守总理本杰明·内塔尼亚胡似乎正在寻求利用反对派“变革”联盟内部的分歧，试图将他赶下台。

paras.en: On Wednesday, he held an undeclared meeting with one of its leading figures, former Prime Minister Naftali Bennett, in a move that has prompted accusations that Netanyahu is attempting to fracture the bloc from within.
paras.zh: 周三，他与该集团领导人之一、前总理纳夫塔利·贝内特举行了一次未经宣布的会面，此举引发了内塔尼亚胡试图从内部分裂该集团的指控。

paras.en: The meeting, which lasted two and a half hours, was described by Netanyahu’s office as a “security briefing”. Sources within the opposition alliance led by Gadi Eisenkot, however, characterised it as a “strategic disaster”, according to Israeli media.
paras.zh: 这次会议持续了两个半小时，内塔尼亚胡办公室将其描述为“安全简报会”。然而，据以色列媒体报道，加迪·艾森科特领导的反对派联盟内部消息人士将其描述为一场“战略灾难”。

paras.en: Bennett had not informed Eisenkot of the meeting in advance, sources told the outlet Ynet. During a subsequent gathering of opposition leaders, Bennett is reported to have argued that they should try to pursue the possibility of a unity government with Netanyahu, Channel 12 reported.
paras.zh: 消息人士告诉媒体 Ynet，贝内特没有提前通知艾森科特这次会面。据第 12 频道报道，在随后举行的反对派领导人聚会中，据报道贝内特表示，他们应该努力寻求与内塔尼亚胡组建联合政府的可能性。

paras.en: Bennett, a right-winger, is among several prominent figures in the opposition alliance who have previously served in Netanyahu-led governments. Eisenkot himself joined Netanyahu’s emergency unity government following the Hamas-led October 7, 2023 attack on Israel, serving as a minister without portfolio and a member of the war cabinet.
paras.zh: 贝内特是一名右翼分子，是反对派联盟中曾在内塔尼亚胡领导的政府中任职的几位知名人物之一。 2023 年 10 月 7 日哈马斯领导的对以色列的袭击后，艾森科特本人加入了内塔尼亚胡的紧急联合政府，担任无职务部长和战时内阁成员。

paras.en: Avigdor Lieberman, meanwhile – another right-wing member of the opposition bloc – served as Netanyahu’s foreign minister and defence minister.
paras.zh: 与此同时，反对派集团的另一位右翼成员阿维格多·利伯曼担任内塔尼亚胡的外交部长和国防部长。

paras.en: “Netanyahu is trying to break up the [opposition] bloc for change through Bennett,” a senior figure in the Eisenkot-led alliance told Ynet in an article referencing the numerous pledges by opposition leaders, including Bennett, never to serve within a Netanyahu-led coalition again.
paras.zh: 艾森科特领导的联盟的一位高级人士在一篇文章中告诉 Ynet，“内塔尼亚胡正试图通过贝内特打破[反对派]集团，寻求变革。”该文章提到了包括贝内特在内的反对派领导人的众多承诺，永远不再在内塔尼亚胡领导的联盟中任职。

paras.en: However, given the broad array of ideologies among the coalition leaders, stretching from the hard-right policies of Lieberman to the relatively left-wing platform of Democrats’ leader Yair Golan, and many having previously worked with Netanyahu, it remains unclear how long the bloc can maintain its unity.
paras.zh: 然而，考虑到联盟领导人之间广泛的意识形态，从利伯曼的极右政策到民主党领袖亚伊尔·戈兰相对左翼的纲领，以及许多人曾与内塔尼亚胡合作过，目前尚不清楚联盟能够维持团结多久。

paras.en: Bennett himself was once among Netanyahu’s closest political allies, serving in several of his governments before breaking with him in 2021, when the opportunity arose to form an alternative administration with centrist Yair Lapid. Bennett and Lapid subsequently assembled a cross-party coalition that ended Netanyahu’s 12 consecutive years in office, with Bennett taking the premiership for the first half of its term. But he still shares many policy positions with Netanyahu.
paras.zh: 贝内特本人曾经是内塔尼亚胡最亲密的政治盟友之一，曾在他的几届政府中任职，后来在 2021 年与中间派亚伊尔·拉皮德组成替代政府的机会出现时与他决裂。贝内特和拉皮德随后组建了一个跨党派联盟，结束了内塔尼亚胡的连续12年执政，贝内特担任了前半个任期的总理。但他仍然与内塔尼亚胡分享许多政策立场。

paras.en: So how cohesive is the opposition coalition, and what could be its potential breaking points?
paras.zh: 那么反对派联盟的凝聚力如何，其潜在的突破点可能是什么？

paras.en: Is the change bloc united ideologically?
paras.zh: 变革集团在意识形态上是否团结？

paras.en: All of the bloc’s members supported Israel’s genocidal war on Gaza – at least at its start – as well as its attacks on several regional states, including Iran and Lebanon.
paras.zh: 欧盟所有成员国都支持以色列对加沙的种族灭绝战争——至少在一开始——以及对包括伊朗和黎巴嫩在内的几个地区国家的袭击。

paras.en: In terms of domestic policy, however, there are marked differences between members of the alliance.
paras.zh: 但在国内政策方面，联盟成员之间存在明显差异。

paras.en: Both the bloc’s leader, former Israeli military Chief of Staff Gadi Eisenkot, and Bennett’s electoral partner, Yair Lapid, are regarded as relatively centrist figures. By contrast, Bennett and Lieberman are firmly on the right, divided largely by their attitudes towards religion: Bennett is a religious nationalist, while Liberman is a staunchly secular politician with a background in Israel’s Russian-speaking community, increasingly at odds with Israel’s powerful religious political currents.
paras.zh: 该集团的领导人、以色列前军事参谋长加迪·艾森科特和贝内特的选举伙伴亚伊尔·拉皮德都被视为相对中间派人物。相比之下，贝内特和利伯曼坚定地站在右翼，主要是因为他们对宗教的态度而存在分歧：贝内特是一位宗教民族主义者，而利伯曼是一位坚定的世俗政治家，拥有以色列俄语社区的背景，与以色列强大的宗教政治潮流越来越不一致。

paras.en: Standing apart is the left-wing Yair Golan, a supporter of a two-state solution with the Palestinians and an outspoken critic of settler pogroms in the occupied West Bank, which he has accused the government of encouraging or tolerating.
paras.zh: 站在一边的是左翼亚伊尔·戈兰，他支持与巴勒斯坦人的两国解决方案，并直言不讳地批评被占领的约旦河西岸定居者大屠杀，他指责政府鼓励或容忍这种屠杀。

paras.en: Beyond the prospect of Netanyahu – Israel’s longest-serving prime minister – continually attempting to undermine them, Eisenkot faces the formidable task of finding the additional 13 seats needed for a parliamentary majority. His bloc holds just 48 of the parliament’s 120 seats after the October 27 elections, leaving him dependent on bridging deep political divides among his allies if he is to form a government capable of governing.
paras.zh: 除了以色列任期最长的总理内塔尼亚胡不断试图削弱他们的前景之外，艾森科特还面临着寻找议会多数所需的额外 13 个席位的艰巨任务。 10 月 27 日的选举后，他的集团仅占据议会 120 个席位中的 48 个，这使得他要想组建一个有能力执政的政府，就必须依靠弥合盟友之间深刻的政治分歧。

paras.en: Golan has already met political leaders from parties representing Palestinian citizens of Israel and spoken enthusiastically about forming a government with their support. However, that suggestion has been rejected by the rest of the bloc, and has provoked fierce opposition, with right-wing protesters even threatening civil war at the prospect.
paras.zh: 戈兰已经会见了代表以色列巴勒斯坦公民的政党领导人，并热情地表示希望在他们的支持下组建政府。然而，这一建议遭到了欧盟其他成员国的拒绝，并引发了激烈的反对，右翼抗议者甚至威胁要爆发内战。

paras.en: Lieberman, whose Yisrael Beytenu party holds seven seats, has been particularly emphatic in rejecting any government dependent on Palestinian support. However, his longstanding and highly vocal opposition to the de facto exemption of ultra-Orthodox Jewish men from military service appears to be softening in the face of another possibility: the 13 seats held by the ultra-Orthodox parties, Shas and United Torah Judaism.
paras.zh: 利伯曼领导的以色列贝特努党拥有七个席位，他特别坚决地拒绝任何依赖巴勒斯坦支持的政府。然而，面对另一种可能性，他长期以来强烈反对极端正统犹太男子事实上免服兵役的立场似乎有所软化：极端正统党派、沙斯党和联合托拉犹太教占据了 13 个席位。

paras.en: Lieberman’s willingness to compromise on conscription risks undermining one of his central electoral promises, as well as those of other opposition leaders, and could prompt a backlash from supporters.
paras.zh: 利伯曼在征兵问题上妥协的意愿可能会破坏他以及其他反对派领导人的一项核心选举承诺，并可能引发支持者的强烈反对。

paras.en: Have the change bloc’s differences come out in the open?
paras.zh: 变革集团的分歧是否已公开化？

paras.en: In August, Bennett dismissed Eisenkot’s proposal to allow limited exemptions from military conscription that would cover the ultra-Orthodox as an “insane mistake”, warning that ultra-Orthodox politicians Aryeh Deri and Moshe Gafni would “run circles around” him. Eisenkot subsequently countered, accusing Bennett and Lieberman of engaging in “old politics” and damaging the opposition’s electoral prospects by refusing to agree that the largest party in the alliance should lead the next government.
paras.zh: 八月，贝内特驳回了艾森科特的提议，即允许对极端正统派进行有限的征兵豁免，称其为“疯狂的错误”，并警告极端正统派政客阿耶·德里和摩西·加夫尼会“围着他转”。艾森科特随后反驳，指责贝内特和利伯曼参与“旧政治”，拒绝同意联盟中最大的政党领导下一届政府，从而损害了反对派的选举前景。

paras.en: Lieberman, just weeks before the election, branded Eisenkot “Gantz 2.0” – referring to former defence minister Benny Gantz, who joined Netanyahu’s government in 2020 despite campaigning against him – accusing Eisenkot of secretly pursuing a deal with Netanyahu and acting out of personal ambition. Golan, meanwhile, told Lieberman several days after the election that, if he was to continue to insist on a government that avoids conscripting ultra-Orthodox men, he was “welcome to form one with Netanyahu”.
paras.zh: 就在选举前几周，利伯曼将艾森科特称为“甘茨2.0”——指的是前国防部长本尼·甘茨，尽管他在竞选活动中反对内塔尼亚胡，但他于2020年加入了内塔尼亚胡政府——指责艾森科特秘密寻求与内塔尼亚胡达成协议，并出于个人野心行事。与此同时，戈兰在选举几天后告诉利伯曼，如果他继续坚持政府避免征召极端正统派人士，他“欢迎与内塔尼亚胡组成一个政府”。

paras.en: What did change bloc leaders say about Netanyahu before entering the opposition?
paras.zh: 在加入反对派之前，变革集团领导人对内塔尼亚胡说了些什么？

paras.en: Their previous assessments of Netanyahu have not always been so harsh.
paras.zh: 他们之前对内塔尼亚胡的评价并不总是那么严厉。

paras.en: In 2020, Bennett told reporters that, despite their personal differences, he respected Netanyahu “very much”, adding that Israel had “won a victory” by having him in office for so long and that he had “done great things” for the country.
paras.zh: 2020年，贝内特对记者表示，尽管他们个人存在分歧，但他“非常”尊重内塔尼亚胡，并补充说，以色列让他长期执政“赢得了胜利”，他为国家“做了伟大的事情”。

paras.en: Lieberman, meanwhile, told The Jerusalem Post in 2019 that he wished Netanyahu “only really good results” and hoped that he would be acquitted on the corruption charges that he has since cited, on numerous occasions, as evidence that the prime minister is unfit for office.
paras.zh: 与此同时，利伯曼在 2019 年告诉《耶路撒冷邮报》，他希望内塔尼亚胡“只有真正好的结果”，并希望他能被无罪释放，此后他多次引用这些指控作为总理不适合担任总理的证据。

articles.title: Netanyahu is playing with the fire that killed Rabin

paras.en: Politics is not for the faint-hearted, and debate and disagreement are integral to it. A number of politicians believe that the end justifies the means, but most know when they are approaching the red lines and when to stop.
paras.zh: 政治不适合胆小的人，辩论和分歧是其中不可或缺的一部分。许多政客认为，为达目的不择手段，但大多数人都知道何时接近红线以及何时停止。

paras.en: Not Benjamin Netanyahu, Israel’s current prime minister. His repulsive response to the success of the Arab parties in last month’s general election unleashed his darkest racist demons.
paras.zh: 不是以色列现任总理本杰明·内塔尼亚胡。他对阿拉伯政党在上个月大选中取得成功的令人厌恶的反应释放了他最黑暗的种族主义恶魔。

paras.en: Some might argue that this is simply another cynical tactic in his efforts to derail his political rivals’ attempts to form a government. Whether this is who he really is or simply a cynical politician at his core, governing through division makes little difference.
paras.zh: 有些人可能会认为，这只是他试图阻止政治对手组建政府的另一种愤世嫉俗的策略。无论他是真正的他，还是本质上只是一个愤世嫉俗的政治家，通过分裂进行统治都没有什么区别。

paras.en: He is the prime minister, and his words and behaviour matter. When he legitimises and normalises this kind of language, he releases the racist genie from the bottle. Certain segments of his supporters may interpret it as a licence to resort to actual violence, and history has precedent for it.
paras.zh: 他是首相，他的言行举止很重要。当他使这种语言合法化和正常化时，他就从瓶子里释放了种族主义精灵。他的某些支持者可能会将其解读为诉诸实际暴力的许可，历史上有这样的先例。

paras.en: Accusing all 19 elected members of the Knesset (MKs) representing predominantly Palestinian citizens of Israel, individually and collectively, of being supporters of terrorism and terrorists, while portraying those members of the Jewish/Zionist parties prepared to form a coalition with them as, for all intents and purposes, collaborators with those who support terrorism against Jews and seek the destruction of the “Jewish state”, amounts to declaring open season on them. In doing so, Netanyahu is abusing the protection afforded to him by his parliamentary immunity, making allegations for which there is not a shred of truth.
paras.zh: 指责主要代表以色列巴勒斯坦公民的所有 19 名以色列议会民选议员（MKs）无论是个人还是集体都是恐怖主义和恐怖分子的支持者，同时将那些准备与他们结成联盟的犹太/犹太复国主义政党成员描绘成无论出于何种意图和目的，都与那些支持针对犹太人的恐怖主义并寻求摧毁“犹太国家”的人合作的人，无异于宣布对他们开放。内塔尼亚胡这样做是滥用议会豁免权为他提供的保护，提出毫无事实依据的指控。

paras.en: If anyone should know better, learn from his past mistakes and express profound remorse for such behaviour, it is Benjamin Netanyahu. No one is more closely associated with the atmosphere of incitement that preceded the assassination of Israeli Prime Minister Yitzhak Rabin on November 4, 1995 than Netanyahu.
paras.zh: 如果有人应该更了解、从过去的错误中吸取教训并对这种行为表示深刻的悔恨，那就是本杰明·内塔尼亚胡。没有人比内塔尼亚胡更与 1995 年 11 月 4 日以色列总理伊扎克·拉宾被暗杀之前的煽动气氛联系在一起。

paras.en: Rabin became the principal target of the Israeli right’s hatred after signing the Oslo Accords – in other words, for demonstrating the courage to pursue a peaceful end to the conflict between Israelis and Palestinians. The religious-messianic right, including several rabbis, issued a ruling known as din rodef (the law of the pursuer) against Rabin, accusing him of “ceding parts of the Land of Israel to Gentiles”. Yigal Amir, Rabin’s eventual assassin, cited this ruling as justification for his heinous crime. Amir pulled the trigger, but those who orchestrated and fed the campaign of hatred against Rabin bear considerable responsibility too, at the very least morally.
paras.zh: 签署《奥斯陆协议》后，拉宾成为以色列右翼仇恨的主要目标 — — 换句话说，是因为他表现出了追求和平结束以色列和巴勒斯坦之间冲突的勇气。包括几位拉比在内的宗教弥赛亚右派针对拉宾发布了一项名为“din rodef”（追捕者法则）的裁决，指责他“将以色列的部分土地割让给外邦人”。最终刺杀拉宾的伊格尔·阿米尔(Yigal Amir)引用这一裁决作为他犯下滔天罪行的理由。阿米尔扣动了扳机，但那些策划和煽动针对拉宾的仇恨运动的人也承担着相当大的责任，至少在道义上如此。

paras.en: Netanyahu, who was chairman of the Likud party and leader of the opposition at the time, not only failed to condemn this behaviour but notoriously participated in a protest in Jerusalem during which Rabin’s image was portrayed in a Nazi uniform. Rabin’s widow, Leah, later recalled: “There was a Likud rally in Jerusalem not too long ago. They put the figure of Yitzhak, my husband, in the uniform of a Nazi leader and Mr Netanyahu was there. He later talked against it, but he was there, and he didn’t stop it.”
paras.zh: 时任利库德集团主席和反对派领袖的内塔尼亚胡不仅没有谴责这种行为，反而臭名昭著地参加了耶路撒冷的抗议活动，抗议活动中拉宾的形象被描绘成穿着纳粹制服。拉宾的遗孀利亚后来回忆道：“不久前，耶路撒冷举行了一次利库德集团集会。他们把我丈夫伊扎克的雕像穿上了纳粹领导人的制服，内塔尼亚胡先生也在场。他后来发表了反对言论，但他就在那里，而且他没有阻止。”

paras.en: She never forgave him for that. He never apologised or expressed regret.
paras.zh: 为此她始终没有原谅他。他从未道歉或表示遗憾。

paras.en: Several months later, Netanyahu was elected prime minister. Perhaps, in his mind, this electoral victory exonerated him from any responsibility for creating the atmosphere that led to Rabin’s assassination. It may also have reinforced his belief that divisive politics pays off and can take him where he has always felt he belongs: The prime minister’s office.
paras.zh: 几个月后，内塔尼亚胡当选总理。也许，在他看来，这次选举的胜利使他免除了制造导致拉宾被暗杀的气氛的任何责任。这也可能强化了他的信念，即分裂政治会带来回报，并可以把他带到他一直认为属于自己的地方：总理办公室。

paras.en: Now, caught between a sense of entitlement to remain in power that appears stronger than ever and the fear that relinquishing office could jeopardise his efforts to prevent his corruption trial from reaching its conclusion, Netanyahu is allowing racial hatred to pour out of him unabated.
paras.zh: 现在，内塔尼亚胡夹在一种似乎比以往任何时候都更强烈的继续掌权的感觉和担心放弃公职可能会危及他阻止腐败审判得出结论的努力之间，任由种族仇恨有增无减地从他身上倾泻而出。

paras.en: It began during the election campaign, when he foresaw that his chances of forming the next government were slim. It escalated dramatically on election day, when he once again resorted to his vile dog-whistle tactics in a last-ditch attempt to mobilise his supporters. He warned of surging Arab voter turnout and, by that, at least implicitly questioned the legitimacy of their votes compared with the Jewish ones, as they couldn’t bear their success. But that was only the beginning. The day after the election, Netanyahu and his ultra-right-wing partners turned up the volume, raising allegations of irregularities in Arab communities to advance a narrative of a “stolen” election.
paras.zh: 这一切始于竞选期间，当时他预见到自己组建下一届政府的机会渺茫。在选举日，事态急剧升级，他再次采取卑鄙的狗哨策略，最后一搏试图动员他的支持者。他警告说，阿拉伯选民的投票率不断上升，并且至少含蓄地质疑了他们与犹太人相比投票的合法性，因为他们无法忍受自己的成功。但这只是开始。选举第二天，内塔尼亚胡和他的极右翼伙伴加大力度，提出对阿拉伯社区违规行为的指控，以宣扬选举“被盗”的说法。

paras.en: Worse was to come. What should have been days of celebrating Israeli democracy, the swearing-in of the new Knesset, became another opportunity for Netanyahu to abuse his parliamentary privilege. Instead of delivering a speech that might have helped unite the nation after a bruising election campaign, he embarked on a jingoistic horror show.
paras.zh: 更糟糕的还在后面。本应庆祝以色列民主的日子，新议会的宣誓就职，却成为内塔尼亚胡滥用议会特权的另一个机会。在一场惨烈的竞选活动之后，他没有发表可能有助于团结全国的演讲，而是开始了一场沙文主义的恐怖表演。
