paras.en: He accused Gadi Eisenkot, whom President Isaac Herzog had tasked with forming a government because he enjoyed the support of a majority of MKs, and his political partners of seeking to establish a government dependent on parties that, according to Netanyahu, “agree that the Jewish state must be destroyed”. He went on to claim that these parties differed only over the kind of Palestinian state they wanted to see emerge from the ruins of the Jewish state: “Whether an Islamic state in the Muslim Brotherhood mould, like Hamas in Gaza, or a nationalist Palestinian state in the Fatah mould. That is the whole difference.”
paras.zh: 他指责加迪·艾森科特（艾萨克·赫尔佐格总统委托他组建政府，因为他得到了大多数MK的支持），他指责他的政治伙伴寻求建立一个依赖政党的政府，据内塔尼亚胡称，这些政党“同意必须摧毁犹太国家”。他接着声称，这些政党的分歧仅在于他们希望看到什么样的巴勒斯坦国从犹太国家的废墟中崛起：“无论是穆斯林兄弟会模式下的伊斯兰国家，如加沙的哈马斯，还是法塔赫模式下的民族主义巴勒斯坦国。这就是全部区别。”

paras.en: This amounts to nothing less than portraying Arab political representatives as a fifth column or traitors, while depicting those prepared to form a government with them as collaborators with this supposed ambition, or as dangerously naive for failing to recognise it.
paras.zh: 这无异于将阿拉伯政治代表描绘成第五纵队或叛徒，同时将那些准备与他们组成政府的人描绘成具有这种所谓野心的合作者，或者描绘成因未能认识到这一野心而危险地天真。

paras.en: When Netanyahu and his political partners insist that their accusations are not directed at the Arab population, even though Arab citizens had voted in record numbers for these very parties only days earlier, they are either playing innocent or insulting the intelligence of both Arab citizens and the wider public.
paras.zh: 当内塔尼亚胡和他的政治伙伴坚称他们的指控不是针对阿拉伯民众时，尽管几天前阿拉伯公民为这些政党投票的人数创下了纪录，但他们要么装无辜，要么侮辱阿拉伯公民和广大公众的智商。

paras.en: Not so long ago, Netanyahu himself offered Mansour Abbas and his Ra’am party the opportunity to join his own government when it suited his political interests. Yet when his rivals contemplate doing precisely the same thing, he shamelessly incites against them.
paras.zh: 不久前，内塔尼亚胡本人向曼苏尔·阿巴斯和他的拉姆党提供了在符合他的政治利益时加入他自己的政府的机会。然而，当他的竞争对手考虑做同样的事情时，他却无耻地煽动反对他们。

paras.en: Let us not forget that Netanyahu is the politician who legitimised the messianic far right and normalised sharing power with its representatives in government. He appointed Itamar Ben-Gvir, who had been convicted of incitement to racism and supporting a terrorist organisation, as minister of national security. This is the same Ben-Gvir who first gained notoriety by stealing the emblem from the car of then-Prime Minister Yitzhak Rabin, displaying it on television and declaring: “We got to his car, and we’ll get to him too.” Netanyahu is opportunistic and cynical to the very end, but by now the distinction between him and the Kahanist Ben-Gvir has become paper-thin.
paras.zh: 我们不要忘记，内塔尼亚胡是一位使弥赛亚极右翼合法化并使其与政府代表分享权力正常化的政治家。他任命因煽动种族主义和支持恐怖组织罪而被定罪的伊塔马尔·本·格维尔（Itamar Ben-Gvir）担任国家安全部长。这就是本-格维尔，他首先从时任总理伊扎克·拉宾的车上偷走了徽章，将其展示在电视上，并宣称：“我们找到了他的车，我们也会找到他。”内塔尼亚胡自始至终都是机会主义者和愤世嫉俗者，但现在他和卡汉主义者本-格维尔之间的区别已经变得微不足道。

paras.en: The warning signs are there, written on the wall in capital letters. The incitement of 1995 helped create the atmosphere that led to Rabin’s assassination. The scale and intensity of today’s incitement could once again lead an extremist zealot to pull the trigger, this time against an Arab or Jewish politician seeking to work with Arab political representatives. It could also encourage attacks against Arab citizens, potentially escalating into widespread communal violence or even civil war, as extremists convince themselves that they are acting in accordance with their leader’s wishes to prevent the supposed destruction of the Jewish state.
paras.zh: 警告标志就在那里，用大写字母写在墙上。 1995 年的煽动活动营造了导致拉宾被暗杀的气氛。今天煽动的规模和强度可能会再次导致极端主义狂热分子扣动扳机，这次是针对寻求与阿拉伯政治代表合作的阿拉伯或犹太政治家。它还可能鼓励针对阿拉伯公民的袭击，有可能升级为广泛的社区暴力甚至内战，因为极端分子说服自己，他们正在按照领导人的意愿行事，以防止犹太国家被所谓的毁灭。

paras.en: Israel is on the brink of political violence. And Benjamin Netanyahu bears a very substantial share of the responsibility for bringing it there.
paras.zh: 以色列正处于政治暴力的边缘。本杰明·内塔尼亚胡对实现这一目标负有重大责任。

paras.en: The views expressed in this article are the author’s own and do not necessarily reflect Al Jazeera’s editorial stance.
paras.zh: 本文表达的观点是作者自己的观点，并不一定反映半岛电视台的编辑立场。

articles.title: Sudan’s war will end, but will it be too late?

paras.en: It has been more than three years since war erupted in Sudan, and its consequences continue to worsen. More people continue to be displaced and require basic humanitarian assistance to survive. On the surface, the conflict appears set to continue indefinitely.
paras.zh: 苏丹战争爆发已三年多，其后果还在不断恶化。越来越多的人继续流离失所，需要基本的人道主义援助才能生存。从表面上看，冲突似乎将无限期地持续下去。

paras.en: At a recent Security Council briefing, a United Nations official noted: “The picture is bleak. … The parties continue to show no credible commitment to compromise or to pursuing a negotiated pause in fighting. They are not moving closer to dialogue.”
paras.zh: 在最近的安理会简报中，一名联合国官员指出：“形势一片黯淡。……双方仍然没有表现出任何妥协或通过谈判暂停战斗的可信承诺。他们没有向对话迈进。”

paras.en: This assessment reflects the international consensus so much so that the United States has chosen in recent months to heap sanction upon sanction in a bid to “raise the costs of continued conflict” for the warring sides and force them into ceasefire talks. But what the view from New York and Washington misses and what became obvious after only a few days in Khartoum this month is that the conditions for a ceasefire are rapidly emerging from within the country.
paras.zh: 这一评估在很大程度上反映了国际共识，以至于美国近几个月选择不断制裁，试图让交战双方“增加持续冲突的成本”，迫使他们进入停火谈判。但纽约和华盛顿的观点忽视了这一点，而本月在喀土穆仅几天后就变得明显的是，停火的条件正在该国内部迅速出现。

paras.en: A perfect storm of financial collapse, military advances and humanitarian catastrophe, along with growing civilian demands, is creating the long-elusive pressure for a ceasefire that could well take hold before the fourth anniversary of the war next April.
paras.zh: 金融崩溃、军事进步和人道主义灾难的完美风暴，加上不断增长的民用需求，正在为停火带来长期难以捉摸的压力，停火很可能在明年四月战争四周年之前实现。

paras.en: Khartoum, Sudan’s beleaguered capital, is no longer the ghost town that it was throughout much of the war. International flights now arrive regularly at the city’s modest airport from Cairo, Riyadh and Doha, carrying Sudanese looking to restart the lives the war put on hold and businessmen sensing a ceasefire on the horizon and angling to get in on the ground floor of the country’s rebirth. At one of the city’s leading business hotels, the lobby was buzzing with British, Swiss and Saudi business groups there to close deals on everything from mining to commodity trading to reconstruction.
paras.zh: 陷入困境的苏丹首都喀土穆已不再是战争期间的鬼城。现在，国际航班定期从开罗、利雅得和多哈抵达这座城市的简陋机场，载着希望重新开始战争搁置的生活的苏丹人，以及感受到停火即将到来并渴望进入该国重生底层的商人。在该市领先的商务酒店之一，大堂里挤满了英国、瑞士和沙特的商业团体，他们在洽谈从采矿到大宗商品交易再到重建等各个领域的交易。

paras.en: But Sudan’s leaders don’t just see the opportunities; they are also feeling the pressure of an economy in freefall. The week I was there, the Sudanese pound fell to a then-record low of 9,000 to the US dollar, compared with a pre-war average of 600. (The exchange rate now exceeds 10,000.) Petrol queues stretched for blocks, even for those lucky enough to be able to afford to fill their tanks. Many of Khartoum’s returnees, more than 2 million of the roughly 3.8 million people who fled, are struggling to buy groceries and keep the lights on. Worse still, farmers can no longer afford fertiliser, leaving much of the country’s most productive cropland lying fallow.
paras.zh: 但苏丹领导人不仅看到了机遇，还看到了机遇。他们还感受到了经济直线下滑的压力。我在那里的那一周，苏丹镑兑美元汇率跌至当时的历史新低 9,000 美元，而战前的平均汇率为 600 美元。（汇率现在超过 10,000。） 加油队排了好几个街区，即使对于那些足够幸运、有能力加油的人来说也是如此。大约 380 万逃离者中，有超过 200 万喀土穆返回者正在努力购买食品杂货并维持生计。更糟糕的是，农民再也买不起化肥，导致该国大部分生产力最高的农田处于休耕状态。

paras.en: A senior official acknowledged to me privately that the war economy, which enabled Sudan’s army to procure the weapons needed to turn the tide of the war, is now the greatest source of pain for the country’s population. The pressure on Sudan’s leaders to reverse the economic decline is real and is creating a new demand to end the fighting.
paras.zh: 一位高级官员私下向我承认，战争经济使苏丹军队能够采购扭转战局所需的武器，但现在却成为该国人民最大的痛苦根源。苏丹领导人面临着扭转经济衰退的真实压力，并且正在产生结束战斗的新要求。

paras.en: Friendly states like Turkiye and Saudi Arabia have pitched in, pursuing agreements to secure fuel supplies and rebuild energy infrastructure, but such support remains limited and temporary. Protests over transit costs recently broke out in Atbara, the northern city where protests against skyrocketing bread prices began in December 2018, helping to spark Sudan’s 2019 democratic revolution. Economic protests unified the country before and could do so again, and the military knows it.
paras.zh: 土耳其和沙特阿拉伯等友好国家已介入，寻求达成协议以确保燃料供应并重建能源基础设施，但此类支持仍然有限且暂时。北部城市阿特巴拉最近爆发了针对交通费用的抗议活动，该城市于 2018 年 12 月开始举行针对面包价格飙升的抗议活动，引发了苏丹 2019 年的民主革命。经济抗议以前曾团结过国家，而且可能会再次团结起来，军方也知道这一点。

paras.en: Beyond the economy, it is the military’s battlefield gains that are creating the conditions for it to contemplate a ceasefire. Army chief Abdel Fattah al-Burhan has promised to reclaim “every inch” of territory. He has succeeded in pushing back a new offensive in southeastern Sudan’s Blue Nile State and is advancing farther west in West Kordofan, where the army and its allied Joint Forces recently retook the strategic town of el-Khuwei and several surrounding areas, increasing the army’s control to roughly two-thirds of the country.
paras.zh: 除了经济之外，军方在战场上的胜利也为其考虑停火创造了条件。陆军参谋长阿卜杜勒·法塔赫·布尔汉承诺收复“每一寸”领土。他成功击退了苏丹东南部青尼罗州的新攻势，并在西科尔多凡州进一步向西推进，军队及其盟军联合部队最近在那里夺回了战略重镇胡韦和周边几个地区，将军队的控制权扩大到了该国约三分之二的地区。

paras.en: Fighting for control of the western region of Darfur, the only region almost entirely under the control of the Rapid Support Forces (RSF) paramilitary, could be costly and time-consuming. But a year after the fall of el-Fasher, the capital of North Darfur State, to the RSF amid atrocities that a UN fact-finding mission said bore the hallmarks of genocide, efforts to retake the area would demonstrate that the military’s commitment to unify the country wasn’t just battlefield bravado. Making inroads in Darfur would also paint the RSF into a corner and give the army both tactical gains and a strategic advantage in ceasefire discussions.
paras.zh: 达尔富尔西部地区是唯一几乎完全由快速支援部队（RSF）准军事部队控制的地区，争夺该地区的控制权可能代价高昂且耗时。但在北达尔富尔州首府法希尔被无国界医生占领一年后，联合国实况调查团称这些暴行带有种族灭绝的特征，夺回该地区的努力将表明，军方对统一国家的承诺不仅仅是战场上的虚张声势。在达尔富尔取得进展也会将无国界医生组织逼入绝境，并为军队在停火谈判中带来战术收益和战略优势。

paras.en: The final reason why a ceasefire has become so urgent is the spiralling humanitarian crisis in the country, which has been at crisis levels for months but could well become catastrophic by year’s end. Adding to the internal displacement, restrictions on humanitarian access and lost food production is this year’s “Super El Nino”, which has disrupted Sudan’s annual rains and devastated whatever meagre harvest was expected.
paras.zh: 停火变得如此紧迫的最后一个原因是该国不断加剧的人道主义危机，几个月来一直处于危机水平，但到年底很可能会变成灾难性的。今年的“超级厄尔尼诺”现象加剧了国内流离失所、人道主义援助准入受到限制以及粮食生产损失，它扰乱了苏丹的年度降雨量，并摧毁了原本微薄的收成。

paras.en: With more than 40 percent of the population already facing “acute food insecurity”, according to the Integrated Food Security Phase Classification hunger monitor, projections suggested that Sudan’s hunger crisis could deteriorate dramatically by mid-2027 when food shortages are expected to be at their most severe. The only way to avoid or even mitigate that outcome would be through a ceasefire in the coming months that enables a massive influx of lifesaving aid.
paras.zh: 根据综合粮食安全阶段分类饥饿监测仪，超过 40% 的人口已经面临“严重粮食不安全”，预测表明，到 2027 年中期，苏丹的饥饿危机可能会急剧恶化，届时粮食短缺预计将达到最严重的程度。避免甚至减轻这种结果的唯一方法是在未来几个月内实现停火，从而使救生援助大量涌入。

paras.en: As conditions on the ground make a ceasefire more urgent, Sudan’s own plans for the day after the fighting are becoming clearer. With each ceasefire proposal the military rejects, public demand for a deal grows as people become increasingly exhausted by the war.
paras.zh: 随着当地局势使停火变得更加紧迫，苏丹自己在战斗结束后的第二天的计划也变得更加明确。随着军方每一次拒绝停火提议，随着人们因战争而变得越来越疲惫，公众对达成协议的要求也随之增加。

paras.en: Talk of an inter-Sudanese dialogue, political reconciliation and eventually elections is also becoming more common, creating greater expectations that fighting should soon come to an end and responsibility for day-to-day governance and service delivery be transferred to civilians. While these efforts remain inchoate, the demand for them is building.
paras.zh: 关于苏丹人之间对话、政治和解以及最终选举的讨论也变得越来越普遍，人们更加期望战斗能够很快结束，并将日常治理和服务提供的责任转移给平民。虽然这些努力仍处于起步阶段，但对它们的需求正在增加。

paras.en: Ultimately, it is the attitudes inside Sudan that will create the momentum for peace, not the external pressures and punitive measures employed by the international community. As conditions for civilians inside the country continue to deteriorate and the military’s position stabilises, there is hope on the horizon that a ceasefire could be achieved. The international community should focus on supporting these internal conditions before the dire warnings about the economy and humanitarian situation become reality.
paras.zh: 最终，苏丹内部的态度将创造和平的动力，而不是外部压力和国际社会采取的惩罚措施。随着该国境内平民的处境持续恶化以及军方立场的稳定，停火有望实现。在有关经济和人道主义局势的可怕警告成为现实之前，国际社会应集中精力支持这些内部状况。

paras.en: A version of this article first appeared on Al Jazeera Arabic.
paras.zh: 本文的一个版本首先出现在半岛电视台阿拉伯语上。

articles.title: The U.K. and EU hold a rare summit to strengthen ties
articles.author: The Associated Press

paras.en: The U.K. and EU hold a rare summit to strengthen ties
paras.zh: 英国和欧盟举行罕见峰会以加强关系

paras.en: BRUSSELS — A decade after the people of Britain voted to leave the European Union, top EU officials are meeting with Prime Minister Andy Burnham on Friday, looking to mend more fences, and just perhaps, to pave the way for them to get back together.
paras.zh: 布鲁塞尔——英国人民公投脱欧十年后，欧盟高级官员将于周五与英国首相安迪·伯纳姆会面，寻求修补更多的隔阂，或许也为他们重归于好铺平道路。

paras.en: Burnham is scheduled to hold just under an hour of talks in Brussels with European Council President António Costa and European Commission President Ursula von der Leyen. Then they'll all meet in a plenary session with U.K. government ministers and European commissioners.
paras.zh: 伯纳姆计划在布鲁塞尔与欧洲理事会主席安东尼奥·科斯塔和欧盟委员会主席乌苏拉·冯德莱恩举行不到一个小时的会谈。然后他们将在全体会议上与英国政府部长和欧盟委员会面。

paras.en: Burnham has described the rare EU-U.K. summit — only the second since Britain became the first country to leave the world's biggest trading bloc — as a step toward undoing a decade of damage caused by the divorce.
paras.zh: 伯纳姆描述了罕见的欧盟-英国关系。这次峰会是自英国成为第一个离开世界最大贸易集团以来的第二次峰会，这是弥补脱欧造成的十年损害的一步。

paras.en: "The Brexit we were given has not worked. We have lost more than we gained," he said this week.
paras.zh: “我们获得的英国脱欧并没有奏效。我们失去的比得到的更多，”他本周表示。

paras.en: Burnham has said all options should be on the table for future relations, including rejoining the now-27-nation bloc. But he's stressed that reversing Brexit is just one possible outcome, and far from imminent. It would need the backing not just of British voters, but the unanimous support of a mistrustful EU. Still, he has broken a long political code of silence on the option of rejoining.
paras.zh: 伯纳姆表示，未来关系的所有选择都应该摆在桌面上，包括重新加入目前由 27 个国家组成的集团。但他强调，逆转脱欧只是一种可能的结果，而且远非迫在眉睫。它不仅需要英国选民的支持，还需要不信任的欧盟的一致支持。尽管如此，他还是打破了长期以来对重新加入的选择保持沉默的政治守则。

paras.en: Ahead of the meeting, von der Leyen said she wanted it to be "a summit of ambition and concrete results. More opportunities for young people. Easier agrifood trade. And a stronger cooperation on economic security."
paras.zh: 会议前，冯德莱恩表示，她希望这是“一次雄心勃勃、取得具体成果的峰会。为年轻人提供更多机会。农产品贸易更加便利。并在经济安全方面加强合作。”

paras.en: Burnham pitched the package of agreements expected to be signed Friday as a way of "cutting costs, keeping prices down in the supermarkets and creating opportunities for young people."
paras.zh: 伯纳姆提出预计将于周五签署的一揽子协议是“削减成本、压低超市价格并为年轻人创造机会”的一种方式。

paras.en: He said "a closer partnership with Europe is good for working people, good for Britain and good for Europe."
paras.zh: 他表示，“与欧洲建立更紧密的伙伴关系有利于劳动人民、有利于英国、也有利于欧洲。”

paras.en: The deals are set to include an agreement for up to 100,000 young adults from Britain to live and work in EU countries for up to three years, and the same number of Europeans to come to the U.K.
paras.zh: 这些协议将包括一项协议，允许多达 10 万名英国年轻人在欧盟国家生活和工作长达三年，以及同等数量的欧洲人来英国。

paras.en: There will also be an emissions trading agreement and a deal to remove checks on food and agricultural products that will make things cheaper and easier for British exporters to Europe. Burnham says the deals could add a modest 0.4% to Britain's economy.
paras.zh: 还将达成一项排放贸易协议以及一项取消食品和农产品检查的协议，这将使英国出口商向欧洲出口的产品变得更便宜、更容易。伯纳姆表示，这些交易可能会给英国经济带来 0.4% 的适度增长。

paras.en: To get the deals, the U.K. must accept some EU rules and standards that it has no role in setting. Supporters of Brexit say that undermines Britain's independence.
paras.zh: 为了达成这些协议，英国必须接受一些欧盟规则和标准，而英国并没有参与制定这些规则和标准。英国脱欧的支持者表示，这损害了英国的独立性。

paras.en: "I'm afraid that the great Brexit debate has just started again," Reform UK leader Nigel Farage told the BBC. He said "it's perfectly clear that this very, very soon becomes a debate about: do we rejoin or do we stay out?"
paras.zh: 英国改革党领袖奈杰尔·法拉奇对英国广播公司表示：“恐怕英国脱欧大辩论才刚刚开始。”他说：“很明显，这很快就会成为一场争论：我们是重新加入还是退出？”

paras.en: The war in Ukraine, and the U.K.'s military strength, are drawing the two back together, and the summit provides the EU with an opportunity to discuss stronger cooperation on security and defense, as well as efforts to restrict irregular migration.
paras.zh: 乌克兰战争和英国的军事实力正在将两国拉回到一起，这次峰会为欧盟提供了一个机会来讨论加强安全和防务合作以及限制非正常移民的努力。

paras.en: "Our security and prosperity are closely intertwined, making a strong partnership between us essential," Costa said ahead of the meeting. "By deepening our cooperation, we can strengthen our ability to address the challenges of our time, strengthen our resilience and promote stability in Europe and beyond."
paras.zh: 科斯塔在会议前表示：“我们的安全与繁荣紧密相连，因此我们之间建立强有力的伙伴关系至关重要。” “通过深化合作，我们可以增强应对时代挑战的能力，增强我们的韧性并促进欧洲及其他地区的稳定。”

paras.en: Nevertheless, feelings remain raw, and EU officials have been reluctant to encourage talk of the U.K. rejoining. They are weary from the shifting demands of seven British prime ministers over the last decade and want real clarity about the country's intentions.
paras.zh: 尽管如此，人们的情绪仍然很敏感，欧盟官员一直不愿鼓励英国重新加入欧盟的讨论。他们对过去十年七位英国首相不断变化的要求感到厌倦，希望真正明确该国的意图。

paras.en: Ireland's ambassador in London, Sonja Hyland, said that when Britain voted for Brexit, "there was a lack of clarity as to exactly what that meant." If Britain wants to reopen negotiations, she said, it must "make a clear decision as to what it wants."
paras.zh: 爱尔兰驻伦敦大使索尼娅·海兰表示，当英国投票支持脱欧时，“人们并不清楚这到底意味着什么。”她说，如果英国想重新启动谈判，就必须“就自己想要什么做出明确的决定”。

articles.title: Another day of survival for a family in Ukraine
articles.author: Eleanor Beardsley

paras.en: Another day of survival for a family in Ukraine
paras.zh: 乌克兰一个家庭又度过了生存的一天

paras.en: On the outskirts of Kyiv, one family prepares for the fifth winter of war against Russia — stockpiling food and fuel and trying to maintain as much a sense of normalcy as possible.
paras.zh: 在基辅郊区，一个家庭正在为针对俄罗斯的第五个冬天的战争做准备——储存食物和燃料，并试图尽可能保持正常的感觉。

paras.en: For a fifth straight winter, Ukrainians fully expect that Russia will again attack their already weakened energy grid in an effort to break their will. But many Ukrainians are more determined than ever to hold on. NPR's Eleanor Beardsley spent time with one family outside Kyiv that has equipped itself for the worst.
paras.zh: 连续第五个冬天，乌克兰人完全预计俄罗斯将再次攻击他们本已脆弱的能源网，试图摧毁他们的意志。但许多乌克兰人比以往任何时候都更有决心坚持下去。美国国家公共广播电台 (NPR) 的埃莉诺·比尔兹利 (Eleanor Beardsley) 采访了基辅郊外的一个家庭，该家庭已做好应对最坏情况的准备。

paras.en: UNIDENTIFIED PERSON: (Non-English language spoken).
paras.zh: 身份不明的人：（非英语语言）。

paras.en: ELEANOR BEARDSLEY, BYLINE: It's dinner time at the Pavlenco household in the town of Irpin just north of Kyiv. The power is out and, the streets are dark across most of the Kyiv region. But the Pavlenco duplex is a pocket of warmth and light as parents Roman and Tanya make dinner.
paras.zh: 埃莉诺·比尔兹利连线：现在是基辅北部伊尔平镇帕夫伦科家的晚餐时间。基辅地区大部分地区停电，街道一片漆黑。但帕夫伦科复式公寓却充满了温暖和明亮，父母罗曼和坦尼娅正在做饭。

paras.en: TANYA: From aubergine, tomato and onion...
paras.zh: TANYA：来自茄子、番茄和洋葱……

paras.en: BEARDSLEY: Eggplant, mashed potatoes and pickled tomatoes from Roman's father's garden in Moldova. Roman, a doctor, now sells medical equipment. He's been in Ukraine for two decades, but he was born in Moldova on Ukraine's southwest border, which means he does not have to serve in Ukraine's military. So the family could leave the country, but they choose to stay.
paras.zh: 比尔兹利：来自罗曼父亲摩尔多瓦花园的茄子、土豆泥和腌西红柿。罗曼是一名医生，现在销售医疗设备。他已经在乌克兰生活了二十年，但他出生在乌克兰西南边境的摩尔多瓦，这意味着他不必在乌克兰军队服役。所以一家人可以离开这个国家，但他们选择留下来。

paras.en: ROMAN: We are still at home. We are still in our country. I really trust that our country will survive, and I want that my children will live here because I want that my children will grow up like Ukrainians. They should study here because if they will be there in Europe, they are not will be Ukrainians.
paras.zh: 罗曼：我们还在家里。我们还在我们的国家。我真的相信我们的国家能够生存下来，我希望我的孩子们能够生活在这里，因为我希望我的孩子们能够像乌克兰人一样成长。他们应该在这里学习，因为如果他们去欧洲，他们就不会是乌克兰人。

paras.en: TANYA: Yes, it's the right choice because my children have good teachers here and music school and coach, sports coach, and the education here is very good.
paras.zh: TANYA：是的，这是正确的选择，因为我的孩子在这里有很好的老师，还有音乐学校和教练、体育教练，而且这里的教育非常好。

paras.en: BEARDSLEY: And they are ready for this fifth winter of war. We go to the basement for a look.
paras.zh: 比尔兹利：他们已经为战争的第五个冬天做好了准备。我们去地下室看看。

paras.en: BEARDSLEY: Lodged between the washer and dryer is a massive electrical system with batteries called an inverter that is connected to several energy sources and toggles between them.
paras.zh: BEARDSLEY：位于洗衣机和烘干机之间的是一个带有电池的大型电气系统，称为逆变器，它连接到多个能源并在它们之间切换。

paras.en: ROMAN: I have the whole system. I have the solar panels on my roof. Another thing is batteries here. Thirdly, I have a grid electricity from the central electricity. Three sources - in the day from the sun, in the night from the batteries, and if we have from the central, we use that one.
paras.zh: 罗曼：我有整个系统。我的屋顶上有太阳能电池板。另一件事是这里的电池。第三，我有中央电力的电网电力。三种来源——白天来自太阳，晚上来自电池，如果我们有来自中央的来源，我们就使用那个来源。

paras.en: BEARDSLEY: They also have a fireplace, a generator and a giant battery for appliances called an EcoFlow. He says most of their neighbors are also well-equipped, but the family knows they are luckier than people living in high-rises with lower incomes.
paras.zh: BEARDSLEY：他们还有一个壁炉、一台发电机和一个名为 EcoFlow 的巨型电池。他说，他们的大多数邻居也装备精良，但家人知道他们比住在高楼里收入较低的人幸运。

paras.en: ROMAN: ...The gas cylinder. It's full of gas, and this is the...
paras.zh: 罗马：……气瓶。里面充满了气体，这就是……

paras.en: BEARDSLEY: And a gas camping stove. Another room in the basement is stocked with canned goods, and there's a bedroom down here for when the shelling ramps up.
paras.zh: 比尔兹利：还有野营燃气炉。地下室的另一个房间里堆满了罐头食品，下面还有一间卧室，供炮击升级时使用。

paras.en: TANYA: We know what we need - how many food, how many clothes, gas and so on - and we are ready.
paras.zh: TANYA：我们知道我们需要什么——多少食物、多少衣服、汽油等等——我们已经准备好了。

paras.en: BEARDSLEY: They slept in their basement bunker frequently this fall as Russia used its new jet-powered drones to attack. Ukraine no longer has enough interceptors to stop all the missiles. Tanya says, their 11-year-old now wants to sleep with them so she can hold her mother's hand at night. She says she does worry about long-term emotional effects of the war.
paras.zh: 比尔兹利：今年秋天，当俄罗斯使用其新型喷气式无人机进行攻击时，他们经常睡在地下室掩体中。乌克兰不再拥有足够的拦截器来阻止所有导弹。坦尼娅说，他们 11 岁的孩子现在想和他们一起睡觉，这样她就可以在晚上握住妈妈的手。她说她确实担心战争的长期情感影响。

paras.en: TANYA: But we try to provide them normal childhood with some birthday parties. They like to ski and visiting our friends in Europe.
paras.zh: TANYA：但我们尽力为他们提供一些生日聚会，让他们过上正常的童年。他们喜欢滑雪和拜访我们在欧洲的朋友。

paras.en: BEARDSLEY: Up in the family room, 15-year-old Ira and 11-year-old Katya play with their corgi, Lemon, before dinner.
paras.zh: 比尔兹利：晚餐前，15 岁的艾拉和 11 岁的卡蒂亚在客厅里和他们的柯基犬莱蒙玩耍。

paras.en: BEARDSLEY: They have started a new science and math school this year in Kyiv. Ira Pavlenco says she has to study a lot more than last year on top of everything else.
paras.zh: 比尔兹利：他们今年在基辅开设了一所新的科学和数学学校。艾拉·帕夫伦科 (Ira Pavlenco) 表示，除其他事项外，她还必须比去年多得多的学习。

paras.en: IRA PAVLENCO: It's really hard, I think, because of so many things that you have to do to learn and also air alarms. And I have new school, and it's, like, very difficult for me now.
paras.zh: IRA PAVLENCO：我认为这真的很难，因为你需要学习很多东西，还有空中警报。我有了新学校，现在对我来说非常困难。

paras.en: BEARDSLEY: She says she'll never forget that morning in February 2022 as Russian troops poured over the border from Belarus. It was two days before her 11th birthday.
paras.zh: 比尔兹利：她说她永远不会忘记 2022 年 2 月的那个早晨，俄罗斯军队从白俄罗斯涌入边境。距离她 11 岁生日还有两天。

paras.en: IRA: It was really suddenly, and we waked up at maybe 5 in the morning, and my mom and dad told me that we need to go somewhere now and pack your things and really quickly.
paras.zh: IRA：这真的很突然，我们大概早上 5 点就醒了，我的妈妈和爸爸告诉我，我们现在需要去某个地方，然后很快地收拾好东西。

paras.en: BEARDSLEY: In 2022, Irpin was on the front line and occupied for about three weeks by the Russians. Ukrainian forces retook the city, which became known as the Shield of Kyiv. The family fled to Moldova but returned a few months later, says Tanya.
paras.zh: 比尔兹利：2022 年，伊尔平位于前线，被俄罗斯人占领了大约三个星期。乌克兰军队夺回了这座城市，这座城市被称为“基辅之盾”。坦尼娅说，一家人逃到摩尔多瓦，但几个月后又回来了。

paras.en: TANYA: This is our home, and we want to come back, even it's quite dangerous.
paras.zh: TANYA：这是我们的家，我们想回来，即使它很危险。

paras.en: BEARDSLEY: Weekdays start at the crack of dawn, so evenings are short but full with piano practice, homework and dinner. I spend the night because of the curfew that's been in place since Russia's full-scale invasion. The next morning, Tanya walks Lemon at 6 a.m. in the pitch dark and rain. With her flashlight, she shows me some gouged marks on their neat brick street.
paras.zh: 比尔兹利：工作日从黎明时分开始，所以晚上很短，但充满了钢琴练习、作业和晚餐。我之所以过夜是因为自俄罗斯全面入侵以来一直实行宵禁。第二天早上 6 点，坦尼娅在漆黑、下着雨的情况下在莱蒙散步。她用手电筒向我展示了整洁的砖砌街道上的一些凿痕。

paras.en: TANYA: It's footprints of Russian tanks.
paras.zh: TANYA：这是俄罗斯坦克的脚印。

paras.en: BEARDSLEY: Their neighborhood was occupied by Russian forces. Many people were killed, she says. The roof of their house was damaged and windows blown out. She says the whole neighborhood had to be de-mined.
paras.zh: 比尔兹利：他们的社区被俄罗斯军队占领了。她说，很多人被杀。他们房子的屋顶被损坏，窗户被炸毁。她说整个街区都必须排雷。

paras.en: BEARDSLEY: Back at home, the girls are getting ready for school. The day begins with a check of the air raid alerts, says Roman.
paras.zh: 比尔兹利：回到家里，女孩们正在准备上学。罗曼说，这一天从检查空袭警报开始。

paras.en: ROMAN: We all have the application on our phones, and we know when we have alarm and when we have no. And we - usually we start at 7, 7-point-10 (ph), and we go to school.
paras.zh: ROMAN：我们的手机上都有这个应用程序，我们知道什么时候有警报，什么时候没有警报。而我们——通常我们在 7 点 7 点 10 分开始，然后去上学。

paras.en: BEARDSLEY: School begins at 8:30, but at 8 o'clock, the school decides whether classes will be in-person or online, depending on the security situation.
paras.zh: BEARDSLEY：学校8点30分开始上课，但到了8点，学校会根据安全情况决定是面授还是在线上课。

paras.en: BEARDSLEY: To get there on time with the traffic, they have to set off around 7, even if there is an ongoing alert.
paras.zh: BEARDSLEY：为了在交通堵塞的情况下准时到达那里，他们必须在 7 点左右出发，即使警报持续存在。

paras.en: BEARDSLEY: That's the case this morning, but we get the all-clear as we are heading out of Irpin towards Kyiv. The girls no longer bat an eye over these air raid sirens that have become such a part of daily life in Ukraine.
paras.zh: 比尔兹利：今天早上就是这种情况，但当我们从伊尔平前往基辅时，警报解除了。女孩们不再对这些已经成为乌克兰日常生活一部分的空袭警报眨眼。

paras.en: Driving through Kyiv's northern suburbs, we pass damaged buildings and high-rises with plywood over blown-out windows. The Pavlencos always keep a full tank of gas and a tourniquet in the car just in case it's needed. Because of the intense Russian attacks this fall, the girls are only now having regular in-person classes. Eleven-year-old Katya says she's glad to be back.
paras.zh: 我们开车穿过基辅北部郊区，经过受损的建筑物和高层建筑，窗户被炸毁，上面覆盖着胶合板。帕夫伦科一家总是在车里备满一箱汽油和一条止血带，以备不时之需。由于今年秋天俄罗斯发动了猛烈的袭击，女孩们现在才开始定期上课。十一岁的卡蒂亚说她很高兴能回来。

paras.en: BEARDSLEY: "I haven't really gotten to know my classmates yet, and I enjoy chatting with them," she says. "Even if it does mean getting up earlier. And the fifth grade has its own shelter, so we can hold lessons if we need to, even though the air is kind of stuffy down there."
paras.zh: 比尔兹利：“我还没有真正了解我的同学，但我喜欢和他们聊天，”她说。 “即使这确实意味着早起。五年级有自己的庇护所，所以如果需要的话我们可以上课，尽管那里的空气有点闷。”

paras.en: Suddenly, we've arrived at the girls' school.
paras.zh: 不知不觉，我们就到了女子学校。

paras.en: BEARDSLEY: And the Pavlenco sisters jump out of the car to attack a new day. Eleanor Beardsley, NPR News, Kyiv.
paras.zh: 比尔兹利：帕夫伦科姐妹跳下车迎接新的一天。埃莉诺·比尔兹利 (Eleanor Beardsley)，NPR 新闻，基辅。

articles.title: LSU women's basketball star MiLaysia Fulwiley faces only misdemeanor charges after arrest

paras.en: LSU women’s basketball player MiLaysia Fulwiley will face misdemeanor traffic citations stemming from a recent traffic incident.
paras.zh: 路易斯安那州立大学女子篮球运动员 MiLaysia Fulwiley 将因最近的一次交通事故而面临轻罪交通罚单。

paras.en: The felony charges included in her initial booking will now be pursued as misdemeanor counts, the East Baton Rouge District Attorney's Office confirmed Friday. Authorities allege Fulwiley attempted to evade officers during a traffic stop.
paras.zh: 东巴吞鲁日地区检察官办公室周五证实，她最初预订中包含的重罪指控现在将作为轻罪追究。当局称富尔威利在交通堵塞期间试图躲避警察。

paras.en: District Attorney Hillar Moore said fleeing and resisting an officer would be weighed as misdemeanors. Fulwiley will also be referred to a diversion program to resolve the charges. The initial charges listed at the time of Fulwiley’s booking included aggravated battery and assault, based on allegations that she drove her vehicle into an officer’s vehicle. Fulwiley has denied the police's account.
paras.zh: 地区检察官希拉尔摩尔表示，逃跑和抵抗警官将被视为轻罪。富尔威利还将被转介至一项转移计划来解决指控。富尔威利预订时列出的初步指控包括严重殴打和袭击，指控她驾驶自己的车辆撞向一名警官的车辆。富尔威利否认了警方的说法。

paras.en: State police captain Russell Graham said Friday that his agency reviewed evidence with Moore and agreed with his decision. "After a thorough review with all involved parties, the charges were amended based on the circumstances and evidence presented," State Police said in a written statement provided by Graham.
paras.zh: 州警察​​局长拉塞尔·格雷厄姆周五表示，他的机构与摩尔审查了证据并同意他的决定。州警方在格雷厄姆提供的一份书面声明中表示：“在与所有相关方进行彻底审查后，根据情况和提供的证据修改了指控。”

paras.en: Fulwiley has not appeared in a game for LSU since her arrest. It remains unclear whether she will return to the team.
paras.zh: 自从被捕后，富尔威利就没有参加过路易斯安那州立大学的比赛。目前还不清楚她是否会重返球队。

paras.en: Fulwiley apologized to police and her teammates.
paras.zh: 富尔威利向警方和她的队友道歉。

paras.en: "Saturday night ended in a situation that never should have happened," she said in a statement released by LSU. "I owe an apology to the officers involved and everyone who calls themselves a Tiger. I also want to apologize to my family and all those who love and support me."
paras.zh: “周六晚上以一种不应该发生的情况结束，”她在路易斯安那州立大学发布的一份声明中说。 “我向涉案警官和所有自称老虎的人道歉。我还要向我的家人以及所有爱我和支持我的人道歉。”

paras.en: The traffic stop happened near Tiger Stadium in Baton Rouge as the a football game between LSU and Texas was ending.
paras.zh: 当路易斯安那州立大学和德克萨斯州之间的一场足球比赛即将结束时，巴吞鲁日老虎体育场附近发生了交通堵塞。

paras.en: "Rules and laws apply to everyone, including the instructions of officers working a game night in Baton Rouge," Fulwiley said. "I respect the job those officers do, and I’ll let the legal process run its course. My focus is doing what this program asks of me and earning back the trust of the people who count on me."
paras.zh: “规则和法律适用于每个人，包括巴吞鲁日比赛之夜工作人员的指示，”富尔威利说。 “我尊重这些警官所做的工作，我会让法律程序顺利进行。我的重点是完成该计划要求我做的事情，并赢得那些依靠我的人的信任。”

paras.en: Fulwiley scored a season-high 23 points on Nov. 13 during LSU’s 101-37 win over the University of Denver.
paras.zh: 11 月 13 日，路易斯安那州立大学以 101-37 战胜丹佛大学的比赛中，富尔威利拿下赛季最高的 23 分。

paras.en: The Associated Press contributed to this report.
paras.zh: 美联社对此报道作出了贡献。

articles.title: Nick Saban names three teams above Alabama as college football's true national championship contenders

paras.en: Nick Saban isn't playing favorites. The former Alabama football head coach said he is not convinced this year’s team has what it takes to make a deep run in this year's College Football Playoff.
paras.zh: 尼克·萨班并没有偏心。这位前阿拉巴马州橄榄球主教练表示，他不相信今年的球队有能力在今年的大学橄榄球季后赛中取得长足的进步。

paras.en: During an appearance on "The Pat McAfee Show," Saban identified the teams he believes belong in a tier above the rest of the national championship hopefuls. The seven-time national championship-winning coach pointed to Georgia, Utah and Notre Dame as the teams he views as true contenders.
paras.zh: 在“帕特·麦卡菲秀”上露面时，萨班确定了他认为属于全国冠军候选者之上的球队。这位七次获得全国冠军的教练指出，乔治亚州、犹他州和圣母大学是他认为真正的竞争者。

paras.en: Alabama was notably not included in that group.
paras.zh: 阿拉巴马州显然不属于该组。

paras.en: "Me personally, I think there's three teams that have the right stuff," Saban said. "This is no disrespect to Alabama because I think there's probably seven or eight teams that could win the championship, Alabama being one of them, but if you're a betting man and you say, who can run the ball, who can play good defense, and who has a good quarterback?"
paras.zh: “就我个人而言，我认为三支球队拥有合适的东西，”萨班说。 “这并不是对阿拉巴马州的不尊重，因为我认为可能有七八支球队可以赢得冠军，阿拉巴马州就是其中之一，但如果你是一个赌徒，你会说，谁能跑球，谁能打出良好的防守，谁有一个好的四分卫？”

paras.en: Saban acknowledged that teams outside his top three could still make a run, but he believes each has a potential weakness to overcome.
paras.zh: 萨班承认，前三名之外的球队仍然可以晋级，但他相信每支球队都有一个潜在的弱点需要克服。

paras.en: "You would say Georgia has that, Utah has that. Notre Dame has that. Everybody else maybe has a flaw somewhere along the way. They might be able to overcome it, but I think those three teams have the right stuff."
paras.zh: “你会说佐治亚州有这个，犹他州有那个。圣母大学有那个。其他人可能在某个地方都有缺陷。他们也许能够克服它，但我认为这三支球队都有正确的东西。”

paras.en: Alabama has built a respectable resume this season. The Crimson Tide have knocked off two ranked teams, Kentucky and South Carolina. They also took Georgia down to the wire in a close loss at home. Since dropping games to the Bulldogs and the Tennessee Volunteers, Alabama has put together a three-game winning streak against SEC opponents.
paras.zh: 阿拉巴马州本赛季取得了令人尊敬的成绩。红潮队击败了两支排名靠前的球队：肯塔基州和南卡罗来纳州。他们还在主场以微弱的比分将乔治亚队逼到了最后关头。自从输给斗牛犬队和田纳西志愿者队以来，阿拉巴马州已经对 SEC 对手取得了三连胜。

paras.en: After the College Football Playoff selection committee released its third rankings earlier this week, chair Hunter Yurachek pointed to Alabama’s overall profile, including its margin of victory.
paras.zh: 在大学橄榄球季后赛选拔委员会本周早些时候发布第三次排名后，主席亨特·尤拉切克（Hunter Yurachek）指出了阿拉巴马州的整体概况，包括其获胜优势。

paras.en: "I think it's a collection of things for Alabama," Yurachek said. "Not only the margin of wins, their SEC wins, which is close to 23 points a game, but their relative scoring defense is in the top 20, relative scoring offense is in the top five, record strength is in the top 5. Quite honestly, when we watch them on film, when we watch their games, we really feel like they're one of the best three or four teams in the country."'
paras.zh: “我认为这是阿拉巴马州的一个集合，”尤拉切克说。 “不仅是胜率，他们的SEC胜利，场均得分接近23分，而且他们的防守相对得分排在前20名，进攻相对得分排在前5名，战绩实力排在前5名。说实话，当我们在电影中观看他们的比赛时，当我们观看他们的比赛时，我们真的感觉他们是全国最好的三四支球队之一。”

paras.en: While Saban offered his assessment Friday, Kalen DeBoer struck a more optimistic tone about Alabama in his third season leading the program.
paras.zh: 虽然萨班周五提出了他的评估，但卡伦·德波尔对阿拉巴马州在领导该项目的第三个赛季表现出了更为乐观的态度。

paras.en: "I feel like we're more complete as a football team and able to play anybody, anytime, anywhere," DeBoer said. "But you got to go do it."
paras.zh: “我觉得我们作为一支足球队更加完整，能够随时随地与任何人比赛，”德波尔说。 “但你必须去做。”

articles.title: Red Hot Chili Peppers drummer Chad Smith to join Wu-Tang Clan for Lions' Thanksgiving halftime show

paras.en: This Thanksgiving, NFL fans will once again have the opportunity to enjoy three games spread across the afternoon and evening.
paras.zh: 今年感恩节，NFL 球迷将再次有机会观看下午和晚上的三场比赛。

paras.en: The Detroit Lions will open the day with their traditional early afternoon matchup, hosting the Chicago Bears. The Cowboys will follow with their long-running home game in the late-afternoon window on Fox. The third game of the day will be played at the new Highmark Stadium, where the Buffalo Bills will host the Kansas City Chiefs.
paras.zh: 底特律雄狮队将在下午早些时候以传统的对阵芝加哥熊队的比赛拉开当天的序幕。牛仔队将在下午晚些时候在福克斯电视台进行他们长期的主场比赛。当天的第三场比赛将在新的海马克体育场举行，布法罗比尔队将在那里主场迎战堪萨斯城酋长队。

paras.en: Rock & Roll Hall of Fame inductees Wu-Tang Clan will headline the Lions-Bears halftime show.
paras.zh: 入选摇滚名人堂的武当派将成为狮熊队中场表演的主角。

paras.en: The legendary hip-hop group will be joined by Red Hot Chili Peppers drummer Chad Smith.
paras.zh: 红辣椒乐队鼓手查德·史密斯将加入这个传奇嘻哈乐队。

paras.en: The Lions announced Smith’s special guest appearance Friday.
paras.zh: 狮子队周五宣布史密斯将作为特邀嘉宾亮相。

paras.en: Detroit rapper Eminem and his manager, Paul Rosenberg, serves as the executive producers of the Lions’ Thanksgiving Day halftime show.
paras.zh: 底特律说唱歌手埃米纳姆和他的经纪人保罗·罗森伯格担任狮子队感恩节中场表演的执行制片人。

paras.en: Friday’s announcement marked the second year of their three-year deal to oversee the event. Last year’s performance featured Jack White and a surprise appearance by Eminem.
paras.zh: 周五的宣布标志着他们监督这项赛事的三年协议的第二年。去年的演出有杰克·怀特 (Jack White) 和埃米纳姆 (Eminem) 的惊喜亮相。

paras.en: The Lions have been an NFL Thanksgiving Day staple nearly every season since 1934.
paras.zh: 自 1934 年以来，狮子队几乎每个赛季都是 NFL 感恩节的主打比赛。

paras.en: Country music artist Miranda Lambert is scheduled to put on a show at the Cowboys-Eagles matchup later that afternoon.
paras.zh: 乡村音乐艺术家米兰达·兰伯特计划于当天下午晚些时候在牛仔队与老鹰队的比赛中进行表演。

paras.en: Last month, the Bills announced the Goo Goo Dolls will perform during halftime of their Thanksgiving night game on Nov. 26. The rock band was originally formed in Buffalo.
paras.zh: 上个月，比尔队宣布 Goo Goo Dolls 将在 11 月 26 日感恩节之夜比赛的中场休息期间进行表演。这支摇滚乐队最初是在布法罗组建的。

paras.en: "The Goo Goo Dolls halftime performance will take place on the Bills Legends Deck, creating a unique concert experience that can be seen throughout the stadium," the Bills said in a statement. "Fans will also receive PixMob light-up bracelets at their seats, transforming the crowd into an interactive part of the show with synchronized lighting effects throughout Highmark Stadium."
paras.zh: 比尔队在一份声明中表示：“Goo Goo Dolls 中场表演将在 Bills Legends Deck 上进行，创造一种在整个体育场都能看到的独特音乐会体验。” “球迷们还将在座位上收到 PixMob 发光手环，将人群变成表演的互动部分，整个海马克体育场的灯光效果同步。”

articles.title: Teenager allegedly organised arsons and kidnapping on Signal during Melbourne hospitality wars
articles.author: Nino Bucci

paras.en: Victorian police allege a 17-year-old boy tasked others to carry out a series of arsons, home invasions and a mistaken identity kidnapping that resulted in the partial amputation of a victim’s finger during Melbourne’s hospitality wars.
paras.zh: 维州警方称，一名 17 岁男孩指使他人实施一系列纵火、入室盗窃和错误的身份绑架，导致一名受害者的手指在墨尔本的招待战中被部分截肢。

paras.en: The boy, who was arrested on Friday afternoon, allegedly communicated with the offenders under the username “Onepercent” on the encrypted communications app Signal.
paras.zh: 这名男孩于周五下午被捕，据称他在加密通讯应用程序 Signal 上使用用户名“Onepercent”与罪犯进行交流。

paras.en: He was charged on Saturday with extortion, making threats to kill, three offences of criminal damage by fire, and home invasion. He was remanded to appear in court later on Saturday.
paras.zh: 周六，他被指控犯有敲诈勒索、威胁杀人、三项刑事毁坏罪和入室盗窃罪。他被还押并于周六晚些时候出庭。

paras.en: In a statement, police said it would be alleged that Onepercent was involved in tasking an arson at a York Street, South Melbourne licensed premises on 15 April; two home invasions and a kidnapping four days apart in Springvale later that month; and two arson attacks during March at a Williamstown ice-cream store and a car in Moonee Ponds.
paras.zh: 警方在一份声明中表示，据称 Onepercent 参与了 4 月 15 日在南墨尔本约克街一处有执照的场所纵火；当月晚些时候，斯普林维尔发生了两起入室盗窃案和一起绑架案，相隔四天； 3 月份，威廉斯敦一家冰淇淋店和 Moonee Ponds 的一辆汽车发生了两起纵火袭击事件。

paras.en: The boy was arrested at a house in the Moonee Ponds region, in Melbourne’s north-west, police said.
paras.zh: 警方称，这名男孩是在墨尔本西北部 Moonee Ponds 地区的一所房子里被捕的。

paras.en: It is alleged a trafficable quantity of cocaine, three phones and cash were seized during the arrest.
paras.zh: 据称，逮捕期间查获了可贩运数量的可卡因、三部手机和现金。

paras.en: Police allege that when the mistaken identity kidnapping occurred at the Springvale property on 22 April, a 34-year-old victim received serious injuries to his lower body and the partial amputation of one of his fingers.
paras.zh: 警方称，4月22日，Springvale住宅发生了一起错误身份绑架事件，一名34岁的受害者下半身严重受伤，一根手指被部分截肢。

paras.en: It is alleged the fire at Capriccio Gelateria in Williamstown on 22 March caused $600,000 worth of damage and endangered the lives of residents at the property upstairs.
paras.zh: 据称，3 月 22 日威廉斯敦 Capriccio Gelateria 发生的火灾造成了价值 60 万美元的损失，并危及楼上居民的生命。

paras.en: On 16 November, police appealed for more information about the person behind the Onepercent user name.
paras.zh: 11 月 16 日，警方呼吁提供有关 Onepercent 用户名背后的人的更多信息。

paras.en: “We need the public’s assistance to identify the user of this handle,” Det Insp Graham Banks said at the time.
paras.zh: “我们需要公众的帮助来识别这个手柄的用户，”探长格雷厄姆·班克斯当时表示。

paras.en: “There will be people in the wider organised crime network and in our community who will have intimate knowledge of who this person is.
paras.zh: “在更广泛的有组织犯罪网络和我们的社区中，会有人非常了解这个人是谁。

paras.en: “We are hopeful that those people may now be in a position to come forward and speak to police.”
paras.zh: “我们希望这些人现在能够站出来与警方交谈。”

articles.title: Tourists are throwing fewer coins into Rome’s Trevi fountain – is €2 entry fee to blame?
articles.author: Angela Giuffrida in Rome

paras.en: When Jeff Clinton, an American visiting Rome with his wife for the first time, found a US one-cent coin on a street close to Termini train station, he knew precisely what he was going to do with it. “I’ll throw it into the Trevi fountain,” said Clinton, holding the copper coin in the palm of his hand as the couple admired the landmark.
paras.zh: 当美国人杰夫·克林顿 (Jeff Clinton) 与妻子第一次访问罗马时，在特米尼 (Termini) 火车站附近的街道上发现了一枚 1 美分硬币，他清楚地知道自己要用它做什么。 “我会把它扔进特莱维喷泉，”克林顿一边说，一边把铜币握在手掌上，夫妇俩正在欣赏这座地标建筑。

paras.en: He was well aware of the tradition among tourists of tossing a coin over their shoulder and into the waters of the baroque masterpiece, in a ritual fabled to ensure a return visit to the city or make other dreams come true.
paras.zh: 他很清楚游客们的传统，即在肩上扔一枚硬币，扔进巴洛克杰作的水中，这是一种传说中的仪式，以确保回访这座城市或让其他梦想成真。

paras.en: But the only thing holding him back from partaking in the gesture was the distance: the steps towards the fountain’s sunken basin are separated by a low barrier and accessible during the day only by Rome’s residents or visitors who pay €2 (£1.64).
paras.zh: 但唯一阻碍他参与这一举动的是距离：通往喷泉下沉盆地的台阶被一道低矮的栅栏隔开，白天只有支付 2 欧元（1.64 英镑）的罗马居民或游客才能进入。

paras.en: The fee, in place since February, has been partly blamed for taking some of the allure out of the coin-throwing tradition. The Rome unit of the church-run charity Caritas, which sweeps up the Trevi fountain’s coins, usually brings in more than €1.4m a year. But it noted a shortfall of about €200,000 between January and September compared with the same period in 2025.
paras.zh: 这项收费自二月份开始实施，部分原因是它削弱了投硬币传统的吸引力。教会经营的慈善机构 Caritas 的罗马分部负责清理特莱维喷泉的硬币，通常每年能带来超过 140 万欧元的收入。但它指出，与 2025 年同期相比，1 月至 9 月之间存在约 20 万欧元的缺口。

paras.en: “The closure of the direct access to the Trevi fountain might be a factor,” Giustino Trincia, the director of Caritas Roma, told Il Messaggero. The charity uses the donations to fund food banks and other welfare projects.
paras.zh: “直接通往特莱维喷泉的通道被关闭可能是一个因素，”罗马明爱负责人朱斯蒂诺·特林西亚 (Giustino Trincia) 告诉《消息报》。该慈善机构利用这些捐款来资助食品银行和其他福利项目。

paras.en: Clinton did contemplate asking someone in the basin area to throw the coin into the fountain on his behalf, but in the end slipped it back into his pocket.
paras.zh: 克林顿确实考虑过让盆地地区的人代他把硬币扔进喷泉里，但最终还是把它放回了口袋里。

paras.en: The shift towards contactless payments and mobile phone wallets is also believed to have eroded Caritas’s collections.
paras.zh: 据信，向非接触式支付和手机钱包的转变也侵蚀了明爱的收藏。

paras.en: Eric and Patty, a young couple from New York, said they might have thrown a coin, but did not have any change. Neither did they want to pay the €2 fee to get close to the basin. “It’s such a breathtaking monument, we’re happy just to take it in from here,” said Patty as they posed for selfies.
paras.zh: 来自纽约的一对年轻夫妇埃里克和帕蒂说，他们可能扔了一枚硬币，但没有找到任何零钱。他们也不想支付 2 欧元的费用来接近盆地。 “这是一座令人惊叹的纪念碑，我们很高兴能从这里欣赏它，”帕蒂在他们摆好姿势自拍时说道。

paras.en: Alan and Ying, visiting Rome from Australia, did pay the fee. While they had heard that throwing coins “is what people do”, they decided not to indulge because “nobody else was really doing it”.
paras.zh: 从澳大利亚来罗马的艾伦和英确实支付了费用。虽然他们听说扔硬币“是人们所做的”，但他们决定不再沉迷，因为“没有其他人真正这样做”。

paras.en: “I always carry cash with me because you never know when you might need it,” said Ying. “But we didn’t see anyone else doing it, so we didn’t either.”
paras.zh: “我总是随身携带现金，因为你永远不知道什么时候会需要它，”应说。 “但我们没有看到其他人这样做，所以我们也没有这样做。”

paras.en: A spokesperson for Caritas Rome told the Guardian the charity was not making any further public statements about the dwindling coin collection. The spokesperson said the collection so far this year did not take into account foreign currency coins, so the hit might not be so bad.
paras.zh: 罗马明爱的一位发言人告诉《卫报》，该慈善机构不会就硬币收藏量的减少发表任何进一步的公开声明。该发言人表示，今年到目前为止的收藏并未考虑外币硬币，因此打击可能不会那么严重。

paras.en: Still, the matter is understood to have caused friction with Rome’s council, which generated €435,194 from the access fee within the first month of its inception.
paras.zh: 尽管如此，据了解，此事还是与罗马议会产生了摩擦，罗马议会在成立的第一个月内就从接入费中获得了 435,194 欧元。

paras.en: The initiative is aimed at curbing overcrowding at the monument while raising funds for the upkeep of the fountain and other Rome monuments. No further figures have been published, but with 4.4 million tourists flocking to the Trevi in 2025, the fee had been forecast to generate a tidy income for the council each year.
paras.zh: 该倡议旨在遏制纪念碑的过度拥挤，同时为喷泉和其他罗马纪念碑的维护筹集资金。目前尚未公布更多数据，但随着 2025 年将有 440 万游客涌入特莱维，预计这笔费用每年将为该委员会带来可观的收入。

paras.en: A team of stewards staff the ticketing system and monitor the flow of the crowd in the basin area. Nicolas Romero does shifts of seven or eight hours. He said people quite often asked him for change in order to throw a coin. “But many don’t even seem to know about the tradition,” he said. “This might also explain the decline.”
paras.zh: 管家团队负责票务系统的工作，并监控流域区域的人群流动。尼古拉斯·罗梅罗 (Nicolas Romero) 的轮班时间为七到八小时。他说，人们经常向他要零钱，以便扔硬币。 “但许多人似乎根本不了解这个传统，”他说。 “这也可能解释了下降的原因。”

paras.en: The gesture is believed to have its origins in an ancient pagan ritual offering to the water gods, although the custom of throwing coins only really took off globally after the 1954 romantic comedy film, Three Coins in the Fountain.
paras.zh: 据信，这一手势起源于一种古老的异教祭祀水神的仪式，尽管投掷硬币的习俗直到 1954 年浪漫喜剧电影《喷泉里的三枚硬币》上映后才真正在全球流行起来。

articles.title: ‘So what if there’s a hole? It hasn’t collapsed’: Kyiv residents unbothered by Russian attacks on city’s bridges
articles.author: Dan Sabbagh in Kyiv; photographs by Julia Kochetova

paras.en: Mykola expects to drive his battered beige passenger minibus 20 to 24 times a day past the holes in the road on Kyiv’s damaged Northern Bridge that were caused by a Russian ballistic missile attack on Tuesday.
paras.zh: 米科拉预计每天会驾驶他那辆破旧的米色客运小巴经过 20 到 24 次，驶过基辅北桥道路上的坑洞，这些坑洞是周二俄罗斯弹道导弹袭击造成的。

paras.en: Buses are now the only motor transport allowed across the normally busy multi-lane crossing, though on their way into the city centre they have to skirt the tears in the tarmac, using the only functioning lane to get by.
paras.zh: 现在，公共汽车是唯一允许穿越通常繁忙的多车道十字路口的汽车交通工具，尽管在进入市中心的途中，他们必须绕过停机坪上的裂缝，使用唯一有效的车道通过。

paras.en: “So what if there’s a hole? The bridge hasn’t collapsed. You need to know a bit about bridge construction,” says Mykola, 65, at the wheel of a half -full afternoon bus as it clatters on its way west.
paras.zh: “如果有一个洞怎么办？桥没有倒塌。你需要了解一些桥梁施工知识，”65 岁的米科拉（Mykola）说道，他驾驶着一辆半满的下午巴士，一路向西行驶。

paras.en: Mykola operates a marshrutka, a single deck private bus, whose drivers are famed in Kyiv mythology for being able to multi-task: chatting, smoking and collecting fares, while driving as fast as possible to take passengers from rivals.
paras.zh: 米科拉经营着一辆 marshrutka，这是一种单层私人巴士，其司机在基辅神话中以能够同时处理多项任务而闻名：聊天、吸烟和收取费用，同时以尽可能快的速度驾驶从竞争对手那里接载乘客。

paras.en: Passengers pay 25 hryvnia (42p) in cash and typically one passenger gets the unofficial job of taking money and handing back change on behalf of the driver. It turns out this has become the Guardian’s task, in order to conduct an interview.
paras.zh: 乘客支付 25 格里夫纳 (42 便士) 现金，通常由一名乘客承担代表司机取钱并返还零钱的非正式工作。原来这成了《卫报》的任务，为了进行采访。

paras.en: “It would be very difficult to destroy the bridge. It would take a huge number of missiles, and if one or two hit it, it wouldn’t be the end of the world,” Mykola continues, with behind-the-wheel speculation that is so far accurate. By lunchtime the holes have been covered up, perhaps to avoid unsettling passengers eyeing the Dnipro River below.
paras.zh: “摧毁这座桥非常困难。这需要大量导弹，即使一两枚导弹击中它，也不会是世界末日，”米科拉继续说道，他的幕后猜测到目前为止是准确的。到午餐时间，这些洞已经被遮盖起来，也许是为了避免让乘客看到下面的第聂伯河而感到不安。

paras.en: Alongside its attacks on the capital’s electricity, heating and water systems, Russia has been attacking Kyiv’s bridges since early October, trying to cut off the city centre in the west from the newer, largely residential east, home to about a third of its population.
paras.zh: 除了攻击首都的电力、供暖和供水系统外，俄罗斯自 10 月初以来一直在攻击基辅的桥梁，试图将西部市中心与较新的、主要是住宅区的东部地区隔离开来，东部地区约占基辅人口的三分之一。

paras.en: Moscow struck the bridges twice again this week, first on Tuesday – overshadowed by Ukraine’s partial destruction of the Kerch road bridge to Crimea. Then again during a noisy Thursday night, hours after Vladimir Putin promised there would be a “far more painful” response to the demolition of his pet project.
paras.zh: 莫斯科本周再次撞桥两次，第一次是在周二，乌克兰部分毁坏了通往克里米亚的刻赤公路桥，使这一事件黯然失色。周四晚上，在弗拉基米尔·普京承诺拆除他最喜欢的项目后，将会有“更加痛苦”的反应。

paras.en: As of Friday, in an already traffic-snarled city, Kyiv’s other main road bridge, the Southern Bridge, was allowing motor traffic only from east to west. The new Podilskyi Bridge, damaged early on Friday, was similarly restricted, and the city’s mayor, Vitali Klitschko, told people to avoid car travel after a night in which six were killed.
paras.zh: 截至周五，在这座已经交通拥堵的城市，基辅的另一座主要公路桥梁南桥仅允许从东向西的汽车通行。周五早些时候受损的新波多利斯基大桥也受到了类似的限制，该市市长维塔利·克利钦科(Vitali Klitschko)在昨晚造成六人死亡后，告诉人们不要开车出行。

paras.en: The Northern Bridge remains open for public transport – plus any cyclists, scooter riders and walkers willing to brave the damp late autumn weather and ignore missile and drone alerts. But below, earthworks have begun to prepare for a floating pontoon bridge, one of eight planned, in case of the worst.
paras.zh: 北桥仍然对公共交通开放，以及任何愿意冒着潮湿的深秋天气并无视导弹和无人机警报的骑自行车者、踏板车骑手和步行者。但在下面，土方工程已经开始为一座浮桥做准备，这是计划中的八座浮桥之一，以防万一。

paras.en: Dmytro Bespalov, a transport planning expert with Kyiv’s National University of Construction and Architecture, said it was difficult to destroy a suspension bridge like the Northern. They have “a strong construction, with a lot of repairability”, meaning damage can usually be fixed. Though there are holes in the roadway, its supporting structures were so far unscathed, he added.
paras.zh: 基辅国立建筑大学交通规划专家德米特罗·贝斯帕洛夫表示，像北方悬索桥这样的吊桥很难被摧毁。它们具有“坚固的结构，具有很强的可修复性”，这意味着损坏通常可以修复。他补充说，尽管道路上有洞，但其支撑结构到目前为止没有受损。

paras.en: Russia is thought to have been aiming ballistic missiles at the supporting pylon, requiring a precise and difficult to execute attack, though that is what Ukraine did at the culmination of its complex attack on the Kerch road bridge, which was brought down after a Flamingo cruise missile struck its supporting arch.
paras.zh: 据信，俄罗斯将弹道导弹瞄准了支撑塔，需要进行精确且难以执行的攻击，尽管这正是乌克兰在对刻赤公路桥进行复杂攻击时所做的，该桥是在火烈鸟巡航导弹击中其支撑拱门后被击落的。

paras.en: Yet, Bespalov cautioned that Kyiv was strategically vulnerable if Russia targets the bridges with “dozens or hundreds” of missiles, because the city did not have enough bridges from before the war. “In 2021, Kyiv was in third place in Europe for congestion on the TomTom traffic index,” he said, behind Istanbul and Moscow.
paras.zh: 然而，贝斯帕洛夫警告说，如果俄罗斯用“数十或数百”枚导弹瞄准这些桥梁，基辅在战略上将很脆弱，因为该城市在战前没有足够的桥梁。他表示：“根据 TomTom 交通指数，2021 年基辅的拥堵情况在欧洲排名第三，仅次于伊斯坦布尔和莫斯科。”

paras.en: Particular concern is reserved for the pontoon bridge alternative. They can bear less traffic: “It would take 20 pontoon bridges to have half the current capacity,” Bespalov said – and they are far more vulnerable to missile and drone attack. “I don’t think it would be possible to use pontoons during a red [missile] or yellow [drone] alarm” – not least because vehicles could end up in the water.
paras.zh: 特别值得关注的是浮桥替代方案。它们可以承受的交通量较少：“需要 20 座浮桥才能达到目前容量的一半，”贝斯帕洛夫说，而且它们更容易受到导弹和无人机的攻击。 “我认为在红色[导弹]或黄色[无人机]警报期间不可能使用浮桥”——尤其是因为车辆最终可能会掉入水中。

paras.en: At the first busy bus stop on the eastern left bank, Nataliya, 40, and Iryna, 39, are happy to make the crossing over the Northern Bridge. They say they have long got used to the difficulties of war: “The main thing is to get through the first 24 hours at home after the initial discomfort, and then we’ll adapt,” said Nataliya, a customer service specialist.
paras.zh: 在东左岸第一个繁忙的公交车站，40 岁的娜塔莉亚和 39 岁的伊琳娜很高兴地穿过北桥。他们说，他们早已习惯了战争的困难：“最重要的是熬过最初不适后在家的最初 24 小时，然后我们就会适应，”客户服务专家娜塔莉亚说。

paras.en: Iryna added: “If we start to despair, that’s exactly what they want. A bridge can be built. The main thing is that when the attack comes, there are no civilians or military personnel around. It’s just concrete, that’s all. They’ll either repair it or come up with something new.”
paras.zh: 伊琳娜补充道：“如果我们开始绝望，这正是他们想要的。一座桥梁可以建造。最主要的是，当袭击发生时，周围没有平民或军事人员。这只是混凝土，仅此而已。他们要么修复它，要么想出新的东西。”

paras.en: It is a core attitude of Kyiv’s remaining residents, who are already contending with hours of electricity shortages and a lack of heating, with the full chill of winter yet to arrive. People want to deal with problems as they arise rather than worrying excessively about what may come – though it is not always easy amid the daily attacks, including a daytime raid on Thursday in which a drone exploded near the Dutch embassy.
paras.zh: 这是基辅剩余居民的核心态度，他们已经在与数小时的电力短缺和供暖不足作斗争，而寒冷的冬天还没有到来。人们希望在出现问题时立即处理，而不是过度担心可能会发生的事情——尽管在日常袭击中这并不总是那么容易，包括周四白天的袭击，一架无人机在荷兰大使馆附近爆炸。

paras.en: Oleksandr, 42, a construction worker, was waiting to get across the bridge. “If the bridges are destroyed we’ll have to leave,” he conceded. If that happened, he and his wife would move to her parents’ house across the river. “I bought them a generator there; they have their own water well. We’d already dug the well during the war. They used to have gas heating, but we’ve converted it to wood-burning. We’re preparing,” he said.
paras.zh: 42 岁的建筑工人奥莱克桑德 (Oleksandr) 正在等待过桥。 “如果桥梁被毁，我们就必须离开，”他承认。如果发生这种情况，他和他的妻子就会搬到河对岸的她父母家。 “我在那里给他们买了一台发电机；他们有自己的水井。我们在战争期间就已经挖好了水井。他们过去用的是燃气供暖，但我们已经把它改成了烧木头。我们正在准备，”他说。

articles.title: Man convicted of starting Palisades fire in Los Angeles

paras.en: A jury in Los Angeles has found a 30-year-old man guilty of starting one of the most destructive wildfires in California's history.
paras.zh: 洛杉矶的一个陪审团裁定一名 30 岁男子犯有引发加州历史上最具破坏性的野火之一的罪名。

paras.en: Jonathan Rinderknecht was convicted of arson after starting the fires that swept through Pacific Palisades and parts of Malibu in January last year, killing 12 people and destroying more than 6,800 buildings in the US state.
paras.zh: 去年 1 月，乔纳森·林德克内西特 (Jonathan Rinderknecht) 在美国州引发了席卷太平洋帕利塞德和马里布部分地区的大火，造成 12 人死亡，并摧毁了 6,800 多座建筑物，因此被判犯有纵火罪。

paras.en: The conviction was handed down nearly five months after deadlocked jurors led to the judge declaring a mistrial.
paras.zh: 在陪审团陷入僵局导致法官宣布审判无效后近五个月后，该罪名被宣判。

paras.en: Rinderknecht, who had pleaded not guilty, was convicted of two federal charges. He is due to be sentenced on 17 March when he faces between five and 20 years in prison on each charge.
paras.zh: 林德克内西特不认罪，但被判犯有两项联邦指控。他将于 3 月 17 日被判刑，每项罪名将面临 5 至 20 年监禁。

paras.en: Rinderknecht was found guilty of lighting a fire on 1 January last year which burned undetected deep in root systems before flaring back up six days later.
paras.zh: Rinderknecht 被判犯有去年 1 月 1 日纵火罪，这场火灾在根系深处燃烧，但六天后又重新燃起，但未被发现。

paras.en: One of the charges was for starting the original brush fire, while the other centred on the damage caused when it reignited into a catastrophic blaze.
paras.zh: 其中一项指控是引发最初的灌木丛火灾，而另一项指控则主要针对火灾重新引发灾难性大火时造成的损害。

paras.en: "We were determined to hold him accountable, and today's guilty verdict delivers a measure of justice for the families who lost loved ones and the thousands whose lives were upended," said Bill Essayli, who leads the US Attorney's Office for the Central District of California.
paras.zh: 加州中区联邦检察官办公室负责人比尔·埃萨利 (Bill Essayli) 表示：“我们决心追究他的责任，今天的有罪判决为失去亲人的家庭和成千上万生活被颠覆的人伸张了正义。”

paras.en: Rinderknecht is a Los Angeles resident and former ride-share delivery driver.
paras.zh: Rinderknecht 是洛杉矶居民，曾任拼车送货司机。

paras.en: Defence attorney Steve Haney had argued at trial that prosecutors lacked sufficient physical evidence or records to prove their case.
paras.zh: 辩护律师史蒂夫·哈尼在审判中辩称，检察官缺乏足够的物证或记录来证明他们的案件。

paras.en: Lawyers for the defendant said they were "disappointed" by the verdict but respected the jury's decision.
paras.zh: 被告的律师表示，他们对判决感到“失望”，但尊重陪审团的决定。

paras.en: Los Angeles Mayor Karen Bass, who was widely criticised for her handling of the fires, said in a statement that "no verdict can bring back the lives lost or erase the pain families have endured".
paras.zh: 因处理火灾而受到广泛批评的洛杉矶市长凯伦·巴斯在一份声明中表示，“任何判决都无法挽回失去的生命，也无法消除家庭所承受的痛苦”。

paras.en: "So many are still struggling to rebuild," she said. "For those still displaced, the devastation remains a daily reality."
paras.zh: “很多人仍在努力重建，”她说。 “对于那些仍然流离失所的人来说，灾难仍然是每天的现实。”

paras.en: Prosecutors had argued that Rinderknecht was driven by revenge, anger and loneliness because he had nowhere to go for the holiday.
paras.zh: 检察官辩称，林德克内西特的动机是报复、愤怒和孤独，因为他无处可去度假。

paras.en: They cited geolocation data from his iPhone, security camera footage that showed his car's location and witness testimony from passengers.
paras.zh: 他们引用了他的 iPhone 中的地理定位数据、显示他汽车位置的安全摄像机镜头以及乘客的证词。

paras.en: They alleged that Rinderknecht had a "deeply entrenched belief that the wealthy were destroying the world" and in turn purposely started the blaze in the affluent neighbourhood.
paras.zh: 他们声称林德克内西特“根深蒂固地相信富人正在毁灭世界”，并故意在富裕社区引发火灾。

paras.en: The fire was one of several that ignited back-to-back across the LA region in January, which in total left 31 people dead and destroyed 16,000 structures.
paras.zh: 这场火灾是 1 月份洛杉矶地区连续发生的多起火灾之一，总共造成 31 人死亡，并摧毁了 16,000 座建筑物。

articles.title: Deal with EU not dependent on tuition fees agreement, Miliband says

paras.en: A deal agreed between the UK and the European Union on Friday will come into force regardless of whether the two sides can negotiate a separate tuition fees agreement, Foreign Secretary Ed Miliband has told the BBC.
paras.zh: 英国外交大臣埃德·米利班德告诉英国广播公司，无论双方是否可以就单独的学费协议进行谈判，英国和欧盟周五达成的协议都将生效。

paras.en: The measures agreed in Brussels include scrapping most checks on British food exports in return for the UK following some EU regulations from 2028, and a new youth mobility scheme.
paras.zh: 在布鲁塞尔达成的措施包括取消对英国食品出口的大部分检查，以换取英国从 2028 年起遵守欧盟的一些规定，以及一项新的青年流动计划。

paras.en: However, a proposal from the bloc to lower the level of tuition fees paid by EU students in the UK has not been agreed.
paras.zh: 然而，欧盟关于降低欧盟学生在英国支付的学费水平的提议尚未获得同意。

paras.en: European Commission President Ursula von der Leyen said she was "confident" a solution would be found, with Prime Minister Andy Burnham adding "me too" during a press conference announcing the deal.
paras.zh: 欧盟委员会主席乌苏拉·冯德莱恩表示，她“有信心”找到解决方案，总理安迪·伯纳姆在宣布该协议的新闻发布会上补充道“我也是”。

paras.en: Meanwhile, asked in his interview with the BBC's Sunday with Laura Kuenssberg programme whether rejoining the EU would be looked at, Miliband said "all the options will be on the table".
paras.zh: 与此同时，米利班德在接受英国广播公司周日劳拉·昆斯伯格节目采访时被问及是否会考虑重新加入欧盟时表示，“所有选择都将摆在桌面上”。

paras.en: It came after the prime minister said that he would discuss possible ideas for even closer ties with the bloc in the coming months.
paras.zh: 此前，首相表示，他将在未来几个月讨论与欧盟建立更密切关系的可能想法。

paras.en: UK and EU leaders have hailed the closer cooperation agreement, with Burnham calling the deal a "win-win" that could lower the cost of living and reduce red tape.
paras.zh: 英国和欧盟领导人对更紧密的合作协议表示欢迎，伯纳姆称该协议是“双赢”，可以降低生活成本并减少繁文缛节。

paras.en: The prime minister said the Treasury believes the deal could boost the UK economy by up to Â£17bn a year.
paras.zh: 首相表示，财政部相信该协议每年可为英国经济带来高达 170 亿英镑的提振。

paras.en: EU sources had earlier suggested that the bloc might hold up applying the wider deal until it was agreed that EU students who wanted to study in the UK would pay the same fees as British students.
paras.zh: 欧盟消息人士早些时候表示，欧盟可能会推迟实施更广泛的协议，直到同意希望在英国学习的欧盟学生将支付与英国学生相同的费用。

paras.en: Miliband said it was "absolutely clear" the agreements on food exports, energy and youth mobility would apply, even though there has not been a deal on tuition fees.
paras.zh: 米利班德表示，尽管尚未就学费达成协议，但关于粮食出口、能源和青年流动性的协议将适用，这一点“绝对明确”。

paras.en: "President von der Leyen... was very clear about this at the press conference we just had. She said there are those three agreements and then there's a separate piece of paper and a separate issue, which is looking at the issue of tuition," he said.
paras.zh: “冯德莱恩总统……在我们刚刚举行的新闻发布会上对此非常清楚。她说有这三项协议，然后有一份单独的文件和一个单独的问题，正在研究学费问题，”他说。

paras.en: Asked again whether the agreements would definitely become law, the foreign secretary said: "Yes, absolutely."
paras.zh: 当再次被问及这些协议是否一定会成为法律时，外交大臣说：“是的，绝对会。”

paras.en: "The dates are set out in 2028 when these things are coming in, we're introducing legislation in Parliament, so definitely."
paras.zh: “日期定在 2028 年，届时这些事情就会到来，我们将在议会提出立法，所以肯定会这样做。”

paras.en: Miliband said there would be "no cost" to the UK taxpayer for anything agreed at Friday's summit, adding that there would be no new contributions to the EU budget.
paras.zh: 米利班德表示，对于周五峰会上达成的任何协议，英国纳税人都“无需承担任何费用”，并补充说，欧盟预算不会有新的捐款。

paras.en: He said previously announced agreements on EU schemes like Erasmus+ were a "separate decision" and the summit "was not about cost to the taxpayer".
paras.zh: 他表示，此前宣布的关于伊拉斯谟+等欧盟计划的协议是一个“单独的决定”，此次峰会“与纳税人的成本无关”。

paras.en: Speaking on Friday, Burnham argued that polling suggests the UK public "want closer ties" with the EU and the deal "delivers that".
paras.zh: 伯纳姆在周五发表讲话时表示，民调显示英国公众“希望与欧盟建立更紧密的关系”，而该协议“实现了这一点”。

paras.en: Miliband told the BBC that "of course all the options will be on the table" when pressed on whether rejoining the bloc would be considered, adding that "we will look at the benefits and the costs of all the different options".
paras.zh: 米利班德告诉英国广播公司，当被问及是否考虑重新加入欧盟时，“当然所有选择都会摆在桌面上”，并补充说“我们将考虑所有不同选择的好处和成本”。

paras.en: He said that while he accepted the result of the 2016 Brexit referendum, "the world has changed massively".
paras.zh: 他表示，虽然他接受了2016年英国脱欧公投的结果，但“世界已经发生了巨大变化”。

paras.en: "Europe is changing too, so we've got to look at what that means. It's not about this parliament, we're respecting the red lines in this parliament," he added.
paras.zh: “欧洲也在发生变化，所以我们必须看看这意味着什么。这与这个议会无关，我们尊重这个议会的红线，”他补充道。

paras.en: Conservative leader Kemi Badenoch said the deal was "not fair", arguing that UK farmers would have to follow rules set in Brussels and young people from the EU would "compete" with young Britons struggling to get jobs at home.
paras.zh: 保守党领袖凯米·巴德诺克表示，这项协议“不公平”，他认为英国农民必须遵守布鲁塞尔制定的规则，而来自欧盟的年轻人将与努力在国内找到工作的英国年轻人“竞争”。

paras.en: She also claimed Burnham had "plucked" the Â£17bn figure out of thin air, and said the only modelling she had seen of how the agreement could boost the economy put the figure at "0.0%".
paras.zh: 她还声称伯纳姆凭空“提取”了170亿英镑的数字，并表示她所看到的关于该协议如何提振经济的唯一模型将这一数字定为“0.0%”。

paras.en: Reform UK leader Nigel Farage said Friday marked a "betrayal of the British people" and a good day for the EU to "try and humiliate" the UK.
paras.zh: 英国改革党领袖奈杰尔·法拉奇表示，周五标志着​​“英国人民的背叛”，也是欧盟“试图羞辱”英国的好日子。

paras.en: Farage, who was a leading figure in the 2016 campaign to get Britain out of the EU, wrote on social media: "Like every prime minister before him, Burnham is a total fraud."
paras.zh: 法拉奇是2016年英国脱欧运动的领军人物，他在社交媒体上写道：“像他之前的每一位首相一样，伯纳姆完全是个骗子。”

paras.en: Liberal Democrat leader Sir Ed Davey said there needed to be more than "tweaks" to the UK's relationship to the EU.
paras.zh: 自由民主党领袖埃德·戴维爵士表示，英国与欧盟的关系需要的不仅仅是“调整”。

paras.en: "A youth mobility scheme is a big step forward, but it's nowhere near enough. We need a whole new deal that actually works for Britain, and fast."
paras.zh: “青年流动计划是向前迈出的一大步，但还远远不够。我们需要一项真正适合英国的全新协议，而且要快。”

articles.title: Zelensky says Putin is a 'killer' after Trump calls Russian leader a friend

paras.en: Ukraine's President Volodymyr Zelensky has said Vladimir Putin is a "killer" in response to Donald Trump referring to the Russian leader as his "friend" in China this week.
paras.zh: 乌克兰总统泽连斯基表示，弗拉基米尔·普京是“杀手”，以回应唐纳德·特朗普本周在中国称这位俄罗斯领导人为他的“朋友”。

paras.en: Speaking to CNN, Zelensky said it was up to the US president "how to call Putin" but "for us, he is an enemy... for us, he's a killer".
paras.zh: 泽连斯基在接受美国有线电视新闻网采访时表示，“如何称呼普京”取决于美国总统，但“对我们来说，他是敌人......对我们来说，他是杀手”。

paras.en: Before Thursday's historic trilateral meeting with Chinese leader Xi Jinping and Putin, Trump called Putin his "friend" and said the two leaders have had a "great relationship for many years".
paras.zh: 在周四与中国领导人习近平和普京举行历史性三边会晤之前，特朗普称普京为他的“朋友”，并表示两国领导人多年来一直保持着“良好的关系”。

paras.en: Russian attacks continued overnight, with two people killed, including a boy, and 52 injured in missile and drone strikes on Zelensky's hometown of Kryvyi Rih in the central Dnipropetrovsk region, officials said.
paras.zh: 官员称，俄罗斯的袭击持续了一整夜，导弹和无人机袭击了泽伦斯基的家乡第聂伯罗彼得罗夫斯克州中部的克里沃罗格，造成两人死亡，其中包括一名男孩，52人受伤。

paras.en: Ukraine's state emergency service DSNS said 11 people were also injured in the north-eastern Kharkiv region, and one person in Rivne, in the north-west.
paras.zh: 乌克兰国家紧急服务机构DSNS表示，东北部哈尔科夫地区也有11人受伤，西北部罗夫诺也有1人受伤。

paras.en: On Friday, at least nine people were killed in Russian strikes targeting bridges in the capital Kyiv and railway stations in western Ukraine - with Zelensky calling the attack the "biggest this year" after an onslaught of 110 missiles, including 27 ballistic, and more than 400 drones.
paras.zh: 周五，俄罗斯针对首都基辅的桥梁和乌克兰西部的火车站发动袭击，造成至少 9 人死亡。泽连斯基称这次袭击是“今年最大规模的一次”，此前俄罗斯使用了 110 枚导弹（其中包括 27 枚弹道导弹）和 400 多架无人机。

paras.en: The strikes came days after Ukraine had badly damaged the Crimean Bridge.
paras.zh: 这次袭击是在乌克兰严重破坏克里米亚大桥几天后发生的。

paras.en: Hours after Friday's strikes on Ukraine, Trump told reporters at the White House that Putin would "love to end the war".
paras.zh: 周五对乌克兰发动袭击数小时后，特朗普在白宫对记者表示，普京“愿意结束战争”。

paras.en: "They [Zelensky and Putin] both want to end it and it's a very good thing I have a relationship," he said on Friday.
paras.zh: “他们（泽伦斯基和普京）都想结束这一切，我能保持这种关系是一件非常好的事情，”他周五表示。

paras.en: Trump also doubled down on his description of the Russian leader as a friend but said he "can't speak" to whether Putin is a friend to the US.
paras.zh: 特朗普还强调了将俄罗斯领导人描述为朋友，但表示他“无法谈论”普京是否是美国的朋友。

paras.en: However Zelensky said despite Trump's stance, he saw Putin as "a killer".
paras.zh: 然而泽伦斯基表示，尽管特朗普的立场如此，他仍将普京视为“杀手”。

paras.en: "I think mostly for the people in the world, he is a killer because he's killing - by the way- he's killing each day and night," he told CNN.
paras.zh: 他对美国有线电视新闻网（CNN）表示：“我认为，对于世界上大多数人来说，他是一名杀手，因为他每天都在杀人，顺便说一句，他每天都在杀人。”

paras.en: Zelensky also said speaking about Putin like he was a "friend" meant "he doesn't feel enough pressure".
paras.zh: 泽伦斯基还表示，像对待“朋友”一样谈论普京意味着“他没有感受到足够的压力”。

paras.en: The war of words came as neighbouring Poland said a Russian cruise missile was among three objects that violated its airspace in the south-east of the country early on Friday.
paras.zh: 这场口水战发生之际，邻国波兰表示，周五早些时候，俄罗斯东南部侵犯其领空的三枚物体中有一枚俄罗斯巡航导弹。

paras.en: Polish Defence Minister WÅadysÅaw Kosiniak-Kamysz said the missile hit a rural area at Nowy Lipowiec about 50km (31 miles) from the Ukrainian border.
paras.zh: 波兰国防部长瓦迪索夫·科西尼亚克·卡米什表示，导弹击中了距离乌克兰边境约 50 公里（31 英里）的新利波维茨农村地区。

paras.en: This was about 100km from where European troops - from 11 of the 36 member nations of the coalition of the willing - were completing a training exercise, Polish authorities said. Another missile and a jet-powered drone were suspected to have hit two other locations, they added.
paras.zh: 波兰当局表示，这里距离欧洲军队——来自自愿联盟 36 个成员国中的 11 个——正在完成训练演习的地方约 100 公里。他们补充说，另一枚导弹和一架喷气式无人机疑似击中了另外两个地点。

paras.en: Polish Prime Minister Donald Tusk said it did not appear to be an accident.
paras.zh: 波兰总理唐纳德·图斯克表示，这似乎不是一次意外。

paras.en: Nobody was hurt and no damage has been reported, but Warsaw described the incident as a "provocation" from Moscow.
paras.zh: 没有人受伤，也没有损失报告，但华沙称这一事件是来自莫斯科的“挑衅”。

paras.en: Nato Secretary General Mark Rutte condemned "grave violations of Polish airspace" and said the military alliance had scrambled its jets in response.
paras.zh: 北约秘书长马克·吕特谴责“严重侵犯波兰领空”，并表示军事联盟已紧急升空飞机作为回应。

paras.en: Russia has made no comment about the violations, which took place during Friday's massive attack on Ukraine.
paras.zh: 俄罗斯没有对周五大规模袭击乌克兰期间发生的违规行为发表评论。

paras.en: Putin launched a full-scale invasion of Ukraine in February 2022.
paras.zh: 普京于2022年2月对乌克兰发动全面入侵。

The move to expanded space is designed to accommodate manufacturing capabilities needed to serve the growing demand across the agriculture, construction and especially mining industries in India and Southeast Asia. articles.title: Why the Right Car Accident Lawyer Changes the Outcome of a Claim
articles.author: Tyrepress Advertorial

paras.en: Why the Right Car Accident Lawyer Changes the Outcome of a Claim

A car crash can turn an ordinary day into months of medical appointments, insurance calls, and difficult decisions. In 2025, Missouri recorded 909 traffic fatalities, a 4.8% decrease from 2024. In the St. Louis region, 157 people died in traffic crashes that year, with 25% of those fatalities involving pedestrians or bicyclists. These figures show that serious collisions remain a concern even as roadway deaths continue to decline.

For people dealing with injuries, vehicle damage, lost income, or other consequences after a crash, the claims process can feel just as challenging as the recovery itself. A car accident lawyer in St. Louis can help assess the circumstances, identify potentially responsible parties, handle insurer communications, and pursue compensation supported by the available evidence. When injured parties know how legal decisions can shape a claim, they can take an important step in determining what comes next.
paras.zh: QUERY LENGTH LIMIT EXCEEDED. MAX ALLOWED QUERY : 500 CHARS

paras.en: Early Decisions Affect Available Evidence

Evidence often determines whether an insurance dispute ends quickly or requires further action. A lawyer examines the crash report, photographs, traffic signals, road conditions, vehicle damage, and witness accounts.
Physical evidence can disappear after repairs, weather changes, or vehicle storage. Legal counsel can request records promptly and preserve information that supports the claimant’s account.

Insurance companies also review recorded statements and social media posts. A claimant who speaks publicly without legal guidance can minimize symptoms, accept blame, or create inconsistencies that damage credibility.
Liability Requires More Than a Police Report

A police report provides useful information, but it does not resolve every issue in a civil claim. The report might omit witnesses, overlook road conditions, or provide limited detail about the collision.

A lawyer compares the report with photographs, medical records, vehicle damage, and witness testimony. That review helps establish how each driver acted before the crash and whether another factor contributed.
- Comparative Fault Rules Cannot Be Ignored

Missouri uses comparative fault rules. If a claimant shares responsibility, the final recovery can decrease according to that percentage. A clear liability record therefore affects the amount the claimant eventually receives.
Medical Records Connect Injuries to Financial Losses
A claim needs medical proof connecting the crash to the reported injuries. Treatment records, diagnostic results, physician notes, and follow-up appointments show the following:
Consistent treatment also creates a reliable timeline. Gaps in care can lead an insurer to argue that the injury was minor, unrelated, or resolved sooner than the records indicate.

Damages include more than emergency bills. A complete claim accounts for ongoing treatment, lost income, reduced work capacity, medication costs, transportation, and pain-related limits on ordinary activities. Each category requires supporting documentation.
Insurance Tactics Can Shift the Claim’s Value

An insurer’s first settlement proposal rarely reflects every documented loss. This is because a carrier may evaluate only the early information available at that stage, which often excludes future care and the full extent of lost earnings. However, a lawyer calculates damages after reviewing medical progress and employment records. This process prevents a claimant from accepting payment before doctors understand the likely course of recovery.

Insurance adjusters also seek statements about prior injuries, current symptoms, and work limitations. Accurate answers matter, but speculation creates avoidable disputes. Legal guidance keeps communications focused on documented facts.
A claim must follow applicable filing deadlines and procedural requirements. Missing a deadline can prevent a claimant from pursuing compensation, even when the evidence supports fault.

A lawyer tracks those dates while handling communications, records requests, settlement discussions, and court filings. This organization lets the claimant focus on medical care instead of managing demands from several parties.

Local knowledge also helps counsel assess road conditions, traffic patterns, reporting practices, and court procedures in the St. Louis area. These details provide useful context during liability analysis and settlement negotiations.
Settlement or Trial Requires Careful Timing

Most injury claims resolve through negotiation, but a settlement should follow a complete review of liability and damages. A lawyer evaluates the insurer’s position, identifies missing damages, and explains the financial effects of accepting a settlement.
If negotiations fail, the evidence gathered during the claim can support a lawsuit. A prepared case helps the claimant choose between a fair resolution and asking a court to decide disputed issues.

The right lawyer changes a car accident claim by preserving evidence, testing liability, documenting medical losses, and resisting premature settlement pressure. A claimant should save photographs and records, follow medical instructions, avoid detailed insurer statements, and arrange a case review promptly.

Early legal analysis helps locate missing proof before it disappears and identifies deadlines before they become obstacles. These steps give the claim a documented foundation and help the claimant choose between settlement and litigation.

articles.title: Fix Auto Avondale Showcases $200K Custom Build at SEMA Show
articles.author: Jason Stahl

paras.en: Fix Auto USA has recognized Fix Auto Avondale and owner Troy Buck for two recent initiatives highlighting the team’s craftsmanship and community involvement.

At the 2026 SEMA Show, Fix Auto Avondale presented a custom vehicle completed through a frame-off restoration. The project was finished in 60 days, with four employees contributing approximately 4,000 hours. The build is valued at more than $200,000.
The vehicle featured custom modifications, including a shaved firewall, shaved cowl panel, sectioned fenders, molded-in spoiler and custom Kandy paint. The vehicle received a strong response at SEMA.

“Seeing the response to the car at SEMA was incredibly rewarding for all of us,” said Buck. “Our team put an unbelievable amount of time and effort into this build, and completing something of this scale in only 60 days took everyone working together. I’m extremely proud of what our team accomplished and the craftsmanship they brought to every detail.”

Ahead of Alice Cooper’s annual charitable concert on Dec. 12, Buck also created an original Alice Cooper painting to raise funds for Alice Cooper’s Solid Rock Teen Centers. The piece continues Buck’s involvement with the organization.

Earlier this year, Buck collaborated with teen artists from the center to create the 10th and final installation in the City of Goodyear’s “HeART of Goodyear” public art project. The sculpture is displayed outside the Solid Rock Teen Center.

Fix Auto Avondale made a $1,500 cash donation to Alice Cooper’s Solid Rock Teen Centers and a $1,500 cash donation to Your Heart Our Hands, which supports youth who have aged out of the foster care system. Over the past three years, Fix Auto Avondale has provided more than $80,000 in charitable donations.

“Solid Rock is an organization I’ve been fortunate to support year after year, and it’s something that means a lot to me personally,” said Buck. “Creating these paintings gives me a chance to combine my love of art with an opportunity to give back and support young people in our community. Whether it’s through the annual concert, working alongside the teens or finding other ways to contribute, I’m grateful to be involved. Our team believes strongly in giving back to the communities that support us, and I’m proud of what we’ve been able to accomplish.”
