paras.en: The attorney told the Guardian that the raid was the result of a “mutual legal assistance” request from the US – and that such a request “wouldn’t give [the Garda Síochána] permission to kick in the doors of someone’s dwelling in Ireland”.
paras.zh: 该律师告诉《卫报》，这次突袭是美国提出的“司法协助”请求的结果，而这样的请求“不会允许[爱尔兰警察局]允许踢开某人在爱尔兰的住所的门”。

paras.en: “It’s unusual for the Irish state to be acting in such a clandestine manner,” Mulholland said. He has asked authorities to produce a search warrant and an itemized list of what was taken. “My fear is that whatever was taken has been put on a plane and taken to the US,” he added.
paras.zh: “爱尔兰政府以如此秘密的方式行事是不寻常的，”穆赫兰说。他要求当局出示搜查令和被盗物品的详细清单。 “我担心的是，无论被带走的东西都已经被装上飞机并带到了美国，”他补充道。

paras.en: “This [extradition case] shows the complete disregard for due process … that the Trump administration seems to have,” Mulholland said.
paras.zh: “这起（引渡案）表明特朗普政府似乎完全无视正当程序，”穆赫兰说。

articles.title: Gérard Depardieu and French author investigated over sexual allegations

paras.en: Warning: this story contains graphic content
paras.zh: 警告：此故事包含令人不适的内容

paras.en: French authorities are investigating disgraced actor GÃ©rard Depardieu and the author Michel Houellebecq over "allegations of a sexual nature", a source with knowledge of the investigation says.
paras.zh: 据了解调查情况的消息人士称，法国当局正在对名誉扫地的演员热拉尔·德帕迪约和作家米歇尔·维勒贝克进行“性指控”调查。

paras.en: The confirmation comes after reports in French media that the two were accused of being involved in a "gang rape" on the set of the film Thalasso in 2018 by an actress.
paras.zh: 法国媒体报道称，两人被指控在 2018 年电影《海水浴》片场被一名女演员“轮奸”，此消息得到证实。

paras.en: The source told the BBC that a judicial investigation was launched after a complaint was filed in May 2025.
paras.zh: 消息人士告诉 BBC，2025 年 5 月提出投诉后，司法调查启动。

paras.en: Depardieu has already separately been convicted of unrelated sexual assaults. The BBC has contacted Depardieu's lawyers and Houellebecq, an acclaimed French author and occasional actor, for comment.
paras.zh: 德帕迪约已因不相关的性侵犯罪被单独定罪。 BBC 已联系德帕迪约的律师和法国著名作家兼演员维勒贝克请其置评。

paras.en: The actress, who has not been named publicly, accused Depardieu of penetration without consent and Houellebecq of forcing her to perform oral sex, in an interview with Mediapart, a French investigative site which first reported the allegations.
paras.zh: 这位未公开姓名的女演员在接受最先报道这些指控的法国调查网站 Mediapart 的采访时，指控德帕迪约未经同意进行插入，并指责维勒贝克强迫她进行口交。

paras.en: She told the outlet that none of this had been written into the script, and that she experienced "profound humiliation" and "unspeakable shame".
paras.zh: 她告诉媒体，这些都没有写进剧本，她经历了“深深的羞辱”和“无法形容的耻辱”。

paras.en: French law stipulates as of 2025 that all sexual acts performed without consent constitute rape.
paras.zh: 法国法律规定，自2025年起，所有未经同意进行的性行为均构成强奸。

paras.en: The film's director, Guillaume Nicloux, has been accused of being complicit because he was said to have filmed the incident, Mediapart and AFP report. The BBC has contacted his agent and the Paris prosecutor's office for comment.
paras.zh: 据 Mediapart 和法新社报道，该片导演纪尧姆·尼克鲁被指控为同谋，因为据说他拍摄了这一事件。 BBC 已联系他的经纪人和巴黎检察官办公室征求评论。

paras.en: Nicloux told Mediapart that the scene had been improvised and he had not intervened as he had not observed "any constraints, verbal or physical opposition, or even discomfort".
paras.zh: 尼克鲁告诉 Mediapart，这一场景是即兴创作的，他没有进行干预，因为他没有观察到“任何限制、口头或身体上的反对，甚至是不适”。

paras.en: The site published production documents showing footage of the scene had been destroyed.
paras.zh: 该网站发布的制作文件显示，现场的镜头已被销毁。

paras.en: The actress told the outlet that she had told friends, her agent and others involved in the film's production in Normandy about the incident at the time, but only filed the complaint after other women accused Depardieu of sexual misconduct.
paras.zh: 这位女演员告诉媒体，她当时已将这件事告诉了朋友、她的经纪人和诺曼底参与电影制作的其他人，但只是在其他女性指控德帕迪约性行为不端后才提出投诉。

paras.en: The Asterix and Obelix star will next week find out whether he will stand trial for allegedly raping another actress, Charlotte Arnould.
paras.zh: 这位《阿斯特里克斯与奥贝利克斯》的主演将于下周得知他是否会因涉嫌强奸另一位女演员夏洛特·阿诺德而受审。

paras.en: On Monday, Depardieu dropped his appeal against a separate conviction for two counts of sexual assault during another film shoot, for which he was handed an 18-month suspended sentence.
paras.zh: 周一，德帕迪约撤销了对另一项电影拍摄期间两项性侵犯罪的单独定罪的上诉，他因此被判处 18 个月缓刑。

paras.en: Several other women have made allegations against the 77-year-old in the media.
paras.zh: 其他几位女性也在媒体上对这位 77 岁的老人提出指控。

paras.en: If you have been affected by any of the issues raised in this story, details of help and support in the UK are available at BBC Action Line
paras.zh: 如果您受到本文中提出的任何问题的影响，请访问 BBC Action Line，获取英国帮助和支持的详细信息

articles.title: Anthropic shares fall after blockbuster opening as wider tech sell-off continues

paras.en: Anthropic's shares have dropped back towards their initial price after a soaring first day on the stock market, as a wider tech sell-off deepens.
paras.zh: 随着更广泛的科技股抛售加深，Anthropic 的股价在股市首日飙升后已回落至初始价格。

paras.en: The fall in tech stocks continued to weigh on markets through Friday, with the S&P 500 down about 2.8% and the Dow Jones Industrial Average down more than 1% by mid-afternoon.
paras.zh: 截至周五，科技股的下跌继续给市场带来压力，标准普尔 500 指数下跌约 2.8%，道琼斯工业平均指数下午中旬下跌超过 1%。

paras.en: Both US indexes touched correction territory, a point where they are trading at 10% or more down from a recent high.
paras.zh: 两个美国指数均触及修正区间，较近期高点下跌 10% 或更多。

paras.en: The tech-heavy Nasdaq Composite Index also fell more than 4% by afternoon trading as shares in major tech companies continued to fall.
paras.zh: 由于主要科技公司的股价继续下跌，以科技股为主的纳斯达克综合指数在下午交易中也下跌了 4% 以上。

paras.en: The speed at which AI investment has been growing - with more than $1 trillion spent in the last year alone by a small handful of major tech companies - has led to ongoing concerns of a financial bubble. Questions are being raised over whether those investments will pay off, and when.
paras.zh: 人工智能投资的增长速度——仅去年一年，少数主要科技公司就花费了超过 1 万亿美元——引发了人们对金融泡沫的持续担忧。人们质疑这些投资是否会以及何时会获得回报。

paras.en: Despite a positive first day of trading, Anthropic's shares fell on Friday, dropping at one point by more than 12% to about $85, close to its initial public offering (IPO) price of $83.
paras.zh: 尽管首日交易表现良好，但 Anthropic 股价周五下跌，一度下跌 12% 以上，至 85 美元左右，接近其 83 美元的首次公开募股 (IPO) 价格。

paras.en: The artificial intelligence (AI) company's introduction to the Nasdaq stock exchange on Thursday was a crucial test for the industry and was largely seen as a success, with trading starting at $111.50.
paras.zh: 这家人工智能 (AI) 公司周四在纳斯达克证券交易所上市，对整个行业来说是一次至关重要的考验，在很大程度上被视为成功，交易起始价为 111.50 美元。

paras.en: The maker of the Claude chatbot raised a record $81bn in its initial public offering (IPO), but its share price moved significantly in the first day of trading.
paras.zh: Claude 聊天机器人的制造商在首次公开募股 (IPO) 中筹集了创纪录的 810 亿美元资金，但其股价在首日交易中大幅波动。

paras.en: The shares peaked at $115 on Thursday, before easing to end the day up 17% at $97.17.
paras.zh: 该股周四最高触及 115 美元，随后回落，最终上涨 17%，至 97.17 美元。

paras.en: Analysts said volatility was to be expected in the first days or even weeks of Anthropic's trading, as the company was the first frontier AI firm to go public so had no direct peers.
paras.zh: 分析师表示，预计 Anthropic 交易的头几天甚至几周内会出现波动，因为该公司是第一家上市的前沿人工智能公司，因此没有直接的同行。

paras.en: Some have also noted the similarities with Elon Musk's SpaceX, which at the time of its debut in June was the largest IPO on record. Shares in the rocket and AI company experienced large swings in its first few weeks of trading.
paras.zh: 一些人还指出了与埃隆·马斯克 (Elon Musk) 的 SpaceX 的相似之处，后者在 6 月份首次亮相时是有记录以来最大的 IPO。这家火箭和人工智能公司的股价在交易的头几周经历了大幅波动。

paras.en: Most tech companies see their shares fall after hitting the stock market, often after reporting quarterly results for the first time.
paras.zh: 大多数科技公司的股价在上市后都会下跌，通常是在首次报告季度业绩后。

paras.en: But many, including Meta, Amazon and Google, have gone on to become the largest and most profitable corporations in the world.
paras.zh: 但包括 Meta、亚马逊和谷歌在内的许多公司已经成为世界上最大、最赚钱的公司。

paras.en: Ed Moya, a strategist at market intelligence firm AlphaSense, said Anthropic's blockbuster IPO did not appear to have restored confidence in the broader AI market.
paras.zh: 市场情报公司 AlphaSense 策略师 Ed Moya 表示，Anthropic 的重磅 IPO 似乎并未恢复人们对更广泛的人工智能市场的信心。

paras.en: While AI demand was still very strong, Moya told the BBC that investors were trying to answer the question of how much were they willing to pay for that growth.
paras.zh: 尽管人工智能需求仍然非常强劲，但莫亚告诉 BBC，投资者正在试图回答这样的问题：他们愿意为这种增长付出多少代价。

paras.en: "As we've gone through the past past few weeks, it seems that there's been more risks that have surfaced," he said.
paras.zh: 他说：“过去几周，似乎出现了更多风险。”

paras.en: "Right now you're starting to see Wall Street is trying to shift from rewarding growth at any price, to demanding stronger cash flow and a clearer path to profitability."
paras.zh: “现在你开始看到华尔街正试图从以任何价格奖励增长转向要求更强劲的现金流和更清晰的盈利途径。”

paras.en: Shares in some of the largest US tech companies also fell on Friday as the market sell off continued.
paras.zh: 随着市场继续抛售，美国一些最大科技公司的股价周五也下跌。

paras.en: Nvidia shares had plunged by more than 11% by the afternoon, while Musk's firms SpaceX and Tesla had both fallen by more than 6%.
paras.zh: 截至下午，英伟达股价暴跌超过 11%，而马斯克旗下的 SpaceX 和特斯拉股价均下跌超过 6%。

paras.en: Meta was down more than 5% and Amazon was down more than 3.5%, while Apple and Alphabet experienced smaller falls.
paras.zh: Meta 下跌超过 5%，亚马逊下跌超过 3.5%，而苹果和 Alphabet 跌幅较小。

paras.en: Europe's main stock markets - which contain fewer tech stocks - also took a hit.
paras.zh: 科技股较少的欧洲主要股市也受到了打击。

paras.en: Germany's Dax index closed down 2.6%, France's CAC 40 was down 1.9% and the UK's FTSE 100 ended trading 1% lower.
paras.zh: 德国 Dax 指数收盘下跌 2.6%，法国 CAC 40 指数下跌 1.9%，英国 FTSE 100 指数收盘下跌 1%。

paras.en: Earlier on Friday, tech-heavy Asian markets saw steep falls.
paras.zh: 周五早些时候，以科技股为主的亚洲市场大幅下跌。

paras.en: South Korea's Kospi and Japan's Nikkei 225 indexes closed down about 5%, with shares in memory chip makers Sk Hynix, Kioxia and Tokyo Electron, and other tech firms such as Samsung Electronics, seeing losses.
paras.zh: 韩国 Kospi 指数和日本日经 225 指数收盘下跌约 5%，存储芯片制造商 Sk Hynix、Kioxia 和 Tokyo Electron 以及三星电子等其他科技公司的股价均下跌。

paras.en: Taiwan's stock market dropped about 6% on Friday, taking the weekly fall to more than 17% and what was reported to be its biggest weekly fall since 1990.
paras.zh: 台湾股市周五下跌约 6%，周跌幅超过 17%，据报道为 1990 年以来最大单周跌幅。

articles.title: Trump threatens ban on US firms building AI data centres overseas

paras.en: Donald Trump has said he will ban US companies from building AI data centres overseas, threatening a "tremendous tax" for tech firms who do so.
paras.zh: 唐纳德·特朗普表示，他将禁止美国公司在海外建设人工智能数据中心，并威胁要对这样做的科技公司征收“巨额税”。

paras.en: "We're going to keep it all in this country," the US president said, while providing little detail on the potential policy he said others in his cabinet were hearing about for the first time.
paras.zh: 这位美国总统表示，“我们将把这一切保留在这个国家”，但他并没有提供有关潜在政策的细节，他说内阁中的其他人是第一次听说这一政策。

paras.en: Data centres were a central issue in the midterm elections earlier in November, with many Democratic candidates promising tougher regulation on their construction.
paras.zh: 数据中心是 11 月初中期选举的核心问题，许多民主党候选人承诺对其建设进行更严格的监管。

paras.en: Tech giants including Meta and Google have entered agreements to build data centres overseas. It remains unclear how such a policy would be enforced if it was brought in.
paras.zh: Meta 和谷歌等科技巨头已签订在海外建设数据中心的协议。目前尚不清楚如果引入这样的政策将如何执行。

paras.en: "We're not going to allow our companies to build data centres outside of our country," Trump told reporters in a press briefing following his return from his trip to Asia.
paras.zh: 特朗普从亚洲之行回国后在新闻发布会上对记者表示：“我们不会允许我们的公司在我国境外建立数据中心。”

paras.en: "Because China will take all of them, and we're not allowing that to happen."
paras.zh: “因为中国将把它们全部拿走，我们不会允许这种情况发生。”

paras.en: But whether that idea will become policy remains unclear.
paras.zh: 但这一想法是否会成为政策仍不清楚。

paras.en: "I don't know if that's a breaking story, but I haven't even said that to my people. But I'm telling them now, they're here," he said.
paras.zh: “我不知道这是否是一个重大新闻，但我什至没有对我的人民说过这些。但我现在告诉他们，他们就在这里，”他说。

paras.en: Trump floated the policy after saying the US was leading on data centre construction, and he would not allow China to beat the US when it came to AI - which he calls super intelligence, or SI.
paras.zh: 特朗普在提出这项政策时表示，美国在数据中心建设方面处于领先地位，他不会允许中国在人工智能（他称之为超级智能，SI）方面击败美国。

paras.en: It also follows an announcement earlier this week that would restrict the export of advanced computer chips and who can access the computing power provided by them.
paras.zh: 此前，本周早些时候还宣布限制先进计算机芯片的出口以及谁可以使用其提供的计算能力。

paras.en: Washington on Monday announced firms would require a licence to buy advanced chips, so US officials can monitor whether they are being used to serve Chinese companies or they are being smuggled into China.
paras.zh: 华盛顿周一宣布，企业购买先进芯片需要获得许可证，以便美国官员可以监控这些芯片是否被用来为中国公司服务，或者是否被走私到中国。

paras.en: The move will impact South East Asian countries that have invested heavily in data centres, as Chinese companies seek to rent computing power from overseas.
paras.zh: 由于中国公司寻求从海外租用计算能力，此举将影响在数据中心方面投入巨资的东南亚国家。

paras.en: Data centres are crucial to the AI boom. The vast warehouse-style buildings house the advanced computer chips and servers that are needed to run AI programmes such as Claude and ChatGPT.
paras.zh: 数据中心对于人工智能的繁荣至关重要。巨大的仓库式建筑容纳了运行 Claude 和 ChatGPT 等人工智能程序所需的先进计算机芯片和服务器。

paras.en: As of April there were about 3,000 data centres across the US, with another 1,500 in various stages of approval and construction, according to the Pew Research Centre.
paras.zh: 根据皮尤研究中心的数据，截至 4 月份，全美约有 3,000 个数据中心，另有 1,500 个处于审批和建设的不同阶段。

paras.en: Many of them are built in rural areas, and concerns about issues including noise pollution and energy consumption helped drive Democratic candidates promising tougher rules on data centre construction to wins on 3 November.
paras.zh: 其中许多建在农村地区，对噪音污染和能源消耗等问题的担忧促使承诺对数据中心建设采取更严格规定的民主党候选人在 11 月 3 日获胜。

paras.en: "You ought to take advantage of the the data centres. Make them pay you, make them pay your community, but take advantage don't shut them off," Trump said.
paras.zh: “你应该利用数据中心。让他们付钱给你，让他们付钱给你的社区，但要利用，不要关闭它们，”特朗普说。

paras.en: "We have a lot of places that want them badly, and they're great places. They have energy and they have everything. They're tremendous assets."
paras.zh: “我们有很多地方都非常需要他们，而他们都是很棒的地方。他们有活力，他们拥有一切。他们是巨大的资产。”

paras.en: Canada has made moves to step in to offer itself as an alternative location for these sites, with less local pushback against projects so far.
paras.zh: 加拿大已采取行动介入，将自己作为这些地点的替代地点，到目前为止，当地对项目的抵制较少。

paras.en: Large tech firms - often called AI hyperscalers due to the size of their investments in AI - have also been branching out.
paras.zh: 大型科技公司——因其在人工智能领域的投资规模而通常被称为人工智能超大规模企业——也一直在进行扩张。

paras.en: In September Google announced a â¬13bn ($15bn: Â£11bn) investment in AI infrastructure in Finland, which included funding for three data centres.
paras.zh: 9 月，谷歌宣布对芬兰的人工智能基础设施投资 130 亿欧元（150 亿美元：110 亿英镑），其中包括为三个数据中心提供资金。

paras.en: Last month, building work for two of those centres was halted due to concerns over the clearance of more than 300 hectares of forest.
paras.zh: 上个月，由于担心砍伐超过 300 公顷的森林，其中两个中心的建设工程被叫停。

paras.en: Trump called out the build in Finland specifically, saying his administration was "not allowing that to happen".
paras.zh: 特朗普特别提到了芬兰的建设，称他的政府“不允许这种情况发生”。

articles.title: Off-Highway Brake & Friction Excellence is All-Italian

paras.en: Off-Highway Brake & Friction Excellence is All-Italian

SK Wellman, a company specializing in the production of brake and frictions components for off-highway, has a lively DNA. A historical reality in Orzinuovi (Bs), where the plant is still located, over the years it has undergone transformations and changes that have contributed to making it what it is today: an evolved company, able to grow in loyalty to the local Italian territory and to innovate its sector with creativity and flexibility worldwide. Today, as part of the CentroMotion Group and its Carlisle Brake & Friction division, SK Wellman is a leader in its segment, recognized and chosen by major brands in earthmoving, agricultural and construction machinery. Engineer Alessandro Gamba, Global Director of Friction Engineering, tells us about the ongoing growth.

paras.en: "S.K. Wellman S.R.L. has 340 employees and a turnover of 127 million by 2023," Gamba begins. In the last five years, a strong push has come from the market but above all from the characteristics of SK, such as creativity, innovation, flexibility, which, in the final analysis, are the result of the greatest wealth of this company: people". They are the ones who make the Brescia-based company an authentic and tenacious company, to the point of being able to export not only their products successfully, but also their skills and design skills to the other plants of the Carlisle Brake & Friction division. The year 2023, which has just ended, confirms a positive performance in turnover for sales revenues alone, recording a slight decrease of -5% compared to the previous exceptional 2022 financial year; A year, the latter, probably unrepeatable for many realities of the Brescia and non-Brescia economy. In fact, 2023 was undoubtedly the year of change that helped people develop a greater ability to manage uncertainty, accepting and dealing with unexpected situations with more resilience.

paras.en: "At the base of success there is a matrix organization developed thanks to group governance - explains the engineer -: a verticality driven on all functions and skills, able to define and guide processes on a global scale and generate best practices. And that's not all," adds Gamba, "we are one of the companies with the lowest level of turnover, and this allows us to transfer the experience of those who have been with us for a long time to young people, on whom we particularly focus. Added to this is a company population of 15 different nationalities, whose strong collaboration creates a truly serene working climate," says the HR Manager. It is no coincidence that the direction of growth is particularly social responsibility.

paras.en: "Among the main projects of SK Wellman and Carlisle - he observes - stands out Enactus, an international non-profit organization that, thanks to its activity, involves university students in the creation of sustainable entrepreneurial projects, helping to bridge the gap between university and business; and then Treedom, which involves the company's commitment to planting 1,600 trees in three years, involving its stakeholders in the project". Two more rare gems for the metalworking industry? A level of accidents at work that borders on zero, and the centrality of talent development. Towards excellence and beyond.

articles.title: ProColor Collision Myrtle Beach Earns Numerous OEM Certifications
articles.author: Jason Stahl

paras.en: ProColor Collision announced that ProColor Collision Myrtle Beach earned collision repair certifications from General Motors, FCA, Hyundai and Kia. The certifications expand the shop’s OEM repair capabilities and reflect the team’s commitment to safe, high-quality repairs for customers throughout the Grand Strand.
The achievements come months after the shop earned Honda and Acura OEM certifications, marking progress for the South Carolina location.

Manufacturer collision repair certifications require shops to meet standards for technician training, specialized tools and equipment, facility capabilities and OEM-approved repair procedures. By investing in these programs, ProColor Collision Myrtle Beach is expanding its ability to repair a wider range of vehicles to manufacturer specifications.

“We’re incredibly proud of what our team has accomplished in such a short amount of time,” said Evan Anderson, co-owner of ProColor Collision Myrtle Beach. “We haven’t even been open a full year, so earning these certifications is a major milestone for us. It reflects the work our team has put in from day one to build a shop our customers can trust.”

Located at 7794 Highway 544, the 6,850-square-foot facility was purpose-built with advanced repair technology and modern equipment to support a full range of collision repair services. Co-owners Evan Anderson and John Masetti continue to invest in the training, technology and capabilities needed to serve drivers throughout the Myrtle Beach community.

“It’s exciting to see the Myrtle Beach team continue expanding what they can offer their customers,” said Nicky Woerner, vice president of sales and operations for ProColor Collision USA. “These certifications reflect an ongoing investment in the training, equipment and expertise needed to deliver safe, manufacturer-approved repairs and set the shop up for continued success.”

As the first ProColor Collision location in South Carolina, ProColor Collision Myrtle Beach continues to grow its capabilities while establishing itself as a trusted collision repair provider in the region.
For more information on ProColor Collision, click here.

articles.title: Champion It Forward Receives $50,000 Donation from LKQ
articles.author: Jason Stahl

paras.en: Champion It Forward, a newly formed nonprofit dedicated to creating opportunities for the next generation of collision repair professionals, announced a $50,000 gift from LKQ Corporation to support the organization’s mission and emerging workforce development programs.

LKQ is a founding member of Champion It Forward. Its early investment will support flagship programs designed to strengthen the collision repair workforce by increasing access to mentorship and apprenticeship programs, reducing financial barriers of entry and developing scholarship programs for aspiring collision repair professionals.

“America’s drivers depend on an automotive repair industry that is staffed with talented, highly skilled professionals, and developing the next generation of that workforce is critical,” said Mark Scafati, board member of Champion It Forward and vice president of sales and marketing for North America for LKQ. “Champion It Forward has created an opportunity for companies throughout our industry to come together around that shared responsibility. LKQ is proud to contribute $50,000 to support its mission and help more individuals discover, pursue and succeed in rewarding careers in collision repair.”
paras.zh: QUERY LENGTH LIMIT EXCEEDED. MAX ALLOWED QUERY : 500 CHARS

paras.en: The automotive collision repair industry is facing a workforce shortage, with more than 55% of collision repair technician positions unfilled and demand for nearly 100,000 technicians over the next five years, according to the latest industry data.

LKQ’s contribution follows the organization raising $300,000 at Crash Champions’ annual Champions Classic charity golf outing earlier this year. The event brought together more than 200 golfers and more than 50 sponsors and partners from across the collision repair and automotive industries, demonstrating broad industry support for Champion It Forward and its mission.

“LKQ is stepping up to send a powerful message about the importance of investing in the people who will carry this industry and the skilled trades forward,” said Seth Ingall, president and chairman of the board for Champion It Forward and chief legal officer for Crash Champions. “This gift will directly support our efforts to create greater access to training, education and career opportunities for the next generation of collision repair professionals. We are incredibly grateful to the entire LKQ team for believing in our mission and helping us turn that mission into action.”

articles.title: Collision Consulting provides consumer handout on new Washington claims handling rules
articles.author: Teresa Moss

paras.en: New claims handling rules in Washington State have prompted Collision Consulting to update a consumer handout that outlines how to manage auto claims in the state.
The changes went into effect Oct. 18, and are extensive.

Consumer Consulting, an appraisal and investigations company owned by Jeff Butler, states that the new rules give claimants stronger rights to inspections, written explanations, data transparency, and prompt responses.
The handout provides consumers eight rights they have while managing an auto claim.
It starts with the right to choose a repair facility.

“The insurer may not unreasonably deny your chosen repair facility’s estimate,” the handout states. “If it pays less, it must promptly disclose all reasons, explain the policy basis for rejecting the estimate or invoice, and document the decision in its claim file.”

The handout adds that consumers do not have to accept a photo-only estimate when the damage is disputed. It states that if a virtual inspection was used and there’s a disagreement over the amount of loss, the consumer can request an in-person inspection.
“The insurer must conduct its in-person inspection within five business days, unless another time is agreed,” the handout states.

Supplements and final invoices also now have a five-business day response requirement, the handout states. It adds that the insurance company is required to respond in writing to both the claimant and the repair facility with its determination of covered amounts. Rejected items must be tied to applicable policy language, the facts of the loss, or both.
Insurance companies also must explain in writing how labor and material costs and repair processes were determined, at claimant request, the handout states.

“If it relies on a database, survey, estimating system, or benchmark for labor or material pricing, request the data date, geographic source, and the businesses that supplied the cost data,” the handout adds. “A reasonable investigation may not rely solely on a database.”

Consumers also can request to be included in all insurance communication with the repair shop, the handout states. It adds that the insurer must allow claim information by email, mail, fax, or in-person delivery.
The insurance company also is responsible for the accuracy of its evaluation and must consider newly discovered loss-related damage.

“Estimates prepared by the insurer must be made by a competent person with relevant expertise, training, and experience to evaluate your damaged vehicle, and the insurer is responsible for the accuracy of its repair documentation and evaluations,” the handout states. “The insurer must consider additional loss-related damage discovered by the claimant or repair facility.”
Additionally, an investigation must not solely rely upon databases.

First-party insureds may request portions of their claim file, including estimates, notes, reports, photographs, and communications, the handout states. The insurance company has 15 business days to provide the requested documents.
Claims investigations generally must be completed within 30 calendar days or the insurer must provide written reasons and continued 30-day updates.
Lastly, the handout also gives details on the right-to-appraisal law that was passed last year.
“Under RCW 48.18.620, every automobile insurance policy with first-party physical damage coverage must include a Right to Appraisal,” the handout says.
The document gives steps on how consumers can use the right-to-appraisal:
- “Each party selects a competent and disinterested appraiser within 10 days.
- “Appraisers independently evaluate the actual cash value and amount of loss.
- “If the appraisers disagree, they select a neutral umpire.
- “If they cannot agree on an umpire, the Washington State Insurance Commissioner appoints one.
- “Any agreement by two of the three (either both appraisers or one appraiser and the umpire) is binding.
- “The appraisal process must be completed within 30 days.”
Photo courtesy of Nutthaseth Vanchaichana/iStock

articles.title: California insurance department holding AI use public workshop, launches survey
articles.author: Lurah Lowery

paras.en: The California Department of Insurance (CDI) will hold a public workshop on Dec. 15 and is conducting an industry survey to help establish consumer safeguards for using artificial intelligence in insurance, according to a CDI press release.

CDI invites consumers, insurance companies, researchers, technology developers, advocates, and the public to help shape how emerging technologies are used within the nation’s largest insurance market.

CDI says input from its “Responsible Use of Artificial Intelligence (RUAI) Survey” and upcoming workshop will inform future regulatory and policy considerations to protect consumers while supporting responsible innovation. CDI says it is surveying a representative sample: “California-admitted insurance companies or groups that wrote at least $250 million in annual California premiums during 2025, selected California-admitted InsurTech companies, and selected insurance companies and groups that transact insurance business through managing general agents.” Survey responses are due by Dec. 30.
paras.zh: QUERY LENGTH LIMIT EXCEEDED. MAX ALLOWED QUERY : 500 CHARS

paras.en: “AI and other advanced analytical technologies are increasingly being used across the insurance industry to support claims processing, fraud detection, customer service, underwriting support, and operational decision-making,” the release states. “While these tools can improve efficiency and enhance customer experiences, they also present risks when not properly designed, tested, monitored, governed, and overseen.
“Without appropriate safeguards, AI systems may produce inaccurate outcomes, compromise sensitive personal information, reduce transparency, or amplify unfair bias and discrimination.”
Commissioner Ricardo Lara adds that “consumers should never be left wondering whether an algorithm, rather than a fair and accountable process, determined their outcome.”

During the workshop, participants are encouraged to share their experiences, concerns, and recommendations regarding transparency, fairness, privacy, human oversight, accountability, and insurer responsibility for technologies supplied by third-party vendors. It begins at 10 a.m. For more information and to register, click here.

The release notes that the workshop won’t focus on specific regulatory text, and the invitation is not a Notice of Proposed Action. CDI says that any future formal regulatory proposal would include a separate public process and additional opportunities for public comment.

articles.title: Allstate planning round of layoffs in restructuring with AI push
articles.author: Lurah Lowery

paras.en: P&C Specialist reports Allstate plans to lay off up to 10% of its employees under a company restructuring “aimed at streamlining operations in an AI-driven efficiency push.”

Sources didn’t confirm the exact number; however, they said up to 10% of Allstate’s workforce could be affected, according to the article. The company’s 2025 annual report states that it employs 53,000.

“Layoffs hit across the organization, including at unit National General and in customer service, underwriting, legal, inside sales, casualty, design, human resources, information technology, claims and support, said sources, who asked not to be named, discussing internal issues,” the article states. “The cuts are not tied to individual performance but stem from broader organizational realignment at Allstate, they said.”
Allstate hasn’t commented on the reported layoffs.
In its Nov. 5 Q3 earnings call, Allstate CEO Tom Wilson said the company will launch a personal agentic assistant (PAA) next year, which it has been working on for a year.

“The advent of personal agentic assistants, or PAAs, gives us the opportunity to serve consumers who prefer to have a machine to handle their transactions, such as Muse, Spark, Dot, you go down the list,” he said. “The introduction of PAAs creates opportunity for Allstate, given our capabilities, and an upcoming launch of our own personal agentic assistant that is focused on protection.

“To thrive in this world of highly sophisticated agents, you need sophisticated pricing, since they’re likely going to do more price comparisons. Secondly, some consumers may still have a brand preference or want a local agent, so we have a broad set of opportunities for them. When ALLIE [Allstate’s Large Language Intelligent Ecosystem] is fully deployed, and the PAAs have expanded their capabilities, this will give customers straight-through processing on servicing claims… Its value proposition includes more accurate pricing, given our insurance expertise, than the general-purpose PAAs will have.”
paras.zh: QUERY LENGTH LIMIT EXCEEDED. MAX ALLOWED QUERY : 500 CHARS

paras.en: Allstate began designing and building ALLIE several years ago, according to Wilson, who noted in the call that “like most companies, we are using AI to do an increasing amount of coding.”

articles.title: Hurry! School of the Year Nomination Deadline is Near!
articles.author: Doug Kaufman

paras.en: Don’t miss your chance to nominate your school or another deserving educational institution for Tomorrow’s Technician’s 2026/2027 School of the Year competition. WIX Filters is once again partnering with O’Reilly Auto Parts as title sponsors for the national contest that finds and names the best technician training school in the country.

“There’s a massive difference between the number of automotive professionals retiring or leaving the industry and the number entering to take their place. Due to the rapidly expanding use of technology in today’s vehicles, this is one of the toughest careers to keep educated about. It requires a knowledge of science, math, communications and business skills – not the grease monkey persona that many people believe still exists,” explains Doug Kaufman, editorial director for Tomorrow’s Technician. “Today’s standards of excellence are defined by a combination of education and experience. The future of the automotive sector relies on the dedication of instructors and the commitment of industry partners to develop skilled professionals capable of navigating a rapidly changing landscape. The School of the Year program, sponsored by WIX, honors schools that exemplify the best in automotive education and are dedicated to shaping the future of the industry.”

paras.en: “The automotive industry needs skilled technicians now more than ever. At WIX Filters, we are committed to supporting the next generation of professionals through programs like ‘School of the Year.’ By investing in these students today, we are helping to build a stronger workforce, support local communities, and ensure that the automotive aftermarket remains strong for years to come” said Carmina Lopez, WIX Filters Brand Manager.

articles.title: CREF Awards Deliver $475K to Collision Schools
articles.author: Jason Stahl

paras.en: The Collision Repair Education Foundation (CREF) announced that 71 collision schools will receive a combined $475,000 through its 2026 Benchmark Awards program. Recipients were announced at CREF’s Benchmark Awards Breakfast held Nov. 4 in Las Vegas during the 2026 SEMA Show.

Schools were selected through CREF’s 2026 Collision School Career Readiness Benchmark Awards program, which provides financial assistance to help collision education programs overcome budgetary limitations and prepare students for careers. Benchmark Awards can be used, in line with the award category, to enhance program capabilities, attract new students or fuel innovative approaches to collision education.

These funds will help instructors strengthen programs, invest in tools and equipment, and provide hands-on training and technical skills. Based on current enrollment figures, the investments are expected to benefit more than 3,580 students this year, with improvements continuing to support future classes.

“Congratulations to the 2026 Benchmark Award recipients,” said Brenda Hogen, chair of CREF. “The Collision Repair Education Foundation is incredibly grateful to our industry partners whose generosity makes these awards possible year after year. Their continued investment demonstrates a shared commitment to strengthening collision education and ensuring that the next generation of repair professionals has the knowledge and skills needed to succeed in our industry. I also want to recognize the dedicated instructors who take the time to apply for these awards, demonstrating their determination to provide students with the best possible education despite the challenges they face.
paras.zh: QUERY LENGTH LIMIT EXCEEDED. MAX ALLOWED QUERY : 500 CHARS

paras.en: “Collision repair programs are the foundation of our industry’s future workforce, and the instructors leading those programs play an essential role in preparing students for successful careers. By connecting industry support with schools in need, CREF helps educators strengthen their programs, expand opportunities for hands-on learning and better prepare students to enter the workforce. We’re proud to be part of that process and grateful to the many organizations that recognize the importance of investing in tomorrow’s collision professionals.”

paras.en: Added CREF Director of Operations and Impact Melissa Marscin, “For the schools receiving these awards, that industry support translates into opportunities to address some of the most persistent challenges facing collision repair education. Many instructors struggle just to maintain their existing equipment and resources, making it even more difficult to introduce new technologies, update training materials or expand their programs to keep pace with an evolving industry. The Benchmark Awards help bridge that financial gap by providing schools with resources they might otherwise be unable to afford, ultimately creating stronger learning environments for students preparing to enter the collision repair workforce.

articles.title: Advance Auto Parts Foundation Awards 24 Scholarships
articles.author: Mary DellaValle

paras.en: The Advance Auto Parts Foundation today announced the recipients of its 2026 scholarship program, awarding 24 scholarships to students pursuing higher education. The annual program helps family members of Advance Auto Parts team members continue their education and work toward earning degrees.

This year’s recipients stood out for their academic achievement, leadership, community involvement, personal accomplishments and future goals. Each student will receive a one-time scholarship of $3,500 to support their education.

“Supporting our team members also means supporting their families, and we’re proud to recognize these students and their achievements,” said Anthony Sarlanis, president of the Advance Auto Parts Foundation and senior vice president, professional at Advance Auto Parts. “Their hard work and dedication have earned this recognition, and we’re proud to help them take the next step in their education. We congratulate each recipient and look forward to seeing all they accomplish in the years ahead.”
The 2026 scholarship recipients and the schools they’re attending:
- Cacee Arthur, Ivy Tech Community College, Ind.
- Micayla Barron, University of South Carolina
- Natalia Ceciliano Martinez, University of Alabama Huntsville
- Emily Da Cruz, Rutgers University, N.J.

articles.title: NTN Holds Community Spirit & Engagement Event
articles.author: Alex Crissey

paras.en: NTN Bearing Corp. of America held its Community Spirit & Engagement Event at the Elk Grove Township Food Pantry in Elk Grove Village, Illinois, on Tuesday, October 27. A team of twelve NTN employees volunteered to help combat food insecurity and support local families ahead of Thanksgiving.

Volunteers spent the morning assembling approximately 400 Thanksgiving food bags that will be distributed to families throughout the community. Designed as a “trick-or-treat” style shopping experience, team members worked together at various food stations, collecting and packing items including cooking oil, canned vegetables, canned pumpkin, mashed potatoes, macaroni and cheese, gravy, brownie mix, and other household necessities.

In the afternoon, NTN employees assisted pantry staff with organizing and storing five pallets of donated food. According to the food pantry manager, the work completed by the NTN team in a few hours would have taken the pantry’s regular staff and volunteers up to a month to accomplish.

NTN’s Community Spirit & Engagement Program, launched in January 2023, includes contributing time and resources to charitable organizations, encouraging employees to take an active role in the local community, and building partnerships with other groups and organizations.

The Elk Grove Township Food Pantry provides food assistance and related support services to residents facing food insecurity, serving approximately 1,100 families each month through a client-choice model that allows households to access nutritious food and household essentials in a dignified and convenient manner. Through partnerships with community organizations, donors, and volunteers, the pantry helps ensure local families have access to the resources they need throughout the year and is expected to distribute the Thanksgiving food bags assembled during the event to nearly 900 families this holiday season.

articles.title: Mitchell 1 Adds QuickSpecs Feature for Faster Repair Lookup
articles.author: Alex Crissey

paras.en: Mitchell 1 has added a “QuickSpecs” feature in its ProDemand repair information, aimed at helping technicians look things up faster.

“When technicians need specification information, they need it immediately,” said Cami Hermann, marketing director for Mitchell 1. “QuickSpecs helps eliminate unnecessary scrolling and table hunting so users can get directly to the information they need and keep repairs moving. The enhancement is part of Mitchell 1’s broader effort to streamline technician workflow and improve efficiency throughout the repair process.”

With added integration with 1Search Plus navigation, QuickSpecs now displays only the information directly related to the search entered by the user. For example, if a technician searches for “lug nut torque,” the system immediately surfaces the matching torque specifications instead of requiring users to scroll through large tables or unrelated information, the company said.

Mitchell 1 says it also redesigned the Common Specs Quick Link experience with a cleaner accordion-style layout Instead of searching through one long table, users can jump directly to the section they need.
QuickSpecs currently supports 2015-2026 vehicles at launch, and Mitchell 1 says it expects to add coverage for 1995-2014 vehicles by the end of 2026.

articles.title: AutoZone’s Phil Daniele on ‘Putting Customers First’
articles.author: Mary DellaValle

paras.en: This episode of DriveTime features Phil Daniele, president and CEO of customer satisfaction at AutoZone.
paras.zh: 本期 DriveTime 的主角是 AutoZone 客户满意度总裁兼首席执行官 Phil Daniele。

paras.en: Daniele said the company’s commercial business has evolved significantly as it continues investing in the professional repair market. With commercial sales approaching $6 billion and programs in approximately 95% of its stores, AutoZone is strengthening its product quality, availability and delivery capabilities to better serve repair shops. Daniele emphasized the importance of OE-quality or better products, including its Duralast portfolio, alongside expanded assortments through its hub and mega hub strategy. Investments in technology, inventory optimization and a dedicated professional sales force are helping AutoZone get the right parts to shops faster while building stronger customer relationships.
paras.zh: Daniele 表示，随着公司继续投资专业维修市场，其商业业务已取得显着发展。 AutoZone 的商业销售额接近 60 亿美元，并在其约 95% 的商店中实施了该计划，因此正在加强其产品质量、可用性和交付能力，以更好地为维修店提供服务。 Daniele 强调了原厂品质或更好产品的重要性，包括其 Duralast 产品组合，以及通过其中心和大型中心战略扩大的品种。对技术、库存优化和专业销售队伍的投资正在帮助 AutoZone 更快地将合适的零件送到商店，同时建立更牢固的客户关系。

paras.en: AutoZone’s recent milestone of 8,000 stores globally reflects decades of expansion and continued growth opportunities, Daniele explained. The company also celebrated its 1,000th store in Mexico, expanded distribution capabilities there and broke ground on another facility. Looking ahead, AutoZone plans to continue opening stores across the United States, Mexico and Brazil. Daniele said that expansion creates opportunities not only to serve more customers but also to develop future leaders within the organization. AutoZone’s promote-from-within culture has helped employees build long-term careers, with many executives beginning their careers in stores.
paras.zh: Daniele 解释说，AutoZone 最近在全球拥有 8,000 家门店的里程碑反映了数十年的扩张和持续增长机会。该公司还庆祝其在墨西哥开设第 1,000 家商店，扩大了当地的分销能力，并在另一家工厂破土动工。展望未来，AutoZone 计划继续在美国、墨西哥和巴西开设门店。 Daniele 表示，扩张不仅创造了服务更多客户的机会，而且还为组织内培养未来的领导者创造了机会。 AutoZone 的内部晋升文化帮助员工建立了长期的职业生涯，许多高管都是在商店开始他们的职业生涯的。

paras.en: Delivering strong customer service remains central to AutoZone’s culture and operating philosophy. Daniele said empowering approximately 130,000 AutoZoners to consistently exceed customer expectations requires strong systems, processes and accountability. That means delivering quality parts quickly, ensuring accurate transactions and understanding each customer’s specific needs. Daniele emphasized that every interaction, from sales representatives to delivery drivers, contributes to the customer experience. By combining operational execution with a customer-first mindset, AutoZone aims to strengthen relationships and deliver the level of service that keeps customers coming back.
paras.zh: 提供强大的客户服务仍然是 AutoZone 文化和运营理念的核心。 Daniele 表示，要让大约 130,000 名 AutoZoners 持续超越客户期望，需要强大的系统、流程和问责制。这意味着快速交付优质零件，确保准确的交易并了解每个客户的具体需求。 Daniele 强调，从销售代表到送货司机的每一次互动都有助于提升客户体验。通过将运营执行与客户至上的理念相结合，AutoZone 旨在加强关系并提供高水平的服务，让客户成为回头客。

articles.title: Sonic Tools USA Relaunches Next S15 13-Drawer Toolbox
articles.author: Alex Crissey

paras.en: Sonic Tools USA has relaunched its Next S15 toolbox, a 13-drawer storage unit with a load capacity of more than one ton. The toolbox can scale from a mobile service cart to a full-capacity tool center for technicians, shops and fleets.
The Next S15 measures 46.5 inches high, 65 inches wide and 26 inches deep. It includes molded bumpers, integrated side pockets, two spray can holders and a paper roll holder.

According to the company, the toolbox uses ball-bearing drawer slides with soft-close technology and provides full-extension access on all 13 drawers. An advanced drawer-blocking system provides anti-tilt protection. A stainless steel worktop with integrated side pockets comes standard for shop use and tire maintenance operations.
Applications range from compact quick-service carts to large-format storage for high-volume service and tire repair facilities, the company said.

The relaunch includes a redesigned foam insert system. Two medium foam inserts can combine to form one large insert to accommodate growing tool sets. Existing foam inserts transfer directly into the S15, allowing users to maintain their current layouts without rebuilding configurations, the company said.

paras.zh: - AutoZone 的枢纽和大型枢纽战略以及专业销售队伍如何支持其不断增长的商业业务。 (11:07)

paras.en: - What AutoZone’s 8,000-store milestone represents for future expansion and employee career opportunities. (15:21)
paras.zh: - AutoZone 的 8,000 家门店里程碑对未来的扩张和员工职业机会意味着什么。 （15:21）

paras.en: - How AutoZone empowers 130,000 AutoZoners to consistently deliver WOW customer service. (21:34)
paras.zh: - AutoZone 如何帮助 130,000 名 AutoZoner 持续提供令人惊叹的客户服务。 (21:34)

paras.en: - Why AutoZone sees significant growth opportunities in the professional repair market. (30:10)
- Lightning Round: Daniele shares some personal insights. (32:03)

articles.title: DRiV Announces Joint Venture With XGM
articles.author: Jeff White

paras.en: DRiV announced a joint venture with XGM Corporation Limited (XGM), an international manufacturer of automotive components. The joint venture expands DRiV’s ride-control offerings across both branded and private-label products. Retail partners across North America can now source a broader selection of private-label products through a streamlined channel. This gives retailers greater operational speed and flexibility.
paras.zh: DRiV 宣布与国际汽车零部件制造商 XGM Corporation Limited (XGM) 成立合资企业。该合资企业将 DRiV 的驾乘控制产品扩展到品牌和自有品牌产品。北美各地的零售合作伙伴现在可以通过简化的渠道采购更广泛的自有品牌产品。这为零售商提供了更高的运营速度和灵活性。

paras.en: DRiV Expands Private-Label Ride-Control Offerings
paras.zh: DRiV 扩展自有品牌行驶控制产品

paras.en: “Our customers want more choice without complexity,” said Joseph Saoud, vice president and general manager of the Americas at DRiV. “This joint venture lets us add a broader private-label range alongside the brands they already trust, with the speed and pricing to compete, and all of it through the DRiV relationship they already have.”
paras.zh: DRiV 美洲区副总裁兼总经理 Joseph Saoud 表示：“我们的客户希望有更多选择，但又不复杂。” “这家合资企业让我们能够在他们已经信任的品牌之外添加更广泛的自有品牌产品，并通过速度和价格进行竞争，而这一切都是通过他们已经拥有的 DRiV 关系实现的。”

paras.en: “By combining our manufacturing capabilities with DRiV’s customer access, product engineering and technical support, we’re creating new opportunities to serve customers with greater scale, responsiveness and speed,” said Edwin Jiang, legal representative & executive director at XGM. “This joint venture positions us to support DRiV’s continued growth and deliver high-quality ride-control solutions that meet the evolving needs of the North American market.”
paras.zh: XGM 法人代表兼执行董事 Edwin Jiang 表示：“通过将我们的制造能力与 DRiV 的客户访问、产品工程和技术支持相结合，我们正在创造新的机会，以更大的规模、更快的响应能力和速度为客户提供服务。” “这家合资企业使我们能够支持 DRiV 的持续增长，并提供高质量的驾乘控制解决方案，以满足北美市场不断变化的需求。”

paras.en: Partnership Expands Distribution Options
paras.zh: 合作伙伴关系扩大了分销选择

paras.en: Retail partners can access these expanded private-label ride-control offerings through existing distribution and fulfillment channels. The expanded offerings complement DRiV’s branded portfolio and support a more comprehensive approach to category management.
paras.zh: 零售合作伙伴可以通过现有的分销和履行渠道获得这些扩展的自有品牌驾驶控制产品。扩展后的产品补充了 DRiV 的品牌产品组合，并支持更全面的品类管理方法。

articles.title: Continental Names Head of Commercial Specialty Tires Americas
articles.author: Christian Hinton

paras.en: Continental appointed Ashok Vedanayagam as head of Commercial Specialty Tires Americas. He will oversee earthmoving, material handling and port operations tire segments across North and South America.
paras.zh: 大陆集团任命 Ashok Vedanayagam 为美洲商用特种轮胎主管。他将负责北美和南美的土方工程、物料搬运和港口运营轮胎业务。

paras.en: His background includes more than two decades in leadership roles. He has worked across commercial truck tire and passenger and light truck tire businesses in multiple regions.
paras.zh: 他拥有二十多年的领导经验。他曾在多个地区的商用卡车轮胎以及乘用车和轻型卡车轮胎业务部门工作过。

paras.en: “Ashok’s extensive experience in sales, marketing, and international business leadership makes him exceptionally well qualified for this role,” said Renato Sarzano, senior vice president, Commercial Tires Americas, Continental. “His proven ability to build strong customer relationships, develop high-performing teams, and deliver results across both consumer and commercial markets will be invaluable as we continue to strengthen our Commercial Specialty Tires business throughout the Americas.”
paras.zh: “阿肖克在销售、营销和国际业务领导力方面的丰富经验使他非常适合担任这一职位，”大陆集团商用轮胎美洲区高级副总裁雷纳托·萨尔扎诺 (Renato Sarzano) 表示。 “随着我们继续加强整个美洲的商用特种轮胎业务，他在建立牢固的客户关系、培养高绩效团队以及在消费者和商业市场取得成果方面的能力得到了证实，这将是非常宝贵的。”

paras.en: Continental said the appointment supports its focus on customers in the Americas through products, industry expertise and operational execution.
paras.zh: 大陆集团表示，此次任命将通过产品、行业专业知识和运营执行来支持其对美洲客户的关注。

articles.title: TWG Names Kevin Valenzuela Data Specialist
articles.author: Jeff White

paras.en: The Wheel Group (TWG), a designer, developer and distributor of aftermarket wheels, tires, accessories and off-road brands, recently announced the hiring of Kevin Valenzuela. He joins the company as its new product data specialist. The company said Valenzuela brings extensive experience in automotive aftermarket catalog management, product data and technical support.
paras.zh: The Wheel Group (TWG) 是一家售后市场车轮、轮胎、配件和越野品牌的设计、开发商和分销商，最近宣布聘用 Kevin Valenzuela。他加入公司担任新产品数据专家。该公司表示，巴伦苏埃拉在汽车售后市场目录管理、产品数据和技术支持方面拥有丰富的经验。

paras.en: The Wheel Group Adds Aftermarket Data Experience
paras.zh: The Wheel Group 增加售后数据体验

paras.en: Most recently, Valenzuela served as a data analyst at Advanced Innovative Technology Corp. (TrakMotive). There, he supported product strategy, competitive analysis, pricing, market research and catalog accuracy. His work included application validation, digital asset management and ensuring product information aligned with industry standards.
paras.zh: 最近，Valenzuela 在 Advanced Innovative Technology Corp. (TrakMotive) 担任数据分析师。在那里，他负责支持产品策略、竞争分析、定价、市场研究和目录准确性。他的工作包括应用程序验证、数字资产管理以及确保产品信息符合行业标准。

paras.en: Prior to that, Valenzuela spent nearly three years as a data support specialist focused on catalog management. He oversaw product and application data across multiple product lines. He worked extensively with ACES and PIES standards, product fitment validation, new product introductions and catalog development. His work supported major retailers and distribution platforms.
paras.zh: 在此之前，Valenzuela 担任了近三年的数据支持专家，专注于目录管理。他负责监督多个产品线的产品和应用数据。他广泛从事 ACES 和 PIES 标准、产品装配验证、新产品介绍和目录开发方面的工作。他的工作为主要零售商和分销平台提供支持。

paras.en: Valenzuela also brings a technical foundation from his earlier career with NCR Corp., where he held several technical and implementation support roles. Combined with his hands-on automotive experience, this background gives him an understanding of the automotive industry’s technical and practical sides, TWG said.
paras.zh: Valenzuela 还从他早期在 NCR Corp. 的职业生涯中获得了技术基础，他在该公司担任过多个技术和实施支持职务。 TWG 表示，结合他在汽车领域的实践经验，这种背景使他能够了解汽车行业的技术和实践方面。

paras.en: Valenzuela to Support Product Data and Catalog Management
paras.zh: Valenzuela 支持产品数据和目录管理

paras.en: In his new role at The Wheel Group, Valenzuela will help strengthen product data accuracy, catalog management and application information. His work will span the company’s growing portfolio of brands. His experience will support TWG’s efforts to improve product information, enhance digital resources and provide reliable, comprehensive product data. These efforts will serve customers and distribution partners.
paras.zh: Valenzuela 在 The Wheel Group 担任新职务后，将帮助加强产品数据准确性、目录管理和应用信息。他的工作将涵盖公司不断增长的品牌组合。他的经验将支持 TWG 改进产品信息、增强数字资源并提供可靠、全面的产品数据的努力。这些努力将为客户和分销合作伙伴服务。

paras.en: “Accurate product information is essential to our business and to the experience we deliver to our customers,” said Joe Podlovits, vice president of Marketing and National Accounts at The Wheel Group. “Kevin brings valuable aftermarket experience and a strong understanding of catalog management and industry standards. We’re excited to have him on board and look forward to the contributions he’ll make as we continue to grow our brands and capabilities.”
paras.zh: “准确的产品信息对于我们的业务以及我们为客户提供的体验至关重要，”The Wheel Group 营销和国民账户副总裁 Joe Podlovits 表示。 “凯文带来了宝贵的售后经验以及对目录管理和行业标准的深刻理解。我们很高兴他加入，并期待他在我们继续发展我们的品牌和能力的过程中做出贡献。”

articles.title: Advance Auto Parts Opens First Store in King of Prussia
articles.author: Mary DellaValle

paras.en: Advance Auto Parts opened its first store in King of Prussia, Pennsylvania, expanding access to parts, tools and expertise for local drivers and automotive professionals. The company marked the opening of the store at 125 W. Dekalb Pike with a ribbon-cutting ceremony alongside local officials and representatives from Central Montco Technical High School who were on site to accept a donation for the school’s automotive technology program.
paras.zh: Advance Auto Parts 在宾夕法尼亚州普鲁士国王开设了第一家商店，为当地驾驶员和汽车专业人士提供了更多零件、工具和专业知识。该公司为庆祝位于 125 W. Dekalb Pike 的商店开业举行了剪彩仪式，当地官员和中央 Montco 技术高中的代表在现场接受了学校汽车技术项目的捐款。

paras.en: The donation will help students gain hands-on experience, training and career opportunities through the school’s automotive technology programs. Skilled automotive technicians continue to be in high demand, with approximately 70,000 openings projected annually through 2034, according to U.S. Bureau of Labor Statistics.
paras.zh: 此次捐赠将帮助学生通过学校的汽车技术项目获得实践经验、培训和职业机会。根据美国劳工统计局的数据，熟练的汽车技术人员的需求量仍然很高，预计到 2034 年，每年大约有 70,000 个职位空缺。

paras.en: “We’re excited to bring Advance Auto Parts to King of Prussia and open our first store in the community,” said Eli Rosa, regional vice president, Advance Auto Parts. “In addition to serving local customers, this market hub will help strengthen support for professional technicians and nearby shops across the area. We’re proud to mark the occasion by supporting Central Montco Technical High School and the programs that help students prepare for automotive technician careers.”
paras.zh: Advance Auto Parts 区域副总裁 Eli Rosa 表示：“我们很高兴将 Advance Auto Parts 带到普鲁士国王，并在社区开设我们的第一家商店。” “除了服务当地客户外，这个市场中心还将有助于加强对整个地区的专业技术人员和附近商店的支持。我们很自豪能够通过支持中央蒙特科技术高中和帮助学生为汽车技术人员职业生涯做好准备的计划来纪念这一时刻。”

paras.en: “We appreciate Advance Auto Parts’ support of career and technical education,” said Craig Robinson, administrative director at Central Montco Technical High School. “This donation helps support the hands-on learning experiences that are at the core of our automotive technology program and gives students opportunities to build skills they’ll use long after graduation.”
paras.zh: “我们感谢 Advance Auto Parts 对职业和技术教育的支持，”中央 Montco 技术高中行政总监 Craig Robinson 说道。 “这笔捐款有助于支持作为我们汽车技术项目核心的实践学习体验，并为学生提供培养毕业后长期使用的技能的机会。”

paras.en: The new store also serves as a market hub – a centralized facility designed to improve parts availability and same-day fulfillment across a network of stores, enhancing hard parts coverage for professional customers, Advance Auto Parts said.
paras.zh: Advance Auto Parts 表示，新店还充当市场中心，这是一个集中设施，旨在提高整个商店网络的零部件可用性和当日履行率，从而提高专业客户的硬件零部件覆盖率。

articles.title: NexaMotion Group Names Inaugural Vendors of the Year
articles.author: Mary DellaValle

paras.en: NexaMotion Group (NMG) named UAC (Universal Air Conditioner, Inc.) and Precision International the recipients of its first annual Vendor of the Year award. The program honors supplier partners whose commitment to NMG’s customers, team and strategy extends well beyond the purchase order.
paras.zh: NexaMotion Group (NMG) 将 UAC (Universal Air Conditioner, Inc.) 和 Precision International 授予其首个年度供应商奖。该计划旨在表彰对 NMG 客户、团队和战略的承诺远远超出采购订单范围的供应商合作伙伴。

paras.en: For 50 years, from the founding of Transtar to the formation of NexaMotion Group, that kind of supplier partnership has been a cornerstone of how the company competes. Honorees were selected by NMG’s executive and supply chain leadership on availability, quality and responsiveness, and on a harder test: how far the supplier was willing to go in service of NMG’s strategy and its customers’ success.
paras.zh: 50 年来，从 Transtar 的成立到 NexaMotion 集团的成立，这种供应商合作伙伴关系一直是公司竞争的基石。获奖者是由 NMG 的高管和供应链领导层根据可用性、质量和响应能力以及更严格的测试选出的：供应商愿意在多大程度上为 NMG 的战略和客户的成功提供服务。

paras.en: “Anyone can fill an order. Our best partners help us build the business,” said Scott Weinstein, President of NexaMotion Group. “UAC and Precision International show up in the planning room, not just on the loading dock. They bring us coverage before our customers ask for it, they invest in our people and our shops, and when we make bold moves as a company they are right beside us. That is partnership, and it is what this award was created to honor.”
paras.zh: “任何人都可以填写订单。我们最好的合作伙伴帮助我们发展业务，”NexaMotion 集团总裁 Scott Weinstein 说道。 “UAC 和 Precision International 出现在规划室，而不仅仅是装货码头。他们在客户提出要求之前就为我们提供报道，他们对我们的员工和商店进行投资，当我们作为一家公司采取大胆行动时，他们就在我们身边。这就是合作伙伴关系，这也是这个奖项的设立的目的。”

paras.en: Founded in 1988 and headquartered in Mansfield, Texas, UAC designs and supplies automotive air conditioning components, from compressors and condensers to evaporators, driers, hose assemblies and electrical parts, backed by a factory audit process and an in-house validation team. NMG recently selected UAC as the lead air conditioning supplier for its general repair business, a decision shaped as much by UAC’s willingness to plan, train and invest alongside NMG’s teams as by the quality of its catalog. UAC is led by Francisco Coll, CEO, and Sophia Coll Crowley, CEO, with Luke Masters, Vice President of Business Development.
paras.zh: UAC 成立于 1988 年，总部位于德克萨斯州曼斯菲尔德，设计和供应汽车空调组件，从压缩机和冷凝器到蒸发器、干燥器、软管组件和电气零件，并有工厂审核流程和内部验证团队的支持。 NMG 最近选择 UAC 作为其一般维修业务的主要空调供应商，这一决定不仅取决于 UAC 与 NMG 团队一起计划、培训和投资的意愿，还取决于其产品目录的质量。 UAC 由首席执行官 Francisco Coll 和首席执行官 Sophia Coll Crowley 以及业务开发副总裁 Luke Masters 领导。

paras.en: Founded in 1975 by Dennis Marshall and based in Yaphank, New York, Precision International supplies more than 3,000 transmission kits and nearly 10,000 parts and components to rebuilders worldwide. The company is ISO 9001 certified and a five-time consecutive General Motors Supplier of the Year. Precision International is led by Tina Parente, President, with Frank Miller, Executive Vice President, and John Sollazzo, Vice President of Sales and Marketing.
paras.zh: Precision International 由丹尼斯·马歇尔 (Dennis Marshall) 于 1975 年创立，总部位于纽约州雅芬克 (Yaphank)，为全球重建商提供 3,000 多种变速箱套件和近 10,000 个零部件。该公司已通过 ISO 9001 认证，并连续五次荣获通用汽车年度供应商称号。 Precision International 由总裁 Tina Parente、执行副总裁 Frank Miller 以及销售和营销副总裁 John Sollazzo 领导。

paras.en: “Both companies share forecasts with us, solve problems before they reach a customer, and measure their success by whether our shops win the job,” said Tim Cox, EVP of Supply Chain, NexaMotion Group. “That is when a supplier relationship stops being a transaction and becomes a competitive advantage for everyone it touches.”
paras.zh: NexaMotion Group 供应链执行副总裁 Tim Cox 表示：“两家公司都与我们分享预测，在问题到达客户之前解决问题，并通过我们的商店是否赢得这份工作来衡量他们的成功。” “那时供应商关系不再是一种交易，而是成为它所接触的每个人的竞争优势。”

paras.en: NMG said it will present the Vendor of the Year award annually. UAC and Precision International products are available through NMG’s business brands and sales representatives.
paras.zh: NMG 表示将每年颁发年度供应商奖。 UAC 和 Precision International 产品可通过 NMG 的商业品牌和销售代表购买。

articles.title: Rare swarm of asteroids from the solar system’s youth found trailing Neptune around the sun
articles.author: Abha Jain

paras.en: Astronomers using the Vera C. Rubin Observatory have discovered two ancient Trojan asteroids trailing Neptune — the first new ones to be spotted in 15 years.
paras.zh: 使用维拉·C·鲁宾天文台的天文学家发现了两颗尾随海王星的古老特洛伊小行星，这是 15 年来首次发现的新小行星。

paras.en: The findings, published Oct. 15 in The Astrophysical Journal Letters, could improve our understanding of the early solar system while reinforcing the Rubin Observatory's potential to unearth new cosmic objects during its brisk scans of the sky.
paras.zh: 这一发现于 10 月 15 日发表在《天体物理学杂志快报》上，可以增进我们对早期太阳系的了解，同时增强鲁宾天文台在快速扫描天空时发现新宇宙物体的潜力。

paras.en: Trojan asteroids are icy, rocky bodies that dwell in a planet's vicinity but don't orbit it. Instead, these asteroids orbit the sun, following the same path as the planet. Trojan asteroids exist in distinct swarms roughly 60 degrees ahead of and behind the planet. At these points, called Lagrange points 4 and 5 (L4 and L5), respectively, the gravitational tugs of the sun and the planet balance each other, essentially "locking" the asteroids in position, according to NASA.
paras.zh: 特洛伊小行星是冰冷的岩石天体，居住在行星附近，但不绕行星运行。相反，这些小行星绕太阳运行，遵循与行星相同的路径。特洛伊小行星以不同的群存在于行星前后约 60 度的位置。据 NASA 称，在这些点，分别称为拉格朗日点 4 和 5（L4 和 L5），太阳和行星的引力相互平衡，基本上将小行星“锁定”在适当的位置。

paras.en: However, very few Trojans actually hang around for billions of years. Such asteroids are likely planetary building block remnants from the solar system's infancy, and detecting them in the outer solar system can be challenging.
paras.zh: 然而，很少有特洛伊木马能够真正存活数十亿年。此类小行星很可能是太阳系初期的行星构件残余物，在太阳系外层探测它们可能具有挑战性。

paras.en: Jupiter's Trojans are the most famous; the International Astronomical Union's Minor Planet Center notes that an incredible 15,000 of these objects have been discovered so far. But some other planets, including Neptune, also host Trojans. In fact, a 2005 study suggested that Neptune has up to 10 times more Trojans than Jupiter. Until now, though, astronomers have spotted only 28 Neptunian Trojans, with just two of these being long-term L5 members.
paras.zh: 木星的特洛伊木马是最著名的。国际天文学联合会小行星中心指出，迄今为止已发现的此类天体数量达到令人难以置信的 15,000 个。但包括海王星在内的其他一些行星也有特洛伊木马。事实上，2005 年的一项研究表明，海王星上的特洛伊木马数量是木星的 10 倍。不过，到目前为止，天文学家只发现了 28 个海王星特洛伊木马，其中只有两个是长期 L5 成员。

paras.en: There are two reasons why it's difficult to detect these rocks. First, the Neptunian Trojans are extremely faint. More critically, for nearly 15 years, the Trojan population's position in the sky relative to Earth has overlapped with the central region of the Milky Way. Consequently, bright background stars have made it nearly impossible to discern the tiny, faint asteroids, Megan Schwamb, the study's first author and a researcher who focuses on how planets and their building blocks form and evolve at Queen's University Belfast, told Live Science in an email.
paras.zh: 检测这些岩石之所以困难有两个原因。首先，海王星特洛伊人极其微弱。更关键的是，近15年来，特洛伊族群在天空中相对于地球的位置已经与银河系的中心区域重叠。因此，明亮的背景恒星使得人们几乎不可能辨别微小而微弱的小行星，该研究的第一作者、贝尔法斯特女王大学研究行星及其构件如何形成和演化的研究人员梅根·施瓦姆在一封电子邮件中告诉《生活科学》。

paras.en: However, from 2025 onward, the L5 group's position has moved — albeit extremely slowly — away from the galactic plane. This has made the population slightly easier to observe. At the same time, the Rubin Observatory started scanning the entire Southern Hemisphere sky with the world's largest digital camera.
paras.zh: 然而，从 2025 年开始，L5 集团的位置已经远离银河平面，尽管速度非常缓慢。这使得观察人群稍微容易一些。与此同时，鲁宾天文台开始用世界上最大的数码相机扫描整个南半球的天空。

paras.en: Get the world’s most fascinating discoveries delivered straight to your inbox.
paras.zh: 将世界上最迷人的发现直接发送到您的收件箱。

paras.en: "Rubin is pretty uniquely suited to being excellent at discovering Neptune Trojans," study co-author Kathryn Volk, a scientist at the Planetary Science Institute in Arizona, told Live Science in an email. "The on-sky density of these objects is not particularly high, so having a large field of view helps a lot!" (Rubin has a field of view equivalent to seven full moons, according to the observatory's website.) This, along with the observatory's excellent vision — which allows it to detect objects 100 billion times dimmer than Venus — enabled the discovery of the new Trojans.
paras.zh: “鲁宾非常适合发现海王星特洛伊木马，”该研究的合著者、亚利桑那州行星科学研究所的科学家凯瑟琳·沃尔克在一封电子邮件中告诉《生活科学》。 “这些物体在天空中的密度并不是特别高，因此拥有大视野会很有帮助！” （据天文台网站称，鲁宾的视野相当于七个满月。）这一点，再加上天文台出色的视力（使其能够探测到比金星暗 1000 亿倍的物体），使得新特洛伊木马的发现成为可能。

paras.en: The new Trojan observations form part of the Rubin Science Validation Survey, a three-month-long test run that was held in mid-2025 prior to the start of the observatory's flagship decade-long Legacy Survey of Space and Time (LSST), which is now underway. By chance, the Science Validation Survey encompassed the part of the sky containing Neptune's L5 Trojans, leading to the asteroids being photographed within three weeks of the survey's start.
paras.zh: 新的特洛伊观测是鲁宾科学验证调查的一部分，这是一项为期三个月的测试，于 2025 年中期进行，之前该天文台长达十年的旗舰时空遗产调查 (LSST) 正在进行中。一次偶然的机会，科学验证调查覆盖了包含海王星 L5 特洛伊小行星的天空部分，导致在调查开始后三周内拍摄到了这些小行星的照片。

paras.en: Following the discoveries, the researchers created computer models to determine the asteroids' orbits. These simulations revealed that the duo will continue to tag behind Neptune for a billion years. The results suggest that the asteroids' trajectories have been stable for several billion years, which means the asteroids may have been traversing these routes from the time of the early solar system. The researchers also found a third object in Rubin's data, but it had a stable orbit in only some of their simulations, leading them to classify it as a candidate Trojan rather than a confirmed one.
paras.zh: 根据这些发现，研究人员创建了计算机模型来确定小行星的轨道。这些模拟表明，这对二人组将继续跟随海王星十亿年。结果表明，小行星的轨道数十亿年来一直保持稳定，这意味着小行星可能从太阳系早期就沿着这些路线移动。研究人员还在鲁宾的数据中发现了第三个物体，但它仅在一些模拟中具有稳定的轨道，导致他们将其归类为候选特洛伊木马，而不是已确认的特洛伊木马。

paras.en: However, the two confirmed Trojans likely didn't form in place alongside Neptune. The simulations showed that the asteroids' orbits are highly tilted, just like those of the previously discovered L5 asteroids — suggesting that Neptune captured these objects as they were hurtling past.
paras.zh: 然而，这两个已证实的特洛伊木马很可能不是在海王星旁边形成的。模拟显示，这些小行星的轨道高度倾斜，就像之前发现的 L5 小行星一样，这表明海王星在这些物体飞驰而过时捕获了它们。

paras.en: Determining the properties of both the Jovian and Neptunian Trojan asteroids will help researchers understand what happened during the solar system's infancy, when the giant planets are believed to have migrated to their present-day positions, Volk said.
paras.zh: 沃尔克说，确定木星和海王星特洛伊小行星的特性将有助于研究人员了解太阳系婴儿期发生的事情，当时人们相信这些巨型行星已经迁移到了现在的位置。

paras.en: Schwamb expects the LSST to unveil many more of the hypothesized Neptunian Trojans, especially because it will survey this same patch of the sky repeatedly over the next several months.
paras.zh: 施万布预计 LSST 将揭示更多假设的海王星特洛伊木马，特别是因为它将在未来几个月内反复勘察同一片天空。

paras.en: Schwamb, M. E., Bernardinelli, P. H., Volk, K., Murtagh, J., 林 H. W. 省. L., Rivkin, A. S., Chandler, C. O., Jones, R. L., Benecchi, S. D., Jurić, M., Kurlander, J. A., Greenstreet, S., Wilson, A., West, M., & Lyttle, R. R. (2026). NSF-DOE Vera C. Rubin Observatory’s first view of the Neptune Trojan L5 (Trailing) cloud: Two new long-term stable Trojans. The Astrophysical Journal Letters, 1010(2), L36. https://doi.org/10.3847/2041-8213/aead9a
paras.zh: Schwamb, M. E.、Bernardinelli, P. H.、Volk, K.、Murtagh, J.、林 H. W. 省。 L.、Rivkin, A. S.、Chandler, C. O.、Jones, R. L.、Benecchi, S. D.、Jurić, M.、Kurlander, J. A.、Greenstreet, S.、Wilson, A.、West, M. 和 Lyttle, R. R. (2026)。 NSF-DOE Vera C. Rubin 天文台对海王星特洛伊木马 L5（尾随）云的首次观察：两个新的长期稳定特洛伊木马。天体物理学杂志快报，1010(2)，L36。 https://doi.org/10.3847/2041-8213/aad9a

paras.en: Abha Jain is a freelance science writer. She did a masters degree in biology, specializing in neuroscience, from the Indian Institute of Science, Bengaluru, India, and is almost through with a bachelor's degree in archaeology from the University of Leicester, UK. She's also a self-taught space enthusiast, and so loves writing about topics in astronomy, archaeology and neuroscience.
paras.zh: 艾卜哈·贾恩 (Abha Jain) 是一位自由科学作家。她在印度班加罗尔的印度科学研究所获得了生物学硕士学位，专攻神经科学，并且即将获得英国莱斯特大学的考古学学士学位。她也是一位自学成才的太空爱好者，因此喜欢撰写有关天文学、考古学和神经科学主题的文章。

articles.title: Voyager 1 stops sending science data ahead of its light-day milestone — but NASA has a plan
articles.author: Brandon Specktor

paras.en: NASA has confirmed that its Voyager 1 spacecraft has reached a record-breaking 1 light-day from Earth — but new milestones come with old problems.
paras.zh: 美国国家航空航天局 (NASA) 证实，其航行者一号航天器已经达到了破纪录的距离地球 1 光日的距离，但新的里程碑也伴随着老问题。

paras.en: On Nov. 14, the Voyager mission team discovered that the nearly 50-year-old space probe had stopped sending science data back to Earth, according to NASA — a problem that the team had to deal with as recently as 2024. As of Thursday (Nov. 19), the team had not resolved the problem.
paras.zh: 据 NASA 称，11 月 14 日，航海者号任务团队发现，这个已有近 50 年历史的太空探测器已停止向地球发送科学数据——该团队直到 2024 年才不得不处理这个问题。截至周四（11 月 19 日），该团队尚未解决该问题。

paras.en: But they did detect a "carrier" signal that is used to ferry science and engineering information from Voyager 1 to Earth, confirming that the probe is still powered up and pointed in the right direction.
paras.zh: 但他们确实检测到了一个“载波”信号，该信号用于将科学和工程信息从旅行者一号传送到地球，确认探测器仍然通电并指向正确的方向。

paras.en: "We have an anomaly that is not unseen before," Suzanne Dodd, Voyager project manager, said at a NASA news conference Thursday, adding that she is "confident" that the science data will continue flowing again soon.
paras.zh: 航行者号项目经理苏珊娜·多德 (Suzanne Dodd) 在美国宇航局周四的新闻发布会上表示：“我们遇到了以前从未见过的异常​​情况。”她补充说，她“有信心”科学数据将很快再次继续流动。

paras.en: Using the carrier signal, the team confirmed that the probe had reached its latest distance milestone of 1 light-day from Earth, or roughly 16.1 billion miles (25.9 billion kilometers) away, Wednesday (Nov. 18). At this distance, which no human-made object had ever reached before, it takes a full 24 hours for radio signals traveling at the speed of light to get from Earth to Voyager 1 and vice versa. (The spacecraft's twin probe, Voyager 2, is expected to reach its own light-day in 2035.)
paras.zh: 利用载波信号，该团队确认探测器已于周三（11 月 18 日）达到距地球 1 光日的最新距离里程碑，即距地球约 161 亿英里（259 亿公里）。在这个距离上，以前没有人造物体达到过，以光速传播的无线电信号从地球到航行者一号需要整整 24 小时，反之亦然。 （该航天器的双探测器 Voyager 2 预计将在 2035 年达到自己的光日。）

paras.en: This incredible distance, coupled with the spacecraft's five-decade-old hardware, makes troubleshooting problems on the probe extremely arduous, Dodd explained.
paras.zh: 多德解释说，这个令人难以置信的距离，再加上航天器已有五年历史的硬件，使得探测器上的故障排除变得极其困难。

paras.en: "It takes two days to diagnose anything with the spacecraft — so we can't do anything fast, and the data rates are very low," she said. "We are in a realm where we're going to see more anomalies with Voyager, just due to the distance and the age."
paras.zh: “用航天器诊断任何事情都需要两天的时间——所以我们不能快速做任何事情，而且数据速率非常低，”她说。 “由于距离和年龄的原因，我们将在航行者号上看到更多异常现象。”

paras.en: Get the world’s most fascinating discoveries delivered straight to your inbox.
paras.zh: 将世界上最迷人的发现直接发送到您的收件箱。

paras.en: According to NASA, the current glitch likely stems from Voyager's onboard computer, which is responsible for collecting data from its science instruments and transmitting it back to Earth in a readable format. The team encountered a similar problem in November 2023 that prevented Voyager 1 from sharing science data until engineers solved the issue in June 2024. The mission team is approaching this new glitch the same way they solved the previous one, NASA wrote in a blog post.
paras.zh: 据美国宇航局称，当前的故障可能源于航行者号的机载计算机，该计算机负责从科学仪器中收集数据并以可读格式将其传输回地球。该团队在 2023 年 11 月遇到了类似的问题，导致航行者 1 号无法共享科学数据，直到工程师在 2024 年 6 月解决了这个问题。NASA 在一篇博客文章中写道，任务团队正在以解决前一个问题的方式解决这个新问题。

paras.en: If the fix succeeds, Voyager 1 will continue transmitting data from its two remaining science instruments — a magnetometer, which measures magnetic fields in interstellar space, and a plasma wave detector, which measures charged particles in the interstellar medium. To conserve power on the aging spacecraft, the mission team shut off some of Voyager's instruments earlier this year while powering other, more efficient ones in a "Big Bang" maneuver that should keep the probe alive through at least 2027.
paras.zh: 如果修复成功，航海者一号将继续从其剩余的两个科学仪器传输数据——磁力计，用于测量星际空间中的磁场，以及等离子体波探测器，用于测量星际介质中的带电粒子。为了节省老化航天器的电力，任务团队在今年早些时候关闭了航行者号的一些仪器，同时为“大爆炸”机动中的其他更高效的仪器提供动力，这将使探测器至少保持到 2027 年。

paras.en: However, it's only a matter of time before Voyager 1 runs out of juice and closes its mechanical eyes to the cosmos. After that, it will continue drifting through interstellar space indefinitely, carrying a Golden Record of images, music and information about life on Earth. In the meantime, Voyager will continue learning everything it can about the strange environment of the interstellar medium — the space between stars, where only Voyagers 1 and 2 have ever been before.
paras.zh: 然而，航行者一号耗尽能量并关闭其对宇宙的机械眼只是时间问题。此后，它将继续无限期地在星际空间中漂流，携带着有关地球生命的图像、音乐和信息的黄金唱片。与此同时，航海家号将继续尽其所能地了解星际介质（恒星之间的空间）的奇怪环境，此前只有航海家号和航海家二号曾经去过那里。

paras.en: Voyager 1 officially reached interstellar space in 2012, after transforming our views of Jupiter, Saturn and other solar system bodies. For more about the probe's incredible discoveries, check out our collection of Voyager 1's iconic photos.
paras.zh: 航海者一号于 2012 年正式抵达星际空间，改变了我们对木星、土星和其他太阳系天体的看法。有关探测器令人难以置信的发现的更多信息，请查看我们的航行者 1 号标志性照片集。

paras.en: See how well you know our planetary neighborhood with our solar system quiz!
paras.zh: 通过我们的太阳系测验来看看您对我们的行星邻居有多了解！

paras.en: Brandon is the space / physics editor at Live Science. With more than 20 years of editorial experience, his writing has appeared in The Washington Post, Reader's Digest, CBS.com, the Richard Dawkins Foundation website and other outlets. He holds a bachelor's degree in creative writing from the University of Arizona, with minors in journalism and media arts. His interests include black holes, asteroids and comets, and the search for extraterrestrial life.
paras.zh: 布兰登是《Live Science》的空间/物理编辑。凭借 20 多年的编辑经验，他的文章曾发表在《华盛顿邮报》、《读者文摘》、CBS.com、理查德·道金斯基金会网站和其他媒体上。他拥有亚利桑那大学创意写作学士学位，辅修新闻学和媒体艺术。他的兴趣包括黑洞、小行星和彗星，以及寻找外星生命。
